```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { msCheckCircleFill } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { inr } from '../../../shared/data/format'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { breakevenCharges, breakevenExample, exampleChargesTotal } from '../data'
import { BreakevenIcon } from '../components/BreakevenIcon'
import styles from './BreakevenExplainerV2.module.css'

/*
 * ARCHIVED 2026-11-04 — not in the app. V2 of the How breakeven works explainer (and V1, the version that ships, as it
 * was then). To bring it back: move this file and its CSS to components/ (as BreakevenExplainer), put
 * `breakevenExampleV2` back in data.ts, and add the F&O option `breakevenExplainer` (V1 / V2) that BreakevenSheet reads
 * with useFlowOption, passing `version` and `explainerLength(version)` for the button's lock.
 */

/**
 * V2 of the explainer, true to scale once it zooms out: ₹0 → ₹100 (the buy), the ₹0.25 of charges on it, and a 12% gain
 * to the sell at ₹112. `path` runs after the buy (`at` 0 → 1 of the plot after it).
 */
const breakevenExampleV2 = {
  entry: breakevenExample.entry,
  breakeven: breakevenExample.breakeven,
  exit: 112,
  axis: [100, 0],
  path: [
    { at: 0, price: breakevenExample.entry },
    { at: 0.1, price: 100.1 },
    { at: 0.2, price: breakevenExample.breakeven },
    { at: 0.36, price: 103.5 },
    { at: 0.48, price: 102.6 },
    { at: 0.66, price: 107 },
    { at: 0.76, price: 106 },
    { at: 0.9, price: 112 },
  ],
}

/**
 * The example in How breakeven works — copied from the designer's recording of the explainer (measured frame by frame),
 * plus the charges breakdown (designer's brief, 2026-11-03). A 15 s loop on a white stage:
 * 1. the price axis (₹100–₹103) and its dashed gridlines fade in; the buy dot pops in at ₹100 with "Bought at ₹100";
 * 2. the chart zooms in 2× on ₹100 → ₹100.25 (the charges are thin at the normal scale): ₹102–₹103 move up out
 *    of view and the charges zone fills one charge at a time, each a band as tall as its share of the charges, with a
 *    tag (name · ₹ on the ₹100 buy). Top down: STT, transaction, stamp duty, SEBI, and brokerage last at
 *    the bottom. They come in top down, so brokerage comes in last (₹0.02, a thin band, its tag the small one);
 * 3. it zooms back out: the bands close into one orange charges zone and the tags slide down under it, stacking into one
 *    tag that reads "Order charges" and stays under the zone; the breakeven line draws across its top at ₹100.25
 *    and its B/E chip comes in;
 * 3. an LTP bubble rides the price line as it draws up to ₹102 (showing the last price it passed); where it crosses the
 *    breakeven line a ringed marker pulses;
 * 4. at ₹102 the bubble goes, a green dot pulses, "Sold at ₹102" slides in and the green net-profit zone grows from the
 *    breakeven line up to the sell price, labelled "Net Profit"; it holds;
 * 5. it plays once and stops on the finished chart (at 9.3 s); a tap on it plays it again from the start.
 * (The recording looped on into an intro — the Breakeven mark, INTRODUCING, Breakeven Line, the one-liner — at 11.75 s;
 * kept below but not reached while it stops on the chart.)
 * `still` (reduced motion) shows the finished chart and no intro.
 */
export function BreakevenExplainer({ still = false, version = 'v1' }: { still?: boolean; version?: ExplainerVersion }) {
  const stageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const width = useWidth(stageRef, FIGMA_WIDTH)
  const [run, setRun] = useState(0)
  const played = explainerLength(version)
  const elapsed = useElapsed(!still, played, run)
  const loop = Math.floor(elapsed / LOOP)
  const time = still ? played : elapsed % LOOP
  const replay = () => { if (!still && elapsed >= played) setRun(run + 1) }

  return (
    <div
      ref={stageRef}
      className={styles.stage}
      style={{ height: HEIGHT }}
      role="button"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={`${t(version === 'v2' ? 'breakeven.chartLabelV2' : 'breakeven.chartLabel')} ${t('breakeven.replay')}`}
      onClick={replay}
      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); replay() } }}
    >
      <ExampleChart time={time} width={width} version={version} />
      {!still && time >= INTRO_AT && <Intro key={loop} />}
      {!still && loop > 0 && time < INTRO_OUT && <Intro key={loop - 1} fade={1 - ramp(time, [0, INTRO_OUT])} />}
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * V1: the recording's order — the buy, zoom in for the charges, zoom out. V2 (designer's brief, 2026-11-04): it starts
 * zoomed in; the price line rises from the bottom of the chart to the buy at ₹100 ("Bought at ₹100") and a blue fill
 * rises under it to the ₹100 line (₹0 → ₹100, what the buy cost), the charges fill and close into one "Order charges"
 * zone, and only then it zooms out — all the way, true to scale (₹100 stays put, the chart shrinks down to ₹0): the blue ₹100, the ₹0.25 of charges
 * a hairline on it, then the B/E line, the run up 12% to "Sold at ₹112" and the green Net Profit.
 */
export type ExplainerVersion = 'v1' | 'v2'
type Timeline = Record<keyof typeof SHOT_V1, [number, number]>

/**
 * Where each part comes in: [start, duration] in ms (t = 0 is the chart starting on a blank stage). From the B/E line
 * on, it's the recording's timing moved 3 s later for the charges breakdown. `leadIn` (V2 only) is the line rising to
 * the buy; a start of -1 means already there at t = 0.
 */
const SHOT_V1 = {
  axis: [150, 250],
  leadIn: [-1, 1],
  boughtZone: [Infinity, 1], // V2 only
  buyDot: [400, 200],
  bought: [650, 150],
  boughtOut: [Infinity, 1], // V2 only
  boughtLabel: [Infinity, 1], // V2 only
  zoomIn: [1000, 500],
  chargeFill: [1550, 300], // the top band and its tag first; each one below CHARGE_STEP later, brokerage last
  zoomOut: [4100, 600],
  leadersOut: [4100, 150],
  zoneMerge: [4100, 600], // the bands close into one zone
  tagsMerge: [4100, 450], // the top tag first; each one below TAG_MERGE_STEP later
  tagsOut: [4600, 150], // the stacked tags cross-fade into the one "Order charges" tag under the zone
  chargesLabel: [4600, 150],
  breakevenLine: [4750, 450],
  breakevenChip: [5200, 200],
  ltpIn: [5550, 150],
  priceLine: [5800, 2150],
  crossingPulse: [120, 400], // after the line reaches the crossing
  ltpOut: [8000, 150],
  sellDot: [8000, 200],
  sellPulse: [8200, 500],
  sold: [8250, 150],
  profitZone: [8450, 550],
  profitLabel: [9150, 150],
} satisfies Record<string, [number, number]>

/** V2: zoomed in from the start; the line rises to the buy, the charges fill and merge, then it zooms out. */
const SHOT_V2: Timeline = {
  axis: [100, 250],
  leadIn: [300, 1100],
  boughtZone: [1400, 450], // the blue ₹0 → ₹100 fill rises from the bottom to the buy
  buyDot: [1400, 200],
  bought: [1600, 150],
  boughtOut: [4600, 150], // the callout hands over to the blue zone's own label (the Order charges tag takes its place)
  boughtLabel: [5600, 200], // zoomed out: "Bought at ₹100" inside the blue zone
  zoomIn: [-1, 1],
  chargeFill: [2000, 300],
  leadersOut: [4100, 150],
  zoneMerge: [4100, 450],
  tagsMerge: [4100, 450],
  tagsOut: [4600, 150],
  chargesLabel: [4600, 150],
  zoomOut: [5000, 600],
  breakevenLine: [5700, 450],
  breakevenChip: [6150, 200],
  ltpIn: [6500, 150],
  priceLine: [6750, 2150],
  crossingPulse: [120, 400],
  ltpOut: [8950, 150],
  sellDot: [8950, 200],
  sellPulse: [9150, 500],
  sold: [9200, 150],
  profitZone: [9400, 550],
  profitLabel: [10100, 150],
}
const SHOTS: Record<ExplainerVersion, Timeline> = { v1: SHOT_V1, v2: SHOT_V2 }
/**
 * V2's line before the buy: rising from the bottom of the chart to ₹100, in the plot's first 28% (the trade after the
 * buy takes the rest). It comes in from the left, above "Bought at ₹100", so the callout stays clear.
 */
const BUY_AT: Record<ExplainerVersion, number> = { v1: 0, v2: 0.28 }
const LEAD_IN: Record<ExplainerVersion, { at: number; price: number }[]> = {
  v1: [],
  v2: [
    { at: 0, price: 99.28 },
    { at: 0.06, price: 99.5 },
    { at: 0.1, price: 99.42 },
    { at: 0.15, price: 99.62 },
    { at: 0.2, price: 99.9 },
    { at: 0.28, price: 100 },
  ],
}
const CHARGE_STEP = 350
const TAG_MERGE_STEP = 30
const LOOP = 15000
/** How long one play takes (ms): it stops on the finished chart, its Net Profit label in. */
export function explainerLength(version: ExplainerVersion) {
  const { profitLabel } = SHOTS[version]
  return profitLabel[0] + profitLabel[1]
}
/** The hard cut to the intro, and how long the intro takes to fade when the loop starts again. */
const INTRO_AT = 11750
const INTRO_OUT = 200
/** The LTP value cross-fades for this long when the line passes a turn. */
const LTP_SWAP = 100

/** The plot, in px (measured at the card's 326 width in Figma; it stretches with the card). */
const FIGMA_WIDTH = 326
const HEIGHT = 286
const PLOT_LEFT = 53.5
const PLOT_RIGHT_INSET = 12.5
const AXIS_X = 12.5
const ZONE_LABEL_INSET = 8.5
/**
 * "Order charges" is a tag in the charge tags' column, 6 under the zone (its middle 17 under ₹100): the zone, ₹0.25
 * tall, is too thin to hold it. A tag's text starts 7 in (its 6 padding and 1 edge).
 */
const CHARGES_LABEL_DROP = 17
const TAG_TEXT_INSET = 7
/** Callouts around their dots: "Bought" hangs 12.5 below with its notch 20 in; "Sold" ends 10 left; LTP sits 8.5 above. */
const BOUGHT_GAP = 12.5
const BOUGHT_NOTCH_X = 20
const SOLD_GAP = 10
const LTP_GAP = 8.5
/** V2's green strip is too thin to hold its label: "Net Profit" sits 10 above it. */
const PROFIT_LABEL_ABOVE = 10
/** ₹100 sits at 209 and every rupee is 53 higher; zoomed in, 2× that (the charges zone twice its final height). */
const BASELINE = 209
const RUPEE = 53
const ZOOM = 2
const ZOOMED_RUPEE = RUPEE * ZOOM
const priceY = (price: number, perRupee: number) => BASELINE - (price - breakevenExample.entry) * perRupee
/**
 * V2 zoomed out, true to scale: ₹100 stays where it was and the chart shrinks down to it — ₹0 comes up to 12 above the
 * stage's bottom, so everything (the ₹0.25 of charges, the 12% to ₹112) is at that scale.
 */
const TRUE_ZERO_Y = HEIGHT - 12
const TRUE_RUPEE = (TRUE_ZERO_Y - BASELINE) / breakevenExampleV2.entry
const EXAMPLES = { v1: breakevenExample, v2: breakevenExampleV2 }
/**
 * Zoomed in, each charge is a band of the zone, as tall as its share of the charges (at least 2, so SEBI's ~0.1% still
 * shows; the rest shrink to make room), 1 apart. Their tags sit in a column 140 from the plot's right, at least 24
 * apart and 10 from the top, each joined by a leader to a dot 20 left of it at its band's middle.
 */
const MIN_BAND = 2
const BAND_GAP = 1
const TAG_COLUMN = 140
const TAG_SPACING = 24
const TAG_TOP = 10
const LEADER = 20
const BANDS = chargeBands()

function ExampleChart({ time, width, version }: { time: number; width: number; version: ExplainerVersion }) {
  const gradientId = useId()
  const SHOT = SHOTS[version]
  const { entry, breakeven, exit, axis, path } = EXAMPLES[version]
  const zoomIn = ramp(time, SHOT.zoomIn, easeInOut)
  const zoomOut = ramp(time, SHOT.zoomOut, easeInOut)
  // V1 zooms out to 1 rupee = 53; V2 all the way to true scale (on a log scale, so the 50× zoom reads as one move).
  const perRupee = version === 'v2'
    ? ZOOMED_RUPEE * (TRUE_RUPEE / ZOOMED_RUPEE) ** zoomOut
    : RUPEE + (ZOOMED_RUPEE - RUPEE) * zoomIn * (1 - zoomOut)
  const y = (price: number) => priceY(price, perRupee)
  const plotRight = width - PLOT_RIGHT_INSET
  const buyAt = BUY_AT[version]
  const plotX = (at: number) => PLOT_LEFT + at * (plotRight - PLOT_LEFT)
  const points = path.map((p) => ({ x: plotX(buyAt + p.at * (1 - buyAt)), y: y(p.price), price: p.price }))
  const leadIn = LEAD_IN[version].map((p) => ({ x: plotX(p.at), y: y(p.price) }))
  const leadInDrawn = leadIn.length ? lineTo(leadIn, ramp(time, SHOT.leadIn)) : []
  const start = points[0]
  const end = points[points.length - 1]
  const crossing = points.find((p) => p.price === breakeven) ?? points[0]

  // The price line draws at a steady pace across the plot; its head is where the LTP bubble rides.
  const drawn = ramp(time, SHOT.priceLine)
  const headX = start.x + drawn * (end.x - start.x)
  const passed = points.filter((p) => p.x <= headX)
  const next = points[passed.length]
  const last = passed[passed.length - 1] ?? start
  const head = next ? { x: headX, y: last.y + ((headX - last.x) / (next.x - last.x)) * (next.y - last.y) } : end
  const crossedAt = SHOT.priceLine[0] + ((crossing.x - start.x) / (end.x - start.x)) * SHOT.priceLine[1]
  const lastTurnAt = SHOT.priceLine[0] + ((last.x - start.x) / (end.x - start.x)) * SHOT.priceLine[1]

  const axisIn = ramp(time, SHOT.axis)
  const boughtZone = ramp(time, SHOT.boughtZone, easeOut)
  const zoneBottom = Math.min(y(0), HEIGHT)
  const profitZone = ramp(time, SHOT.profitZone, easeOut) * (y(breakeven) - y(exit))
  const ltp = ramp(time, SHOT.ltpIn, easeOut) * (1 - ramp(time, SHOT.ltpOut))
  const sellIn = ramp(time, SHOT.sellDot, easeOutBack)
  const chargeIn = (order: number) => SHOT.chargeFill[0] + (BANDS.length - 1 - order) * CHARGE_STEP
  const bandFill = (order: number) => ramp(time, [chargeIn(order), SHOT.chargeFill[1]], easeOut)
  const leadersShown = 1 - ramp(time, SHOT.leadersOut)
  const tagsShown = 1 - ramp(time, SHOT.tagsOut)
  const tagX = plotRight - TAG_COLUMN
  const labelX = tagX + TAG_TEXT_INSET
  const labelY = y(entry) + CHARGES_LABEL_DROP
  const tagMerge = (order: number) =>
    ramp(time, [SHOT.tagsMerge[0] + (BANDS.length - 1 - order) * TAG_MERGE_STEP, SHOT.tagsMerge[1]], easeInOut)

  return (
    <>
      <svg className={styles.chart} width={width} height={HEIGHT} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${HEIGHT}`} aria-hidden>
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={gradientId} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0" className={styles.profitTop} />
            <stop offset="0.6" className={styles.profitMid} />
            <stop offset="1" className={styles.profitBottom} />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        {/* V2: what the buy cost, ₹0 → ₹100 — blue up from the bottom of the chart to the ₹100 line. */}
        <rect className={styles.boughtZone} x={PLOT_LEFT} width={plotRight - PLOT_LEFT} y={zoneBottom - boughtZone * (zoneBottom - y(entry))} height={boughtZone * (zoneBottom - y(entry))} />
        <g opacity={axisIn}>
          {axis.map((price) => (
            <line key={price} className={price === entry ? styles.baseline : styles.gridline} x1={PLOT_LEFT} x2={plotRight} y1={y(price)} y2={y(price)} />
          ))}
        </g>
        {/* The charges zone: the bands fill up one by one; zooming out, the whole zone fades in over them and closes the gaps. */}
        {BANDS.map((band, order) => {
          const top = y(band.from + (band.to - band.from) * bandFill(order))
          const height = Math.max(0, y(band.from) - top - BAND_GAP)
          return height > 0 && <rect key={band.charge.id} className={styles.chargesZone} x={PLOT_LEFT} width={plotRight - PLOT_LEFT} y={top} height={height} />
        })}
        <rect className={styles.chargesZone} x={PLOT_LEFT} width={plotRight - PLOT_LEFT} y={y(breakeven)} height={y(entry) - y(breakeven)} opacity={ramp(time, SHOT.zoneMerge, easeInOut)} />
        {leadersShown > 0 &&
          BANDS.map((band, order) => {
            const shown = ramp(time, [chargeIn(order), SHOT.chargeFill[1]]) * leadersShown
            const middle = y((band.from + band.to) / 2)
            return (
              shown > 0 && (
                <g key={band.charge.id} className={styles.leader} opacity={shown}>
                  <line x1={tagX - LEADER} y1={middle} x2={tagX} y2={band.tagY} />
                  <circle cx={tagX - LEADER} cy={middle} r={2} />
                </g>
              )
            )
          })}
        <rect fill={`url(#${gradientId})`} x={PLOT_LEFT} width={plotRight - PLOT_LEFT} y={y(breakeven) - profitZone} height={profitZone} />
        <line
          className={styles.breakevenLine}
          x1={PLOT_LEFT}
          x2={PLOT_LEFT + ramp(time, SHOT.breakevenLine, easeInOut) * (plotRight - PLOT_LEFT)}
          y1={y(breakeven)}
          y2={y(breakeven)}
        />
        {leadInDrawn.length > 1 && <polyline className={styles.priceLine} points={leadInDrawn.map((p) => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(' ')} />}
        {drawn > 0 && <polyline className={styles.priceLine} points={[...passed, head].map((p) => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(' ')} />}
        <circle className={styles.buyDot} cx={start.x} cy={start.y} r={4.5 * ramp(time, SHOT.buyDot, easeOutBack)} />
        {time >= crossedAt && (
          <g>
            <Pulse cx={crossing.x} cy={crossing.y} time={time - crossedAt} shot={SHOT.crossingPulse} className={styles.crossingPulse} />
            <circle className={styles.crossingRing} cx={crossing.x} cy={crossing.y} r={7.5} />
            <circle className={styles.buyDot} cx={crossing.x} cy={crossing.y} r={4} />
          </g>
        )}
        {drawn >= 1 && (
          <g>
            <Pulse cx={end.x} cy={end.y} time={time} shot={SHOT.sellPulse} className={styles.sellPulse} />
            <circle className={sellIn > 0 ? styles.sellRing : styles.sellRingDrawing} cx={end.x} cy={end.y} r={7.5} />
            <circle className={styles.sellDot} cx={end.x} cy={end.y} r={4.5 * sellIn} />
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>

      {axis.map((price) => (
        <span key={price} className={price === entry ? styles.axisEntry : styles.axisLabel} style={at(AXIS_X, y(price), axisIn)}>
          {inr(price, 0)}
        </span>
      ))}

      <span className={styles.chip} style={{ ...at(plotRight, y(breakeven), ramp(time, SHOT.breakevenChip, easeOut)), scale: `${0.9 + 0.1 * ramp(time, SHOT.breakevenChip, easeOut)}` }}>
        <span className={styles.chipTag}>{t('breakeven.beTag')}</span>
        {inr(breakeven)}
      </span>

      <span
        className={styles.zoneLabel}
        style={at(labelX, labelY, ramp(time, SHOT.chargesLabel))}
        data-zone="charges"
      >
        {t('breakeven.charges')}
        <span className={styles.chargeRate}>{t('breakeven.chargesTotal', { amount: chargeInr(exampleChargesTotal) })}</span>
      </span>
      <span className={styles.zoneLabel} style={at(PLOT_LEFT + ZONE_LABEL_INSET, version === 'v2' ? y(exit) - PROFIT_LABEL_ABOVE : y(exit) + 32.5, ramp(time, SHOT.profitLabel))} data-zone="profit">
        {t('breakeven.netProfit')}
      </span>
      <span className={styles.zoneLabel} style={at(PLOT_LEFT + ZONE_LABEL_INSET, (y(entry) + zoneBottom) / 2, ramp(time, SHOT.boughtLabel))} data-zone="bought">
        {t('breakeven.bought', { price: inr(entry, 0) })}
      </span>

      {/* Zooming out, the tags slide into the zone and stack where its "Order charges" label comes in. */}
      {tagsShown > 0 &&
        BANDS.map((band, order) => {
          const shown = ramp(time, [chargeIn(order), SHOT.chargeFill[1]], easeOut)
          const merge = tagMerge(order)
          const tagY = band.tagY + (labelY - band.tagY) * merge
          return (
            shown > 0 && (
              <span key={band.charge.id} className={styles.chargeTag} data-size={band.charge.id === 'brokerage' ? 'small' : undefined} style={{ ...rise(at(tagX, tagY), shown, 0, 4), opacity: shown * tagsShown }}>
                {t(`breakeven.charge.${band.charge.id}`)}
                <span className={styles.chargeRate}>{chargeInr(band.charge.amount)}</span>
              </span>
            )
          )
        })}

      <span className={styles.bought} style={rise(at(start.x - BOUGHT_NOTCH_X, start.y + BOUGHT_GAP), ramp(time, SHOT.bought, easeOut) * (1 - ramp(time, SHOT.boughtOut)), 0, 4)}>
        {t('breakeven.bought', { price: inr(entry, 0) })}
      </span>
      <span
        className={styles.sold}
        data-place={version === 'v2' ? 'above' : undefined}
        style={version === 'v2'
          ? rise(at(end.x + SOLD_GAP, end.y - SOLD_GAP), ramp(time, SHOT.sold, easeOut), 0, 4)
          : rise(at(end.x - SOLD_GAP, end.y), ramp(time, SHOT.sold, easeOut), 6, 0)}
      >
        <Icon icon={msCheckCircleFill} size={16} />
        {t('breakeven.sold', { price: inr(exit, 0) })}
      </span>

      {ltp > 0 && (
        <span className={styles.ltp} style={{ ...at(head.x, head.y - LTP_GAP, ltp), scale: `${0.9 + 0.1 * ltp}` }}>
          <span className={styles.ltpName}>{t('breakeven.ltp')}</span>
          <span key={last.price} className={styles.ltpValue} style={{ opacity: last === start ? 1 : ramp(time, [lastTurnAt, LTP_SWAP]) }}>
            {inr(last.price)}
          </span>
        </span>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

/**
 * The charges as bands of the zone, bottom to top (in rupees, so they follow the zoom), and where each tag sits when
 * zoomed in: at its band's middle, pushed up to stay TAG_SPACING apart, then back down to stay under TAG_TOP.
 */
function chargeBands() {
  const { entry, breakeven } = breakevenExample
  const zone = breakeven - entry
  const total = breakevenCharges.reduce((sum, charge) => sum + charge.amount, 0)
  const heights = breakevenCharges.map((charge) => Math.max((charge.amount / total) * zone, MIN_BAND / ZOOMED_RUPEE))
  const fit = zone / heights.reduce((sum, height) => sum + height, 0)
  let from = entry
  const bands = breakevenCharges.map((charge, order) => {
    const band = { charge, from, to: from + heights[order] * fit, tagY: 0 }
    from = band.to
    return band
  })
  bands.forEach((band, order) => {
    const middle = priceY((band.from + band.to) / 2, ZOOMED_RUPEE)
    band.tagY = order === 0 ? middle : Math.min(middle, bands[order - 1].tagY - TAG_SPACING)
  })
  for (let order = bands.length - 1; order >= 0; order--) {
    const above = bands[order + 1]
    bands[order].tagY = Math.max(bands[order].tagY, above ? above.tagY + TAG_SPACING : TAG_TOP)
  }
  return bands
}

/** The polyline `points` drawn `progress` (0 → 1) of the way along x, ending at its moving head. */
function lineTo(points: { x: number; y: number }[], progress: number) {
  const first = points[0]
  const headX = first.x + progress * (points[points.length - 1].x - first.x)
  const passed = points.filter((p) => p.x <= headX)
  const next = points[passed.length]
  if (!next || passed.length === 0) return passed
  const last = passed[passed.length - 1]
  return [...passed, { x: headX, y: last.y + ((headX - last.x) / (next.x - last.x)) * (next.y - last.y) }]
}

/** A charge in ₹: paise to 2 places (₹0.15); the tiny ones to their first digit (₹0.003, ₹0.0002). */
function chargeInr(amount: number) {
  return `₹${amount >= 0.01 ? amount.toFixed(2) : Number(amount.toPrecision(1))}`
}

/** A ring that grows from the marker (7.5 → 14) and fades. */
function Pulse({ cx, cy, time, shot, className }: { cx: number; cy: number; time: number; shot: [number, number]; className: string }) {
  const p = ramp(time, shot, easeOut)
  if (p <= 0 || p >= 1) return null
  return <circle className={className} cx={cx} cy={cy} r={7.5 + 6.5 * p} opacity={0.4 * (1 - p)} />
}

/** The intro the loop ends on: Figma's reveal (its timings are CSS animations, so it plays each time it mounts). */
function Intro({ fade = 1 }: { fade?: number }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.intro} style={{ opacity: fade }}>
      <BreakevenIcon variant="tile" className={styles.introIcon} />
      <p className={styles.overline}>{t('breakeven.introducing')}</p>
      <p className={styles.introTitle}>{t('breakeven.lineName')}</p>
      <p className={styles.introText}>{t('breakeven.tagline')}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

/** A callout anchored at (x, y) on the stage; each callout's CSS places itself around that point. */
function at(x: number, y: number, opacity = 1): CSSProperties {
  return { '--x': `${x}px`, '--y': `${y}px`, opacity } as CSSProperties
}

/** Comes in by `progress`, moving from (dx, dy) px away to its place. */
function rise(style: CSSProperties, progress: number, dx: number, dy: number): CSSProperties {
  return { ...style, opacity: progress, translate: `${dx * (1 - progress)}px ${dy * (1 - progress)}px` }
}

/** 0 → 1 over [start, duration], eased. */
function ramp(time: number, [start, duration]: [number, number], ease = linear) {
  return ease(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (time - start) / duration)))
}
const linear = (x: number) => x
const easeOut = (x: number) => 1 - (1 - x) ** 3
const easeInOut = (x: number) => (x < 0.5 ? 4 * x ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * x + 2) ** 3 / 2)
const easeOutBack = (x: number) => 1 + 2.70158 * (x - 1) ** 3 + 1.70158 * (x - 1) ** 2

/** Milliseconds since the play started, every frame, stopping at `until`; a new `run` plays it again from 0. */
function useElapsed(playing: boolean, until: number, run: number) {
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return
    let frame = 0
    let start: number | undefined
    setElapsed(0)
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      start ??= now
      const passed = Math.min(now - start, until)
      setElapsed(passed)
      if (passed < until) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
    }
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame)
  }, [playing, until, run])
  return elapsed
}

/** The element's width, kept current. */
function useWidth(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, fallback: number) {
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(fallback)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current
    if (!element) return
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => setWidth(element.clientWidth))
    observer.observe(element)
    setWidth(element.clientWidth)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [ref])
  return width
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/AllEventsVersions.tsx`

```tsx
// ARCHIVED 2026-11-26 — not in the app (user: final V5 only, the rest archived). Expiring This Week V1 (`v6` All Events), V2 (`v7` Upcoming Events), V3 (`v8` Date pills) and V5 / V6 (the timeline's two options) as they were, with their View all page; the live app keeps only the final V5 (components/AllEvents.tsx). To bring one back, render it from CommoditiesFeed / CommodityCalendar and restore its option values in fno/index.tsx (git history has them).
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msApps, msArrowDropDown, msArrowDropUp, msCandlestickChart, msEvent, msSchedule, msTrendingDown, msTrendingUp, msWbIncandescentFill } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../../shared/prototype'
import { Screen } from '../../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { allEventsSample, timelineEventsSample, upcomingEventsSample, type AllEventsDay, type AllEventsItem, type AllEventsPhase } from '../data'
import { RowActions, dayFrom } from '../components/CalendarDay'
import parts from '../../components/HomeParts.module.css'
import styles from '../components/AllEvents.module.css'

type Actions = { onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }

/** Prototype setting “Event phase” (Versions 6 and 7): before the release (Forecast) or after it (Actual). */
const usePhase = () => useFlowOption('fno', 'eventPhase', 'pre') as AllEventsPhase

/**
 * Expiring This Week version 6 — “All Events” (Figma 7030:9072, Pre-Event / Post-Event, 26 Nov). Header “All Events”
 * with View all (→ the Commodity calendar, fno-38). Days down the left in a grey block (weekday, Description 12 secondary,
 * over the date, Label 14; 48 wide, radius 12), each card on its own row, every row 16 apart (a day's later cards keep
 * an empty slot where the block would be). Cards: art 20, 8 to the name (Label 12); an expiry has a grey “Expiry” tag;
 * an event “Event” and its Forecast / Actual tag (trend arrow), 6 below the name; option chain + ScalpPro on the right.
 * A note under a hairline: bulb, “In last trend, Gold has moved ▲ 1.2%”.
 */
export function AllEventsSection({ onViewAll, ...actions }: Actions & { onViewAll: () => void }) {
  const phase = usePhase()
  return <section className={parts.contractSection} aria-label={t('allEvents.title')}>
    <SectionHeader className={styles.header} title={t('allEvents.title')} action={{ type: 'view-all', label: t('viewAll'), onClick: onViewAll }} />
    <EventDays days={allEventsSample(phase)} {...actions} />
  </section>
}

/** The page's filter tabs, as on the other versions' calendar (fno-38): flat tabs with icons in the Actionbar's bottom slot (sticky). */
type Tab = 'all' | 'option' | 'future' | 'event'
const TABS: Tab[] = ['all', 'option', 'future', 'event']
const TAB_ICONS: Record<Tab, string> = { all: msApps, option: msCandlestickChart, future: msTrendingUp, event: msEvent }

/**
 * The View all page (fno-38) in versions 6 and 7: the Commodity Calendar actionbar with the All / Options / Futures /
 * Events tabs under it (user, 26 Nov — the tabs back as a filter), then each month under a band with its days below.
 * The band sticks under the tabs while its month scrolls by; the next month's band pushes it out (user, 26 Nov).
 * - Version 6 (Figma 6995:25579): grey band (surface-secondary, “NOV 2026” Heading 14 spaced 4; 8 above and below,
 *   16 above on the first), days 20 below in the version 6 list. Sample: the two days, again the month after.
 * - Version 7 (Figma 7035:13357): the band in surface-accent-discover-light (12 above on the first, 8 below), days 24 below
 *   in the version 7 list (date line, a time block per card).
 */
export function AllEventsPage({ onBack, timed = false, pill = false, timeline = false, ...actions }: Actions & { onBack: () => void; timed?: boolean; pill?: boolean; timeline?: boolean }) {
  const phase = usePhase()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('all')
  // The tab's cards: All, an expiry's contract type, or the events; days left empty drop out.
  const days = (timeline ? timelineEventsSample('one') : timed ? upcomingEventsSample(phase) : allEventsSample(phase, true))
    .map((d) => ({ ...d, items: d.items.filter((item) => tab === 'all' || (tab === 'event' ? item.kind === 'event' : item.contract === tab)) }))
    .filter((d) => d.items.length)
  const month = (offset: number) => {
    const d = dayFrom(0)
    return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + offset, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }).toUpperCase()
  }
  return <Screen top={<Actionbar title={t('expiryAll.title')} onBack={onBack} backLabel={t('lot.back')}
    bottom={<Tabs aria-label={t('expiryAll.filter')} value={tab} onChange={(v) => setTab(v as Tab)}
      items={TABS.map((value) => ({ value, label: t(`expiryAll.tab.${value}`), iconLeft: <Icon icon={TAB_ICONS[value]} size={16} /> }))} />} />}>
    {days.length ? <div className={styles.page} data-timed={timed || timeline || undefined} data-pill={pill || undefined}>
      {[0, 1].map((offset) => {
        const monthDays = days.map((d) => ({ ...d, inDays: d.inDays + offset * 30 }))
        return <section key={offset} className={styles.month} aria-label={month(offset)}>
          <h2 className={styles.band}>{month(offset)}</h2>
          <div className={styles.monthBody}>
            {timeline ? <TimelineDays days={monthDays} sameDates={offset > 0} page {...actions} />
              : timed ? <TimedDays days={monthDays} sameDates={offset > 0} pill={pill} {...actions} />
              : <EventDays days={monthDays} sameDates={offset > 0} {...actions} />}
          </div>
        </section>
      })}
    </div> : <p>{t('allEvents.empty.all')}</p>}
  </Screen>
}

/**
 * Expiring This Week version 7 — “Upcoming Events” (Figma 7035:14545, 26 Nov): version 6 with the time. Header
 * “Upcoming Events” with View all (→ fno-38). Each day under a date line (“25th Nov”, Label 12 spaced 1, a hairline
 * running to the right edge, 4 apart); every card has its own grey time block on the left (“09:00” Label 12 over “AM”
 * Description 12 secondary; 48 wide, 8 × 6 in, radius 12), 12 to the card. Day groups and cards 16 apart, the list 16
 * from the screen edge. An expiry's tag reads “Options Expiry”.
 */
export function UpcomingEventsSection({ onViewAll, pill = false, timeline = false, ...actions }: Actions & { onViewAll: () => void; pill?: boolean; timeline?: boolean }) {
  const phase = usePhase()
  const timelineOption = useTimelineOption()
  return <section className={parts.contractSection} aria-label={t('upcomingEvents.title')}>
    <SectionHeader className={styles.header} title={t('upcomingEvents.title')} action={{ type: 'view-all', label: t('viewAll'), onClick: onViewAll }} />
    {timeline ? <TimelineDays days={firstCards(timelineEventsSample(timelineOption), HOME_CARDS)} {...actions} /> : <TimedDays days={upcomingEventsSample(phase)} pill={pill} {...actions} />}
  </section>
}

/**
 * Version 8 (Figma 7042:19186) = version 7 with `pill`: each day's date in a grey pill (surface-secondary, radius 8,
 * 4 × 12 in; Label 12 spaced 2) instead of the line, and the time on the page (no grey block). Its page: the month as
 * plain text (Heading 14 spaced 4, sticky on the page surface), the months split by a 2px divider.
 */

/** Home's V5 timeline shows the first 3 cards (user, 26 Nov); View all has every one. */
const HOME_CARDS = 3
/** The days cut to their first `count` cards, in order; a day left empty drops out. */
function firstCards(days: AllEventsDay[], count: number): AllEventsDay[] {
  let left = count
  return days.map((d) => {
    const items = d.items.slice(0, Math.max(left, 0))
    left -= items.length
    return { ...d, items }
  }).filter((d) => d.items.length)
}

/** “25th Nov”. */
function ordinalDate(date: Date) {
  const n = date.getDate()
  const suffix = n % 100 >= 11 && n % 100 <= 13 ? 'th' : ['th', 'st', 'nd', 'rd'][n % 10] ?? 'th'
  return `${n}${suffix} ${date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short' })}`
}

/** Version 7's list: a date line per day, a time block per card. */
function TimedDays({ days, sameDates, pill, ...actions }: Actions & { days: AllEventsDay[]; sameDates?: boolean; pill?: boolean }) {
  return <div className={styles.timedList} data-pill={pill || undefined}>
    {days.map((day) => {
      // The page's second month repeats the sample's dates, only the month changes.
      const base = dayFrom(sameDates ? day.inDays - 30 : day.inDays)
      const date = sameDates ? new Date(base.getFullYear(), base.getMonth() + 1, base.getDate()) : base
      return <section key={day.inDays} className={styles.timedDay} aria-label={date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' })}>
        {pill ? <h3 className={styles.datePill}>{ordinalDate(date)}</h3>
          : <h3 className={styles.dateLine}><span>{ordinalDate(date)}</span><span className={styles.dateRule} /></h3>}
        {day.items.map((item) => {
          const [clock, ampm] = (item.time ?? '').split(' ')
          return <div key={item.id} className={styles.timedRow}>
            <div className={styles.timeBlock} aria-label={item.time}>
              <span className={styles.timeClock}>{clock}</span>
              <span className={styles.timeAmpm}>{ampm}</span>
            </div>
            <EventCard item={sameDates ? { ...item, live: false } : item} expiryLabel={t('upcomingEvents.optionsExpiry')} {...actions} />
          </div>
        })}
      </section>
    })}
  </div>
}

/** Version 5's two timelines (setting “Timeline”, Figma 7076:26456). */
type TimelineOption = 'one' | 'two'
const useTimelineOption = () => useFlowOption('fno', 'timelineOption', 'one') as TimelineOption

/**
 * Version 5 (`v9`) · Timeline (Figma 7076:26456 — two options, setting “Timeline”). A vertical line down the left with a
 * node per card, every card 16 apart; the line runs from the first node to the last. A live event's node is a green dot
 * (12, indicator-up) in a blinking green halo (20, indicator-up light); what's coming is a grey dot (12, border-dark). The
 * line is solid green from a live node to the next one when that one is live too or starts soon, dashed grey otherwise.
 * - Option 1: the time on the left (“5:00 PM” Label 12, right-aligned in 56; the day over a day's first time — “TODAY”,
 *   “27th Nov”, Label 10 secondary, 2 above), 8 to its node, 12 to the card. The node sits level with the time. Card: art
 *   20, name Label 12 over its tags (Options Expiry / Event grey, plus Live green or “In 2 hours” yellow with a clock), 4
 *   apart. The list starts 8 from the screen edge.
 * - Option 2: no time column: the node centred on its card, 16 from the screen edge, 16 to the card. Card: name Label 14
 *   with its grey tag (Expiry / Event) beside it, over “Today • 9:00 AM” (Label 12 secondary), 4 apart.
 * View all (fno-38, `page`) is always Option 1 — the final V5 — with each event in Version 2's card (Forecast tag, the
 * bulb note) and the months in V2's grey strip; expiries keep the timeline card.
 */
function TimelineDays({ days, sameDates, page = false, ...actions }: Actions & { days: AllEventsDay[]; sameDates?: boolean; page?: boolean }) {
  const chosen = useTimelineOption()
  // The View all page is always Option 1 (the final V5).
  const option = page ? 'one' : chosen
  const rows = days.flatMap((day) => {
    // The page's second month repeats the sample's dates, only the month changes.
    const base = dayFrom(sameDates ? day.inDays - 30 : day.inDays)
    const date = sameDates ? new Date(base.getFullYear(), base.getMonth() + 1, base.getDate()) : base
    const today = !sameDates && day.inDays === 0
    return day.items.map((item, at) => ({ item: sameDates ? { ...item, live: false, startsIn: undefined } : item, first: at === 0, today, date }))
  })
  // A stretch of line is green from a live node to the next when that one is live too or starts soon.
  const green = (i: number) => Boolean(rows[i]?.item.live && (rows[i + 1]?.item.live || rows[i + 1]?.item.startsIn))
  return <ol className={styles.timeline} data-option={option} aria-label={t('upcomingEvents.title')}>
    {rows.map(({ item, first, today, date }, i) => {
      const day = today ? t('upcomingEvents.today') : ordinalDate(date)
      return <li key={`${i}-${item.id}`} className={styles.tlRow} data-dated={(option === 'one' && first) || undefined}
        data-first={i === 0 || undefined} data-last={i === rows.length - 1 || undefined}
        data-green-up={green(i - 1) || undefined} data-green-down={green(i) || undefined}>
        {option === 'one' && <span className={styles.tlTime}>
          {first && <span className={styles.tlDay}>{today ? day.toUpperCase() : day}</span>}
          <span className={styles.tlClock}>{item.time}</span>
        </span>}
        <span className={styles.tlRail}>{item.live
          ? <span className={styles.tlLive} role="img" aria-label={t('allEvents.live')} />
          : <span className={styles.tlNode} />}</span>
        {page && item.kind === 'event'
          // On the View all page an event gets Version 2's fuller card (forecast tag, last-move note). No status tags there
          // (Live, In 2 hours): the blinking node says live; only home carries them.
          ? <EventCard item={{ ...item, live: false }} compact {...actions} />
          : <TimelineCard item={page ? { ...item, live: false, startsIn: undefined } : item} option={option} when={t('timeline.when', { day, time: item.time ?? '' })} {...actions} />}
      </li>
    })}
  </ol>
}

/** Version 5's card, per option (see TimelineDays). */
function TimelineCard({ item, option, when, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: Actions & { item: AllEventsItem; option: TimelineOption; when: string }) {
  const grey = <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" className={styles.greyTag}>
    {item.kind === 'expiry' ? (option === 'one' ? t('upcomingEvents.optionsExpiry') : t('timeline.expiry')) : t('eventsToday.event')}
  </Tag>
  return <Card padding="none" className={styles.card}>
    <div className={styles.tlBody} data-tappable={item.kind === 'expiry' || undefined} onClick={item.kind === 'expiry' ? onAsset : undefined}>
      <div className={styles.tlMain}>
        <img src={item.image} alt="" className={styles.art} />
        {option === 'one'
          ? <div className={styles.tlText}>
            <p className={styles.name}>{item.name}</p>
            <div className={styles.tlTags}>
              {grey}
              {item.live && <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" color="profit">{t('timeline.live')}</Tag>}
              {item.startsIn && <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" color="warning" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msSchedule} />}>{t('timeline.startsIn', { hours: item.startsIn })}</Tag>}
            </div>
          </div>
          : <div className={styles.tlText}>
            <div className={styles.tlTitle}><p className={styles.tlName}>{item.name}</p>{grey}</div>
            <p className={styles.tlWhen}>{when}</p>
          </div>}
      </div>
      {item.actions && <RowActions name={item.name} chain compact onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />}
    </div>
  </Card>
}

/** The list: one row per card, the day's block beside its first card (a day's later cards keep the slot empty). */
function EventDays({ days, sameDates, ...actions }: Actions & { days: AllEventsDay[]; sameDates?: boolean }) {
  return <div className={styles.list}>
    {days.flatMap((day) => {
      // The page's second month repeats the sample's dates as drawn, only the month changes.
      const base = dayFrom(sameDates ? day.inDays - 30 : day.inDays)
      const date = sameDates ? new Date(base.getFullYear(), base.getMonth() + 1, base.getDate()) : base
      const weekday = (sameDates ? base : date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'short' })
      return day.items.map((item, at) => <div key={`${day.inDays}-${item.id}`} className={styles.row}>
        <div className={styles.date} aria-hidden={at > 0 || undefined} data-spacer={at > 0 || undefined}
          aria-label={at === 0 ? date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }) : undefined}>
          <span className={styles.weekday}>{weekday}</span>
          <span className={styles.day}>{date.getDate()}</span>
        </div>
        <EventCard item={sameDates ? { ...item, live: false } : item} {...actions} />
      </div>)
    })}
  </div>
}

function EventCard({ item, expiryLabel, compact, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: Actions & { item: AllEventsItem; expiryLabel?: string; compact?: boolean }) {
  const head = <div className={styles.head}>
    {item.live ? <span className={styles.live} role="img" aria-label={t('allEvents.live')} /> : item.flag ? <span className={styles.flag}><img src={item.image} alt="" /></span> : <img src={item.image} alt="" className={styles.art} />}
    <div className={styles.text} data-event={item.kind === 'event' || undefined}>
      <p className={styles.name}>{item.name}</p>
      <div className={styles.tags}>
        <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" className={styles.greyTag}>{item.kind === 'expiry' ? (expiryLabel ?? t('eventsToday.expiry')) : t('eventsToday.event')}</Tag>
        {item.tag && (() => {
          const icon = <Icon icon={item.tag.arrow === 'up' ? msTrendingUp : msTrendingDown} />
          return <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" color={item.tag.tone}
            iconLeft={item.tag.side === 'left' ? icon : undefined} iconRight={item.tag.side === 'right' ? icon : undefined}>
            {t(`allEvents.${item.tag.kind}`, { trend: t(`allEvents.trend.${item.tag.trend}`) })}
          </Tag>
        })()}
      </div>
    </div>
    {item.actions && <RowActions name={item.name} chain compact={compact} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />}
  </div>
  return <Card padding="none" className={styles.card}>
    <div className={styles.body} data-note={Boolean(item.note) || undefined} data-tappable={item.kind === 'expiry' || undefined}
      onClick={item.kind === 'expiry' ? onAsset : undefined}>
      {head}
      {item.note && <div className={styles.footer}>
        <span className={styles.rule} />
        <div className={styles.note}>
          <Icon icon={msWbIncandescentFill} size={16} className={styles.bulb} />
          <span className={styles.noteLine}>
            <span>{t(`allEvents.note.${item.note.kind}`, { name: item.note.name })}</span>
            <span className={styles.move} data-up={item.note.change >= 0}>
              <Icon icon={item.note.change >= 0 ? msArrowDropUp : msArrowDropDown} size={12} />
              {Math.abs(item.note.change).toFixed(1)}%
            </span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>}
    </div>
  </Card>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/CalendarWeekView.tsx`

```tsx
/**
 * ARCHIVED 2026-11-24 — not in the app. The Commodity calendar page (fno-38) with a day / week view switch: on the right
 * of every month title, an L3 pill-group Tabs (small, two icon-only pills — Day `msViewAgenda`, Week `msCalendarViewWeek`);
 * the whole switch is one tap target that flips to the other view (one choice for the whole page, every tab and month).
 * Week view: each month as the home's V4 day picker (weeks split by "NEXT WEEK" / "7 DEC" pills), each month picking its
 * first day so its cards show; today (`markToday`) is dark only while it is the picked day. The page went back to the
 * day list only.
 * To bring it back, in ExpiryTimeline:
 * - `const [view, setView] = useState<CalendarView>('day')` in ExpiryTimeline, passed to every CalendarBody with `onView`;
 * - in the month head, `<Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" align="center" justify="between">` holding the
 *   SectionHeader and `<CalendarViewSwitch view={view} onView={onView} />`;
 * - under it, `view === 'week' ? <CalendarWeekMonth days={m.days} … /> : <Stack gap="32">…day list…</Stack>`.
 * The CSS (`.calendarViewSwitch`, `.dayPickerDay[data-today]`) and the copy (`expiryAll.view*`) are still in place.
 */
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msCalendarViewWeek, msViewAgenda } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import type { ExpiryDay } from '../data'
import { DayPicker } from './ExpiringDayPicker'
import styles from '../components/Commodities.module.css'

/** Day view: every day listed under its month. Week view: each month as the home's V4 day picker. */
export type CalendarView = 'day' | 'week'

/** The day / week switch on the right of a month title; a tap anywhere on it flips to the other view. */
export function CalendarViewSwitch({ view, onView }: { view: CalendarView; onView: (view: CalendarView) => void }) {
  return <div className={styles.calendarViewSwitch} onClick={() => onView(view === 'day' ? 'week' : 'day')}>
    <Tabs appearance="pill-group" size="sm" aria-label={t('expiryAll.view')} value={view} onChange={() => {}}
      items={[
        { value: 'day', label: t('expiryAll.view.day'), hideLabel: true, iconLeft: <Icon icon={msViewAgenda} size={16} /> },
        { value: 'week', label: t('expiryAll.view.week'), hideLabel: true, iconLeft: <Icon icon={msCalendarViewWeek} size={16} /> },
      ]} />
  </div>
}

/** One month in week view: its days as the V4 day picker, the picked day's cards under it. */
export function CalendarWeekMonth({ days, showKind, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { days: ExpiryDay[]; showKind: boolean; onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  return <Stack gap="16">
    <DayPicker days={days} markToday showKind={showKind} eventDetails onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
  </Stack>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/DayPickerByWeek.tsx`

```tsx
/**
 * ARCHIVED 2026-11-24 — not in the app. The Commodity calendar page (fno-38) in Expiring This Week version 4: the days
 * as week sections (Monday to Sunday), each titled with its range ("November 23 – 29"), with that week's day picker
 * (no week pills) and the selected day's cards; a 2 line edge to edge between weeks (`.weekSection`,
 * `--app-week-divider`). The page went back to the day list (dates on the left, one card per contract or event).
 * To bring it back: in ExpiryTimeline's CalendarBody, when `useFlowOption('fno', 'expiringVersion', 'v4') === 'v4'`,
 * return `<div className={styles.calendar}><DayPickerByWeek days={days} showKind={tab === 'all'} eventDetails … /></div>`,
 * and add 'fno-38' back to the option's floatOn (fno/index.tsx).
 */
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { dayFrom } from '../components/CalendarDay'
import { DayPicker, byWeek, todayInWeek } from './ExpiringDayPicker'
import styles from '../components/Commodities.module.css'

/** A week's title: its Monday to Sunday, month spelled out — "November 23 – 29", "November 30 – December 6". */
function weekTitle(week: number) {
  const monday = dayFrom(week * 7 - todayInWeek())
  const sunday = dayFrom(week * 7 - todayInWeek() + 6)
  const month = (date: Date) => date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'long' })
  const to = month(sunday) === month(monday) ? `${sunday.getDate()}` : `${month(sunday)} ${sunday.getDate()}`
  return t('expiring.weekRange', { from: `${month(monday)} ${monday.getDate()}`, to })
}

/**
 * The calendar page in version 4 (fno-38): the days split into week sections (Monday to Sunday). Each section has the
 * week as its title ("November 23 – 29"), that week's days as a row of date cards (no week pills — the title says which
 * week), and the card for the selected day under it; each week picks its own day (its first, to start). A 2 line runs
 * edge to edge between two weeks, 24 above and below it.
 */
export function DayPickerByWeek({ days, ...rest }: Omit<Parameters<typeof DayPicker>[0], 'weekPills'>) {
  return <Stack gap="24">
    {byWeek(days).map((w) => <section key={w.week} className={styles.weekSection} aria-label={weekTitle(w.week)}>
      <Stack gap="12">
        <SectionHeader title={weekTitle(w.week)} />
        <DayPicker days={w.days} weekPills={false} {...rest} />
      </Stack>
    </section>)}
  </Stack>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/EventsToday.module.css`

```css
/* Expiring This Week v5 · Day view Versions 2 / 3 (EventsToday.tsx), after Figma 7006:4490. */

/* Rows 16 apart; Figma's list sits 12 from the screen edge (the section's 16, less 4). */
.list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-16); margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-04)); }
/* Version 2: 16 more after the first row (the expiry), as drawn. */
.list[data-variant='plain']:not([data-week]) > .row:first-child { margin-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
.row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--l3-spacing-12); }

/* The time: “9:00” (Label 14) over “AM” (Description 12, secondary), centred in 48, 8 × 4 in. */
.time { box-sizing: border-box; flex: none; width: var(--l3-spacing-48); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-04); text-align: center; }
.list[data-variant='block'] .time { border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12); background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); }
.clock { font: var(--l3-text-label-14); color: var(--l3-content-primary); }
.ampm { font: var(--l3-text-description-12); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }

.card.card { min-width: 0; gap: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.name { margin: 0; font: var(--l3-text-label-12); color: var(--l3-content-primary); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
/* Figma's grey tag: L3 Tag neutral tertiary, its label in content-secondary (L3's neutral soft tag is content-primary — L3 gap). */
.greyTag.greyTag { color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }

.expiry { padding: var(--l3-spacing-12); cursor: pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.expiry:active { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); }
@media (hover: hover) { .expiry:hover { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); } }

.event { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-12); padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) 0; }
.event[data-note] { padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-06); }
.eventHead { padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-12); }

/* The note: a hairline 16 in from each side, 6 above a 24 line (content 4 down, 12 in). */
.footer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-06); }
.rule { height: 1px; margin-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16); background: var(--l3-border-light); } /* 1px hairline */
.note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-08); min-height: var(--l3-size-24); padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-12); }
.bulb { flex: none; transform: scaleY(-1); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); } /* the bulb upright: Figma flips wb_incandescent */
.noteLine { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; font: var(--l3-text-label-10); color: var(--l3-content-primary); white-space: nowrap; }
.move { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font: var(--l3-text-heading-10); color: var(--l3-content-accent-error-default); }
.move[data-up='true'] { color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default); }

/* Pictures. Version 2: art 16 (a flag 12) inside the 24 L3 Avatar. Version 3: art bare at 20; a flag 15 in a 20 circle. */
.avatar.avatar { flex: none; }
.artIn { width: var(--l3-size-16); height: var(--l3-size-16); object-fit: contain; }
.flagIn { width: var(--l3-size-12); height: var(--l3-size-12); border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); object-fit: cover; }
.art { flex: none; width: var(--l3-size-20); height: var(--l3-size-20); object-fit: contain; }
.flagCircle { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: var(--l3-size-20); height: var(--l3-size-20); border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); overflow: hidden; }
.flagCircle img { width: var(--app-today-flag); height: var(--app-today-flag); border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); object-fit: cover; }
/* Figma: 6 between an event's name and its tags (L3 Stack has no 06 gap). */
.eventText.eventText { gap: var(--l3-spacing-06); }
/* A row's cards (the Week view: a day's contracts and events), 8 apart. */
.cards { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-08); }
/* Week view: the day block as Version 2's date — weekday (Description 12, secondary) over the date (Label 16). */
.time[data-day] .clock { font: var(--l3-text-description-12); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }
.time[data-day] .ampm { font: var(--l3-text-label-16); color: var(--l3-content-primary); }
.empty { margin: 0; font: var(--l3-text-description-12); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }
/* Version 3: a symbol avatar (Copper's “Cu”, L3 Avatar's smallest is 24) takes the bare art's 20 in the row, so names line up. */
.list[data-variant='block'] .avatar.avatar { margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-02)); }
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/EventsToday.tsx`

```tsx
// ARCHIVED 2026-11-26 — not in the app (user: keep only Expiring This Week Versions 6–8). Was Versions 1–5 of Expiring This Week / their calendar page; to bring one back, import it in CommoditiesFeed (or CommodityCalendar) and restore its option values in fno/index.tsx.
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msArrowDownward, msArrowDropDown, msArrowDropUp, msArrowUpward, msTrendingDown, msTrendingUp, msWbIncandescentFill } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { asTodayItem, eventsTodaySample, expiryCalendarAll, type TodayItem } from '../data'
import { RowActions, dayFrom } from '../components/CalendarDay'
import styles from './EventsToday.module.css'

/**
 * Expiring This Week version 5 — Day view, Versions 2 and 3 (Figma 7006:4490, “Events today”, 25 Nov). Today's list,
 * one row per time: the time on the left (“9:00” over “AM”, 48 wide), the card on the right (12 apart), rows 16 apart.
 * - `plain` (Version 2, Figma left): the time on the page (no block); pictures in a 24 L3 Avatar; 16 more after the
 *   first row.
 * - `block` (Version 3, Figma right): the time in a grey block (surface-secondary, radius 12); pictures bare at 20.
 * Card: an expiry — name (Label 12) over a grey “Expiry” tag, option chain + ScalpPro on the right. An event — name over
 * “Event” and its trend tag (“Bullish Trend” ↗ / “Bearish Trend” ↘) or the commodities it moves (↑ Gold, ↓ Crude oil);
 * with a note, a hairline (16 in from each side) and a footer line: a bulb, “In last bullish trend, Gold has moved” /
 * “Last time, Crude oil has moved” (Label 10) and the move, ▲ / ▼ in success / error (Heading 10).
 */
export function EventsToday({ variant, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { variant: 'plain' | 'block'; onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  // Day: one row per item, the time on the left ("9:00" over "AM").
  const rows = eventsTodaySample.map((item) => { const [top, bottom] = item.time.split(' '); return { key: item.id, label: item.time, top, bottom, items: [item] } })
  return <EventRows rows={rows} variant={variant} onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
}

/** How far ahead the Week view lists: this week (today and the 6 days after). */
const WEEK_DAYS = 7

/**
 * The Week view in the same layout (user, 25 Nov): a vertical list of the week's expiry days (only days a contract
 * expires; an event on one of them still shows), the day on the left as the time is in Day view — the weekday over the
 * date ("Fri" over "27"), plain or in the grey block — and that day's cards on the right, one per contract or event,
 * 8 apart. Contracts tagged “Options expiry” / “Futures expiry”.
 */
export function EventsWeek({ variant, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { variant: 'plain' | 'block'; onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  const rows = expiryCalendarAll
    .filter((d) => d.inDays < WEEK_DAYS && d.entries.some((e) => e.kind !== 'event'))
    .map((d) => {
      const date = dayFrom(d.inDays)
      const items = d.entries.map((e) => asTodayItem(e, e.kind === 'event' ? undefined : t(`eventsToday.tag.${e.kind}`)))
      return { key: String(d.inDays), label: date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }),
        top: date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'short' }), bottom: String(date.getDate()), items, day: true }
    })
  if (!rows.length) return <Card><p className={styles.empty}>{t('eventsToday.noneWeek')}</p></Card>
  return <EventRows rows={rows} variant={variant} onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
}

type Row = { key: string; label: string; top: string; bottom: string; items: TodayItem[]; day?: boolean }

/** The list: each row is the left block (time, or day) and its cards. */
function EventRows({ rows, variant, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { rows: Row[]; variant: 'plain' | 'block'; onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  return <div className={styles.list} data-variant={variant} data-week={rows[0]?.day || undefined}>
    {rows.map((row) => {
      return <div key={row.key} className={styles.row}>
        <div className={styles.time} aria-label={row.label} data-day={row.day || undefined}>
          <span className={styles.clock}>{row.top}</span>
          <span className={styles.ampm}>{row.bottom}</span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.cards}>{row.items.map((item) =>
        <Card key={item.id} padding="none" className={styles.card}>
          {item.kind === 'expiry'
            ? <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="12" align="center" className={styles.expiry} data-tappable onClick={onAsset}>
              <Picture item={item} variant={variant} />
              <Stack gap="04" className={styles.text}>
                <p className={styles.name}>{item.name}</p>
                <span><Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" className={styles.greyTag}>{item.tag ?? t('eventsToday.expiry')}</Tag></span>
              </Stack>
              <RowActions name={item.name} chain={Boolean(item.chain)} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
            </Stack>
            : <div className={styles.event} data-note={Boolean(item.note) || undefined}>
              <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="12" align="center" className={styles.eventHead}>
                <Picture item={item} variant={variant} />
                <Stack gap="04" className={`${styles.text} ${styles.eventText}`}>
                  <p className={styles.name}>{item.name}</p>
                  <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" align="center">
                    <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" className={styles.greyTag}>{t('eventsToday.event')}</Tag>
                    {item.trend && <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" color={item.trend === 'bullish' ? 'profit' : 'loss'}
                      iconLeft={<Icon icon={item.trend === 'bullish' ? msTrendingUp : msTrendingDown} />}>{t(`eventsToday.trend.${item.trend}`)}</Tag>}
                    {item.moves?.map((m) => <Tag key={m.name} variant="tertiary" size="sm" color={m.trend === 'up' ? 'profit' : 'loss'}
                      iconLeft={<Icon icon={m.trend === 'up' ? msArrowUpward : msArrowDownward} />}>{m.name}</Tag>)}
                  </Stack>
                </Stack>
              </Stack>
              {item.note && <div className={styles.footer}>
                <span className={styles.rule} />
                <div className={styles.note}>
                  <Icon icon={msWbIncandescentFill} size={16} className={styles.bulb} />
                  <span className={styles.noteLine}>
                    <span>{item.note.kind === 'trend'
                      ? t('eventsToday.noteTrend', { trend: t(`eventsToday.trendWord.${item.note.trend ?? 'bullish'}`), name: item.note.name })
                      : t('eventsToday.noteLast', { name: item.note.name })}</span>
                    <span className={styles.move} data-up={item.note.change >= 0}>
                      <Icon icon={item.note.change >= 0 ? msArrowDropUp : msArrowDropDown} size={12} />
                      {Math.abs(item.note.change).toFixed(1)}%
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>}
            </div>}
        </Card>)}</div>
      </div>
    })}
  </div>
}

/** The row's picture: in Version 2 inside a 24 L3 Avatar (16 art; a flag 12), in Version 3 bare at 20 (a flag in a 20 circle). */
function Picture({ item, variant }: { item: TodayItem; variant: 'plain' | 'block' }) {
  // No art (Copper, Zinc…): their symbol in a 24 L3 Avatar, either version.
  if (!item.image) return <Avatar size={24} initials={item.initials} className={styles.avatar} />
  if (variant === 'plain') return <Avatar size={24} className={styles.avatar}
    icon={<img src={item.image} alt="" className={item.flag ? styles.flagIn : styles.artIn} />} />
  return item.flag
    ? <span className={styles.flagCircle}><img src={item.image} alt="" /></span>
    : <img src={item.image} alt="" className={styles.art} />
}
```
