### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/ExpiringDayPicker.tsx`

```tsx
import { Fragment, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { ExpiringHeader } from '../components/ExpiringHeader'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { expiryCalendarAll, type ExpiryDay } from '../data'
import { CalendarEntry, dayFrom } from '../components/CalendarDay'
import parts from '../../components/HomeParts.module.css'
import styles from '../components/Commodities.module.css'

/** How far ahead the home's day row reaches: about a month. */
const DAYS_AHEAD = 31

/** Today's place in its calendar week (weeks run Monday to Sunday): Mon 0 … Sun 6. */
export const todayInWeek = () => (new Date().getDay() + 6) % 7

/** Days grouped by calendar week (0 = this week, 1 = next week …), in order. */
export function byWeek(days: ExpiryDay[]): { week: number; days: ExpiryDay[] }[] {
  const weeks: { week: number; days: ExpiryDay[] }[] = []
  for (const day of days) {
    const week = Math.floor((day.inDays + todayInWeek()) / 7)
    const last = weeks[weeks.length - 1]
    if (last?.week === week) last.days.push(day)
    else weeks.push({ week, days: [day] })
  }
  return weeks
}

/** The pill before a week: "Next week", then that week's Monday ("7 Dec") — short, so the turned text fits the row. */
function weekLabel(week: number) {
  if (week === 1) return t('expiring.nextWeek')
  return dayFrom(week * 7 - todayInWeek()).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })
}

/**
 * The day picker (Expiring This Week version 4, the default): the given days (only days that
 * have something, so every card leads somewhere) as a row of small date cards, scrolling sideways. Weeks run Monday to
 * Sunday; each week after this one starts with a thin grey pill, its text turned 90° (bottom to top, upper case, 8):
 * "NEXT WEEK", then the week's Monday ("7 DEC"). The selected day has a dark border on grey; the first day is selected
 * first (no count tag — removed 24 Nov). Under the row, that day's contracts and events, one card each (8 apart).
 */
export function DayPicker({ days, weekPills = true, markToday = false, showKind, eventDetails, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: {
  days: ExpiryDay[]
  /** The "NEXT WEEK" / "7 DEC" pills between weeks — off when the days are one week already (the calendar page's week sections). */
  weekPills?: boolean
  /** Today's card, when selected, inverted (dark fill, light text), as on the calendar page's day list — the calendar page's week view, not the home. */
  markToday?: boolean
  /** Tag each row with its kind (Options / Futures / Event) — when the days mix kinds. */
  showKind: boolean
  /** Events show their figures (previous / forecast / actual) — on the calendar page, not on the home. */
  eventDetails: boolean
  onAsset: () => void
  onOptionChain: () => void
  onScalper: () => void
}) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(days[0]?.inDays ?? 0)
  const day = days.find((d) => d.inDays === selected) ?? days[0]
  // The row's ends fade on a side with more to scroll to (data-more-before / -after → the CSS mask), checked on scroll and resize.
  const row = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const updateFades = () => {
    const el = row.current
    if (!el) return
    el.toggleAttribute('data-more-before', el.scrollLeft > 1)
    el.toggleAttribute('data-more-after', el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth < el.scrollWidth - 1)
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    updateFades()
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(updateFades)
    if (row.current) observer.observe(row.current)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [days])
  return <>
    <div ref={row} onScroll={updateFades} role="tablist" aria-label={t('expiring.days')} className={styles.dayPicker}>
      {byWeek(days).map((w) => <Fragment key={w.week}>
        {weekPills && w.week > 0 && <span className={styles.dayPickerWeek} aria-hidden>{weekLabel(w.week)}</span>}
        {w.days.map((d) => {
          const date = dayFrom(d.inDays)
          const active = d.inDays === day?.inDays
          return <button key={d.inDays} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={active} className={styles.dayPickerDay} data-today={(markToday && d.inDays === 0) || undefined}
            aria-label={date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' })}
            onClick={() => setSelected(d.inDays)}>
            <span className={styles.calendarWeekday}>{date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'short' })}</span>
            <span className={styles.calendarDay}>{date.getDate()}</span>
          </button>
        })}
      </Fragment>)}
    </div>
    {day && <Stack gap="08">
      {day.entries.map((c) => <Card key={c.id} padding="none" className={styles.calendarCard}>
        <CalendarEntry entry={c} showKind={showKind} eventDetails={eventDetails} onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
      </Card>)}
    </Stack>}
  </>
}

/**
 * Expiring This Week, version 4 — the day picker over the next month (contracts with option chain + ScalpPro, events
 * on one line). View all → the Commodity calendar (fno-38), the day list (one card per contract or event).
 */
export function ExpiringDayPicker({ onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper, onViewAll }: { onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void; onViewAll: () => void }) {
  return <section className={parts.contractSection} aria-label={t('expiring.title')}>
    <ExpiringHeader onViewAll={onViewAll} />
    <DayPicker days={expiryCalendarAll.filter((d) => d.inDays < DAYS_AHEAD)} showKind eventDetails={false} onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
  </section>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/ExpiringDayWeek.tsx`

```tsx
// ARCHIVED 2026-11-26 — not in the app (user: keep only Expiring This Week Versions 6–8). Was Versions 1–5 of Expiring This Week / their calendar page; to bring one back, import it in CommoditiesFeed (or CommodityCalendar) and restore its option values in fno/index.tsx.
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../../shared/prototype'
import { EventsToday, EventsWeek } from './EventsToday'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { entryTime, expiryCalendarAll, minutesOf, todaySample, type ExpiryEntry } from '../data'
import { CalendarEntry } from '../components/CalendarDay'
import { DayPicker } from './ExpiringDayPicker'
import parts from '../../components/HomeParts.module.css'
import styles from '../components/Commodities.module.css'

/** How far ahead the week view reaches: about a month (people don't look at expiries further out). */
const DAYS_AHEAD = 31

type View = 'day' | 'week'

/**
 * Expiring This Week, version 5 — no View all page: the header's Day / Week switch (an L3 pill-group Tabs, small, on
 * the right where View all was) changes what the section shows.
 * - Day (first): today only — one event and two commodity expiries (3 cards; topped up from the coming days as a
 *   sample when today has fewer, `todaySample`), as version 2's short calendar, but the grey block on the left holds the TIME it happens
 *   (an event's release time, a contract's expiry at the MCX close) instead of the date — "9:00" over "PM". Entries at
 *   the same time share a block (one card each, 8 apart); times 16 apart, earliest first. Nothing today → one line.
 * - Week: version 4's day row over the next month, but only the days a contract expires (an events-only day isn't a
 *   date here) — e.g. Wed, then Fri, then the "NEXT WEEK" pill. An event on one of those days still shows with it.
 */
export function ExpiringDayWeek({ onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>('day')
  // Prototype setting “Day view”: Version 1 = TodayByTime below; 2 / 3 = Figma's “Events today” (EventsToday), titled so.
  const dayView = useFlowOption('fno', 'dayView', 'v2')
  const figma = dayView !== 'v1'
  const figmaDay = view === 'day' && figma
  const listVariant = dayView === 'v3' ? 'block' : 'plain'
  const props = { onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }
  return <section className={parts.contractSection} aria-label={t('expiring.title')}>
    <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" align="center" justify="between">
      <SectionHeader title={figmaDay ? t('eventsToday.title') : t('expiring.title')} />
      <Tabs appearance="pill-group" size="sm" aria-label={t('expiring.view')} value={view} onChange={(v) => setView(v as View)} className={styles.expiringViewAll}
        items={[{ value: 'day', label: t('expiring.view.day') }, { value: 'week', label: t('expiring.view.week') }]} />
    </Stack>
    {figmaDay ? <EventsToday variant={listVariant} {...props} /> : view === 'day' ? <TodayByTime {...props} /> : figma ? <EventsWeek variant={listVariant} {...props} /> : <DayPicker
      days={expiryCalendarAll.filter((d) => d.inDays < DAYS_AHEAD && d.entries.some((e) => e.kind !== 'event'))}
      showKind eventDetails={false} {...props} />}
  </section>
}

/** Day view: today's entries grouped by time, earliest first. */
function TodayByTime({ onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  const today = todaySample()
  const times = new Map<string, ExpiryEntry[]>()
  for (const entry of [...today].sort((a, b) => minutesOf(entryTime(a)) - minutesOf(entryTime(b))))
    times.set(entryTime(entry), [...(times.get(entryTime(entry)) ?? []), entry])
  if (!times.size) return <Card><p className={styles.calendarExchange}>{t('expiring.noneToday')}</p></Card>
  return <div className={styles.expiryCalendarPreview}>
    {[...times].map(([time, entries]) => {
      const [clock, ampm] = time.split(' ')
      return <Stack key={time} direction="horizontal" gap="12" align="start">
        <Stack gap="00" align="center" className={styles.calendarDate} data-static aria-label={time}>
          <span className={styles.calendarDay}>{clock}</span>
          <span className={styles.calendarWeekday}>{ampm}</span>
        </Stack>
        <Stack gap="08" className={styles.calendarCards}>
          {entries.map((c) => <Card key={c.id} padding="none" className={styles.calendarCard}>
            <CalendarEntry entry={c} showKind eventDetails={false} showTime={false} onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
          </Card>)}
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    })}
  </div>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/ExpiringThisWeek.tsx`

```tsx
// ARCHIVED 2026-11-26 — not in the app (user: keep only Expiring This Week Versions 6–8). Was Versions 1–5 of Expiring This Week / their calendar page; to bring one back, import it in CommoditiesFeed (or CommodityCalendar) and restore its option values in fno/index.tsx.
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { MaskIcon } from '@l3/components/MaskIcon'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { ExpiringHeader } from '../components/ExpiringHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { inr } from '../../../../shared/data/format'
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../../shared/prototype'
import type { Contract } from '../../data'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { expiringThisWeek, type ExpiringContract } from '../data'
import scalper from '../../assets/scalppro.svg'
import { TrendBadge } from '../../components/TrendBadge'
import { trendLabel, trendSince } from '../sheets/TrendInfoSheet'
import parts from '../../components/HomeParts.module.css'
import styles from '../components/Commodities.module.css'

/** The commodity art on the left of each card — hidden for now (kept, not deleted). */
const SHOW_ART = false

/** The expiry line's day: Today, Tomorrow, then the weekday ("Thu"). */
function expiryDay(days: number) {
  if (days === 0) return t('expiring.today')
  if (days === 1) return t('expiring.tomorrow')
  const date = new Date()
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + days)
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'short' })
}

/** The card as a contract, for the contract sheet (Buy). */
const asContract = (c: ExpiringContract): Contract => c.kind !== 'future'
  ? { id: c.id, name: `${c.symbol} ${c.option}`, description: c.description, price: c.price, change: c.priceChange, volume: 0, side: c.option.includes(' PE') ? 'put' : 'call' }
  : { id: c.id, name: c.symbol, description: c.description, price: c.price, change: c.priceChange, volume: 0 }

/** The card's variant: the expiry line under the symbol and the left column's label (the option, or LTP for a future). */
const expiryLine = (c: ExpiringContract) =>
  c.kind === 'option' ? t('expiring.tag', { day: expiryDay(c.expiresInDays) })
  : c.kind === 'event' ? t('expiring.eventTag', { event: c.event, day: expiryDay(c.eventInDays), time: c.eventTime })
  : t('expiring.futTag', { date: c.expiryDate })
const priceLabel = (c: ExpiringContract) => c.kind === 'future' ? t('expiring.ltp') : c.option

/**
 * Expiring This Week — the Commodities tab's section between the commodity shortcuts and the chart: a sideways rail
 * of contracts whose options expire this week. Each card: the commodity with when its options expire (plain text,
 * "OPT Expiry Today" / "FUT Expiry 3 Dec"), the trend since when it started, the option's premium or the future's LTP
 * (left) and the margin per lot
 * (right), each a label over its value, then
 * View all opens the Upcoming expiries timeline (fno-38). The trend read-out (top right, with its i) opens the trend info sheet. ScalpPro and Buy in the card's action footer (no fill); the three parts sit 16 apart. A tap on the card opens the contract's asset page.
 */
export function ExpiringThisWeek({ onAsset, onContract, onScalper, onViewAll, onTrendInfo }: { onAsset: () => void; onContract: (contract: Contract) => void; onScalper: () => void; /** The trend read-out (Strong Uptrend / Bullish …, the whole top right) → the trend info sheet. */ onTrendInfo: (contract: ExpiringContract) => void; /** View all → the Upcoming expiries timeline (fno-38). */ onViewAll: () => void }) {
  // Prototype setting “Expiring card buttons”: off hides the whole ScalpPro + Buy footer.
  const showButtons = useFlowOption('fno', 'expiringButtons', 'on') === 'on'
  return <section className={parts.contractSection} aria-label={t('expiring.title')}>
    <ExpiringHeader onViewAll={onViewAll} />
    <div className={styles.expiryRail}>
      {expiringThisWeek.map((c) => <div key={c.id} className={styles.expiryItem}>
        <Card
          className={styles.expiryCard}
          onClick={onAsset}
          aria-label={`${c.symbol} ${priceLabel(c)}`}
          footer={showButtons ? <>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" fullWidth iconLeft={<span className={styles.expiryActionIcon}><MaskIcon src={scalper} /></span>} onClick={onScalper}>{t('chart.scalper')}</Button>
            <Button variant="primary" size="md" fullWidth onClick={() => onContract(asContract(c))}>{t('expiring.buy')}</Button>
          </> : undefined}
        >
          <Stack gap="16">
            <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="12" align="center">
              {SHOW_ART && <span className={styles.expiryLogo}><img className={styles.expiryArt} src={c.image} alt="" /></span>}
              <Stack gap="04" className={parts.grow}>
                <p className={styles.expirySymbol}>{c.symbol}</p>
                <p className={parts.description}>{expiryLine(c)}</p>
              </Stack>
              <TrendBadge trend={c.trend} label={trendLabel(c)} since={trendSince(c)} largeSince info={t('expiring.sinceInfo')} onInfo={() => onTrendInfo(c)} />
            </Stack>
            <div className={styles.expiryRule} />
            <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="12" justify="between">
              <Stack gap="04"><span className={styles.expiryLabel}>{priceLabel(c)}</span><Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" align="center"><span className={styles.expiryValue}>{inr(c.price)}</span><PriceChange value={c.priceChange} unit="percent" size="md" /></Stack></Stack>
              <Stack gap="04" align="end"><span className={styles.expiryLabel}>{t('expiring.margin')}</span><span className={styles.expiryValue}>{inr(c.margin)}</span></Stack>
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
        </Card>
      </div>)}
    </div>
  </section>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/ExpiryTimeline.tsx`

```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msApps, msCandlestickChart, msEvent, msTrendingUp } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { Screen } from '../../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { neighbour, useSwipeBetween } from '../../../../shared/ui/useSwipeBetween'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { expiryCalendar, expiryCalendarAll, type ExpiryKind } from '../data'
import { CalendarDay, dayFrom } from '../components/CalendarDay'
import styles from '../components/Commodities.module.css'
import flat from '../../flatCards.module.css'

type Tab = 'all' | ExpiryKind
const TABS: Tab[] = ['all', 'option', 'future', 'event']
const TAB_ICONS: Record<Tab, string> = { all: msApps, option: msCandlestickChart, future: msTrendingUp, event: msEvent }

const monthOf = (date: Date) => date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })

/**
 * fno-38 · Expiry calendar — View all on Expiring This Week (Commodities). All / Options / Futures / Events (flat tabs with icons, sticky, in the
 * Actionbar's bottom slot). The days run from today under a month section header (L3 SectionHeader, content-primary: "Nov 2026", repeated when the month turns):
 * on the left one grey block (surface-secondary) holding the weekday over the date (today inverted on the calendar page — dark fill, light text — not marked on the home), on the right one card with that day's contracts — one day can hold
 * several, split by hairlines. Scrolling, the month header sticks at the top until the next month's pushes it out, and
 * each day's date block sticks under it for as long as that day's card is in view. A row is only the contract's name with two flat (no shadow) icon
 * buttons, centred vertically, the row 12 in from every side: options get option chain (→ option chain page) then ScalpPro (→ Scalper);
 * Changing tab slides the body with it (tap: the new tab's body slides in from its side; swipe left / right on the body drags it
 * to the next / previous tab, rubber-band at the ends — shared useSwipeBetween).
 * futures ScalpPro only; events show everything upfront (time IST, previous / forecast / actual, one arrow tag per commodity it moves → asset page), no buttons. All tags each row with its kind. Cards are flat (border, no shadow).
 */
export function ExpiryTimeline({ onBack, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { onBack: () => void; onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('all')
  // The tab being tapped, so the tabs answer at once while the body is still sliding.
  const [tapped, setTapped] = useState<Tab | null>(null)
  // The body slides with the tabs (the shared useSwipeBetween, like Market's tabs and the stocks theme page): the tab
  // next door's body sits just off-screen on either side, so a swipe drags it into view and a tap slides it across.
  const body = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const comingFrom = useRef<1 | -1 | 0>(0)
  const swipe = useSwipeBetween({
    page: tab,
    canGo: (direction) => neighbour(TABS, tab, direction) !== null,
    onSwitch: (direction) => { const next = neighbour(TABS, tab, direction); if (next) { setTab(next); setTapped(null) } },
    slides: () => (body.current ? [body.current] : []),
    fades: () => [],
  })
  // A tap on a tab. Next door: the same slide as a swipe. Further away: it slides straight in from its side.
  const pick = (next: Tab) => {
    const step = TABS.indexOf(next) - TABS.indexOf(tab)
    if (!step || next === tapped) return
    setTapped(next)
    if (Math.abs(step) === 1) return swipe.go(step as 1 | -1, () => { setTab(next); setTapped(null) })
    comingFrom.current = step > 0 ? 1 : -1
    setTab(next)
    setTapped(null)
  }
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const from = comingFrom.current
    comingFrom.current = 0
    const el = body.current
    if (!from || !el || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return
    el.animate([{ translate: `${from * el.offsetWidth}px 0` }, { translate: '0 0' }], { duration: 280, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)' })
  }, [tab])
  const props = { onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }
  return <Screen className={flat.flatCards} top={<Actionbar title={t('expiryAll.title')} onBack={onBack} backLabel={t('lot.back')}
    bottom={<Tabs aria-label={t('expiryAll.filter')} value={tapped ?? tab} onChange={(v) => pick(v as Tab)}
      items={TABS.map((value) => ({ value, label: t(`expiryAll.tab.${value}`), iconLeft: <Icon icon={TAB_ICONS[value]} size={16} /> }))} />} />}>
    <div className={styles.calendarViewport}>
      <div ref={(el) => { body.current = el; swipe.bind(el) }} className={styles.calendarTrack}>
        {/* Keyed by tab: the body that slides in stays the same once it becomes the current one. */}
        {[neighbour(TABS, tab, -1), tab, neighbour(TABS, tab, 1)].map((panelTab, at) => panelTab && (
          <div key={panelTab} className={styles.calendarPanel} data-side={['before', 'current', 'after'][at]} inert={at !== 1} aria-hidden={at !== 1 || undefined}>
            <CalendarBody tab={panelTab} {...props} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  </Screen>
}

/** One tab's days, grouped by month. */
function CalendarBody({ tab, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { tab: Tab; onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  const days = tab === 'all' ? expiryCalendarAll : expiryCalendar[tab]
  // The days grouped by month ("Nov 2026", "Dec 2026"), in order.
  const months: { month: string; days: typeof days }[] = []
  for (const day of days) {
    const month = monthOf(dayFrom(day.inDays))
    if (months.at(-1)?.month === month) months.at(-1)!.days.push(day)
    else months.push({ month, days: [day] })
  }
  // The sticky date blocks stop just under the sticky month header: measure its height once it's drawn.
  const headRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [headHeight, setHeadHeight] = useState(0)
  useLayoutEffect(() => { setHeadHeight(headRef.current?.offsetHeight ?? 0) }, [tab])
  return <div className={styles.calendar} style={{ '--calendar-head': `${headHeight}px` } as CSSProperties}>
    {months.map((m, mi) => <section key={m.month} className={styles.calendarMonth} aria-label={m.month}>
      {/* Sticky: the month stays at the top until the next month's header pushes it out. (The day / week view switch
          on its right is archived: commodities/archive/CalendarWeekView.tsx.) */}
      <div ref={mi === 0 ? headRef : undefined} className={styles.calendarMonthHead}><SectionHeader title={m.month} /></div>
      {/* 32 between two days (no line). */}
      <Stack gap="32">
        {m.days.map((day) => <CalendarDay key={day.inDays} day={day} showKind={tab === 'all'} separate onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />)}
      </Stack>
    </section>)}
  </div>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/archive/expiryPreviewSamples.ts`

```ts
/**
 * ARCHIVED 2026-11-24 — not in the app. The prototype setting "Calendar days" (F&O, Commodities) let the home's
 * Expiring This Week show sample weeks instead of the real MCX calendar: 3 today, 2 today · 1 tomorrow, 1 a day. Only
 * the real data is shown now. Nothing imports this file.
 * To bring it back: import `expiryPreviewSamples` in ExpiringCalendar / ExpiringCalendarCard, read
 * `useFlowOption('fno', 'expiringDays', 'real')` and pass `expiryPreviewSamples[sample]` to `expiryPreview(3, …)`, and
 * add the option to fno/index.tsx: { id: 'expiringDays', group: 'Commodities', label: 'Calendar days', values: [real
 * "Real week", calendar "3 today", split "2 today · 1 tomorrow", spread "1 a day"], default: 'real', floatOn:
 * ['fno-08', 'fno-09', 'fno-10', 'fno-38'] }.
 */
import { contracts, expiryCalendar, expiryCalendarAll, type ExpiryDay } from '../data'

/**
 * Prototype: how the home's short calendar (Expiring This Week v2 / v3) looks when the week splits differently — the
 * setting “Calendar days”. Sample weeks: the first two days hold only option / future contracts, an event comes on the
 * third day only. `calendar` = 3 today (all contracts); `split` = 2 today + 1 tomorrow; `spread` = 1 a day, so the
 * third row is the event. The calendar page (fno-38) keeps the real calendar.
 */
export type ExpiryPreviewSample = 'real' | 'calendar' | 'split' | 'spread'
const crudeStock = expiryCalendar.event.flatMap((d) => d.entries).find((e) => e.name === 'EIA crude oil inventories')!
export const expiryPreviewSamples: Record<ExpiryPreviewSample, ExpiryDay[]> = {
  real: expiryCalendarAll, // the real MCX calendar (default)
  calendar: [
    { inDays: 0, entries: [...contracts('option', ['Gold Mini', 'Crude Oil Mini']), ...contracts('future', ['Natural Gas'])] },
    { inDays: 1, entries: contracts('option', ['Natural Gas']) },
    { inDays: 2, entries: [crudeStock] },
  ],
  split: [
    { inDays: 0, entries: [...contracts('option', ['Gold Mini']), ...contracts('future', ['Crude Oil Mini'])] },
    { inDays: 1, entries: [...contracts('option', ['Natural Gas']), ...contracts('future', ['Natural Gas Mini'])] },
    { inDays: 2, entries: [crudeStock] },
  ],
  spread: [
    { inDays: 0, entries: contracts('option', ['Gold Mini']) },
    { inDays: 1, entries: contracts('future', ['Natural Gas Mini']) },
    { inDays: 2, entries: [crudeStock] },
  ],
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/components/AllEvents.module.css`

```css
/* Expiring This Week v6 · “All Events” (AllEvents.tsx), after Figma 7030:9072. */

/* One card per row, rows 16 apart; Figma's list sits 12 from the screen edge (the section's 16, less 4). */
.list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-16); margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-04)); }
.row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--l3-spacing-12); }

/* The day: weekday (Description 12, secondary) over the date (Label 14) in a grey block, 48 wide, 8 × 4 in, radius 12.
   A day's later cards keep the slot empty. */
.date { box-sizing: border-box; flex: none; width: var(--l3-spacing-48); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-04); border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12); background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); text-align: center; }
.date[data-spacer] { visibility: hidden; }
.weekday { font: var(--l3-text-description-12); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }
.day { font: var(--l3-text-label-14); color: var(--l3-content-primary); }

.card.card { flex: 1; min-width: 0; gap: 0; overflow: hidden; }
/* A card: 12 in; with a note 12 above, 6 below, the head 12 above the note. */
.body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-12); padding: var(--l3-spacing-12); }
.body[data-note] { padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) 0 var(--l3-spacing-06); }
.body[data-note] .head { padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-12); }
.body[data-tappable] { cursor: pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.body[data-tappable]:active { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); }
@media (hover: hover) { .body[data-tappable]:hover { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); } }

/* Head: art 20, 8 to the name (Label 12) over the tags (4 below for an expiry, 6 for an event; tags 4 apart). */
.head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-08); }
.text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--l3-spacing-04); }
.text[data-event] { gap: var(--l3-spacing-06); }
.name { margin: 0; max-width: 100%; font: var(--l3-text-label-12); color: var(--l3-content-primary); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-04); } /* wraps on narrow phones (360) rather than running under the buttons */
/* Figma's grey tag: L3 Tag neutral tertiary, its label in content-secondary (L3's is content-primary — L3 gap). */
.greyTag.greyTag { color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }

.art { flex: none; width: var(--l3-size-20); height: var(--l3-size-20); object-fit: contain; }
.flag { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: var(--l3-size-20); height: var(--l3-size-20); }
.flag img { width: var(--app-today-flag); height: var(--app-today-flag); object-fit: cover; transform: scale(1.125); } /* Figma 7035:9401: the flag art 15 in the 20 slot, its image 6.25% past each edge */

/* The note: a hairline 16 in from each side, 6 above a 24 line (bulb, Label 10, the move in Heading 10). */
.footer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-06); }
.rule { height: 1px; margin-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16); background: var(--l3-border-light); } /* 1px hairline */
.note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-08); min-height: var(--l3-size-24); padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-12); }
/* The bulb (flipped upright) sits 1 higher: its screw base hangs below the text baseline, so centred it reads low. */
.bulb { flex: none; transform: translateY(calc(-0.5 * var(--l3-spacing-02))) scaleY(-1); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }
.noteLine { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; font: var(--l3-text-label-10); color: var(--l3-content-primary); white-space: nowrap; }
.move { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font: var(--l3-text-heading-10); color: var(--l3-content-accent-error-default); }
.move[data-up='true'] { color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default); }

/* The View all page: months under a grey band (Heading 14, spaced 4; 8 above and below the text, 16 above on the first), the days 20 below, 16 in. */
.page { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-24); padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
.month { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-20); }
.band { margin: 0 calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16)); padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-16); background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); font: var(--l3-text-heading-14); letter-spacing: var(--app-month-band-tracking); color: var(--l3-content-primary); }
/* Only the first band, where the page starts, has 16 above its text. */
.month:first-child .band { padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
/* The band sticks at the top of the page while its month scrolls by; the next month's band pushes it out (its section ends). */
.band { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; }
.monthBody .list { margin-inline: 0; }


/* Version 7 (Figma 7035:14545): a date line per day, a time block per card. Day groups and cards 16 apart. */
.timedList { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
.timedDay { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
/* “25th Nov” (Label 12, spaced 1) and a hairline to the right edge, 4 apart. */
.dateLine { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-04); font: var(--l3-text-label-12); letter-spacing: var(--app-date-line-tracking); color: var(--l3-content-primary); white-space: nowrap; }
.dateRule { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--l3-border-light); } /* 1px hairline */
.timedRow { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--l3-spacing-12); }
/* The time: “09:00” (Label 12) over “AM” (Description 12, secondary), 48 wide, 8 × 6 in, radius 12, grey. */
.timeBlock { box-sizing: border-box; flex: none; width: var(--l3-spacing-48); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-06); border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12); background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); text-align: center; }
.timeClock { font: var(--l3-text-label-12); color: var(--l3-content-primary); }
.timeAmpm { font: var(--l3-text-description-12); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }
/* Version 7's page: the band grey as Version 6 (surface-secondary; user, 26 Nov — Figma has discover-light), 12 above on the first, 8 below; the days 24 below. */
.page[data-timed] .month:first-child .band { padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-12); }
.page[data-timed] .month { gap: var(--l3-spacing-24); }

/* Live event (Figma 7040:14546): in the art's 20 slot, a 16 green halo (indicator-up light) round an 8 dot (indicator-up),
   the halo blinking — it breathes out and fades, the dot steady. Still when reduced motion is on. */
.live { position: relative; flex: none; width: var(--l3-size-20); height: var(--l3-size-20); }
.live::before, .live::after { content: ''; position: absolute; border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); }
.live::before { inset: var(--l3-spacing-02); background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-light); animation: liveBlink 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.live::after { inset: var(--l3-spacing-06); background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-default); }
@keyframes liveBlink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.2; transform: scale(0.6); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .live::before { animation: none; } }

/* Version 8 (Figma 7042:19186): the date in a grey pill — surface-secondary, radius 8, 4 × 12 in, Label 12 spaced 2. */
.datePill { margin: 0; padding: var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-12); border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08); background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); font: var(--l3-text-label-12); letter-spacing: var(--app-date-pill-tracking); color: var(--l3-content-primary); white-space: nowrap; }
/* …and the time on the page: no grey block. */
.timedList[data-pill] .timeBlock { background: none; }
/* Its page: the month as plain text on the page surface (sticky), 16 above its days; month 16 / 24 in (top / bottom),
   the next 24 / 16; months split by a 2px divider (border-light) running edge to edge. */
.page[data-pill] .band { background: var(--l3-surface-default); padding: var(--l3-spacing-16) var(--l3-spacing-16) var(--l3-spacing-08); }
.page[data-pill] .month { gap: var(--l3-spacing-08); padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-24); }
.page[data-pill] .month + .month { border-top: 2px solid var(--l3-border-light); padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08); padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-16); margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16)); padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16); } /* 2px divider, as drawn */
.page[data-pill] { gap: 0; }

/* The section's title in Heading 16 (user, 26 Nov; Figma 7035:14545 / 7042:19186 draw it so). L3 SectionHeader's title is
   fixed at Heading 14 — no size prop (L3 gap). */
.header.header h2 { font: var(--l3-text-heading-16); }

/* Version 5 · Timeline (TimelineDays, Figma 7076:26456): a node per card on one vertical line; cards 16 apart. */
.timeline { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
/* Option 1 starts 8 from the screen edge (the section's 16, less 8). */
.timeline[data-option='one'] { margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08)); }
/* A row: [time 56 · 8] · rail · the card. Where the node sits down the row (its centre): Option 1 level with the time
   (20 down; 30 under a day label: 8 + label 12 + 2 + half the time's 16), Option 2 the card's middle. */
.tlRow { --tl-node: var(--l3-spacing-20); display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: var(--l3-spacing-12); }
.tlRow[data-dated] { --tl-node: calc(var(--l3-spacing-08) + var(--l3-spacing-12) + var(--l3-spacing-02) + var(--l3-spacing-08)); }
.timeline[data-option='two'] .tlRow { --tl-node: 50%; gap: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
.tlRow > :last-child { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.tlTime { box-sizing: border-box; flex: none; width: var(--l3-spacing-56); margin-right: calc(var(--l3-spacing-08) - var(--l3-spacing-12)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: var(--l3-spacing-02); padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-12); text-align: right; }
.tlRow[data-dated] .tlTime { padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08); }
.tlDay { font: var(--l3-text-label-10); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }
.tlClock { font: var(--l3-text-label-12); color: var(--l3-content-primary); white-space: nowrap; }
/* The rail: 12 wide (Option 2: 20). The line is two halves per row — above the node (reaching up over the 16 gap) and
   below it — so each stretch between two nodes can be green or dashed grey; none above the first node or below the last. */
.tlRail { position: relative; flex: none; width: var(--l3-size-12); }
.timeline[data-option='two'] .tlRail { width: var(--l3-size-20); }
.tlRail::before, .tlRail::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: calc(50% - 1px); width: 2px; /* 2px line */
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(var(--l3-border-intense) 0 var(--l3-spacing-04), transparent var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-08)); }
.tlRail::before { top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16)); height: calc(var(--tl-node) + var(--l3-spacing-16)); }
.tlRail::after { top: var(--tl-node); bottom: 0; }
.tlRow[data-first] .tlRail::before, .tlRow[data-last] .tlRail::after { display: none; }
.tlRow[data-green-up] .tlRail::before, .tlRow[data-green-down] .tlRail::after { background: var(--l3-border-accent-indicator-up-light); }
/* What's coming: a grey 12 dot (surface-quaternary); the dashes border-intense. */
.tlNode { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: var(--tl-node); left: 50%; width: var(--l3-size-12); height: var(--l3-size-12); translate: -50% -50%; border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); background: var(--l3-surface-quaternary); }
/* Live: a green 12 dot in a 20 halo (indicator-up light) that blinks — breathes out and fades; still with reduced motion. */
.tlLive { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: var(--tl-node); left: 50%; width: var(--l3-size-20); height: var(--l3-size-20); translate: -50% -50%; }
.tlLive::before, .tlLive::after { content: ''; position: absolute; border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); }
.tlLive::before { inset: 0; background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-light); animation: liveBlink 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.tlLive::after { inset: var(--l3-spacing-04); background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-default); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .tlLive::before { animation: none; } }
/* The card: 12 in; art 20 and its text 8 apart, the buttons 12 to the right. */
.tlBody { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-12); padding: var(--l3-spacing-12); }
.tlBody[data-tappable] { cursor: pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.tlBody[data-tappable]:active { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); }
@media (hover: hover) { .tlBody[data-tappable]:hover { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); } }
.tlMain { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-08); }
.tlText { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--l3-spacing-04); }
.tlTags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-08); }
/* Option 2: the name (Label 14) and its tag 8 apart, over the day and time. */
.tlTitle { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--l3-spacing-08); max-width: 100%; }
.tlName { margin: 0; min-width: 0; font: var(--l3-text-label-14); color: var(--l3-content-primary); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.tlWhen { margin: 0; font: var(--l3-text-label-12); color: var(--l3-content-secondary); white-space: nowrap; }
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/components/AllEvents.tsx`

```tsx
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { EmptyState } from '@l3/components/EmptyState'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msApps, msArrowDropDown, msArrowDropUp, msCandlestickChart, msEvent, msSchedule, msTrendingDown, msTrendingUp, msWbIncandescentFill } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Screen } from '../../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { timelineEventsSample, type AllEventsDay, type AllEventsItem } from '../data'
import { RowActions, dayFrom } from './CalendarDay'
import parts from '../../components/HomeParts.module.css'
import styles from './AllEvents.module.css'

/*
 * Expiring This Week — the final version, V5 · Timeline (Figma 7076:26456 “Timeline view”, Option 1; user, 26 Nov). The
 * earlier versions (V1–V4) and the timeline's other option (V6, time in the card) are archived in
 * commodities/archive/ (AllEventsVersions, ExpiringDayPicker, ExpiryTimeline).
 */

type Actions = { onAsset: () => void; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }

/** Home shows the first 3 cards (user, 26 Nov); View all has every one. */
const HOME_CARDS = 3

/**
 * Commodities home: “Upcoming Events” (Heading 16) with View all (→ the Commodity calendar, fno-38), then the timeline's
 * first 3 cards.
 */
export function UpcomingEventsSection({ onViewAll, ...actions }: Actions & { onViewAll: () => void }) {
  return <section className={parts.contractSection} aria-label={t('upcomingEvents.title')}>
    <SectionHeader className={styles.header} title={t('upcomingEvents.title')} action={{ type: 'view-all', label: t('viewAll'), onClick: onViewAll }} />
    <TimelineDays days={firstCards(timelineEventsSample(), HOME_CARDS)} {...actions} />
  </section>
}

/** The page's filter tabs: flat tabs with icons in the Actionbar's bottom slot (sticky). */
type Tab = 'all' | 'option' | 'future' | 'event'
const TABS: Tab[] = ['all', 'option', 'future', 'event']
const TAB_ICONS: Record<Tab, string> = { all: msApps, option: msCandlestickChart, future: msTrendingUp, event: msEvent }

/**
 * View all (fno-38), the Commodity Calendar: the actionbar with the All / Options / Futures / Events tabs under it, then
 * each month in a grey strip (surface-secondary, “NOV 2026” Heading 14 spaced 4; sticky while its month scrolls by, the
 * next month's strip pushes it out) and its timeline below. A simple page: no status tags (Live, In 2 hours) — the
 * blinking node shows what's live. Events get the fuller card (Forecast tag + last-move note); expiries the timeline card.
 * Sample: the timeline's days, again the month after. A tab with nothing in it (Futures, in the sample) shows the L3
 * empty state — illustration, “No futures expiring soon”, a line on what shows up here, and Show all (→ the All tab).
 */
export function AllEventsPage({ onBack, ...actions }: Actions & { onBack: () => void }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('all')
  // The tab's cards: All, an expiry's contract type, or the events; days left empty drop out.
  const days = timelineEventsSample()
    .map((d) => ({ ...d, items: d.items.filter((item) => tab === 'all' || (tab === 'event' ? item.kind === 'event' : item.contract === tab)) }))
    .filter((d) => d.items.length)
  const month = (offset: number) => {
    const d = dayFrom(0)
    return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + offset, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }).toUpperCase()
  }
  return <Screen top={<Actionbar title={t('expiryAll.title')} onBack={onBack} backLabel={t('lot.back')}
    bottom={<Tabs aria-label={t('expiryAll.filter')} value={tab} onChange={(v) => setTab(v as Tab)}
      items={TABS.map((value) => ({ value, label: t(`expiryAll.tab.${value}`), iconLeft: <Icon icon={TAB_ICONS[value]} size={16} /> }))} />} />}>
    {days.length ? <div className={styles.page} data-timed>
      {[0, 1].map((offset) => {
        const monthDays = days.map((d) => ({ ...d, inDays: d.inDays + offset * 30 }))
        return <section key={offset} className={styles.month} aria-label={month(offset)}>
          <h2 className={styles.band}>{month(offset)}</h2>
          <div className={styles.monthBody}>
            <TimelineDays days={monthDays} sameDates={offset > 0} page {...actions} />
          </div>
        </section>
      })}
    </div> : <EmptyState key={tab} title={t(`allEvents.empty.${tab}`)} description={t('allEvents.empty.description')}
      action={<Button size="sm" onClick={() => setTab('all')}>{t('allEvents.empty.showAll')}</Button>} />}
  </Screen>
}

/** The days cut to their first `count` cards, in order; a day left empty drops out. */
function firstCards(days: AllEventsDay[], count: number): AllEventsDay[] {
  let left = count
  return days.map((d) => {
    const items = d.items.slice(0, Math.max(left, 0))
    left -= items.length
    return { ...d, items }
  }).filter((d) => d.items.length)
}

/** “25th Nov”. */
function ordinalDate(date: Date) {
  const n = date.getDate()
  const suffix = n % 100 >= 11 && n % 100 <= 13 ? 'th' : ['th', 'st', 'nd', 'rd'][n % 10] ?? 'th'
  return `${n}${suffix} ${date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short' })}`
}

/**
 * The timeline. Time on the left (“5:00 PM” Label 12, right-aligned in 56; a day's first time has the day over it —
 * “TODAY”, “27th Nov”, Label 10 secondary, 2 above), 8 to its node, 12 to the card; the list starts 8 from the screen
 * edge. A node per card, level with the time, on one line from the first node to the last, cards 16 apart. A live item's
 * node is a green dot (12, indicator-up) in a blinking green halo (20, indicator-up light); what's coming a grey dot (12).
 * The line is solid green from a live node to the next when that one is live too or starts soon, dashed grey otherwise.
 * `page` (View all): events in the fuller card, and no status tags on any card.
 */
function TimelineDays({ days, sameDates, page = false, ...actions }: Actions & { days: AllEventsDay[]; sameDates?: boolean; page?: boolean }) {
  const rows = days.flatMap((day) => {
    // The page's second month repeats the sample's dates, only the month changes.
    const base = dayFrom(sameDates ? day.inDays - 30 : day.inDays)
    const date = sameDates ? new Date(base.getFullYear(), base.getMonth() + 1, base.getDate()) : base
    const today = !sameDates && day.inDays === 0
    return day.items.map((item, at) => ({ item: sameDates ? { ...item, live: false, startsIn: undefined } : item, first: at === 0, today, date }))
  })
  // A stretch of line is green from a live node to the next when that one is live too or starts soon.
  const green = (i: number) => Boolean(rows[i]?.item.live && (rows[i + 1]?.item.live || rows[i + 1]?.item.startsIn))
  return <ol className={styles.timeline} data-option="one" aria-label={t('upcomingEvents.title')}>
    {rows.map(({ item, first, today, date }, i) => {
      const day = today ? t('upcomingEvents.today') : ordinalDate(date)
      return <li key={`${i}-${item.id}`} className={styles.tlRow} data-dated={first || undefined}
        data-first={i === 0 || undefined} data-last={i === rows.length - 1 || undefined}
        data-green-up={green(i - 1) || undefined} data-green-down={green(i) || undefined}>
        <span className={styles.tlTime}>
          {first && <span className={styles.tlDay}>{today ? day.toUpperCase() : day}</span>}
          <span className={styles.tlClock}>{item.time}</span>
        </span>
        <span className={styles.tlRail}>{item.live
          ? <span className={styles.tlLive} role="img" aria-label={t('allEvents.live')} />
          : <span className={styles.tlNode} />}</span>
        {page && item.kind === 'event'
          ? <EventCard item={item} {...actions} />
          : <TimelineCard item={page ? { ...item, live: false, startsIn: undefined } : item} {...actions} />}
      </li>
    })}
  </ol>
}

/**
 * The timeline card: art 20, 8 to the name (Label 12) over its tags 4 below — Options Expiry / Event (grey), plus Live
 * (green) or “In 2 hours” (yellow, clock) on home; option chain + ScalpPro (24 × 24) on the right. An expiry opens its
 * asset page.
 */
function TimelineCard({ item, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: Actions & { item: AllEventsItem }) {
  return <Card padding="none" className={styles.card}>
    <div className={styles.tlBody} data-tappable={item.kind === 'expiry' || undefined} onClick={item.kind === 'expiry' ? onAsset : undefined}>
      <div className={styles.tlMain}>
        <img src={item.image} alt="" className={styles.art} />
        <div className={styles.tlText}>
          <p className={styles.name}>{item.name}</p>
          <div className={styles.tlTags}>
            <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" className={styles.greyTag}>{item.kind === 'expiry' ? t('upcomingEvents.optionsExpiry') : t('eventsToday.event')}</Tag>
            {item.live && <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" color="profit">{t('timeline.live')}</Tag>}
            {item.startsIn && <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" color="warning" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msSchedule} />}>{t('timeline.startsIn', { hours: item.startsIn })}</Tag>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {item.actions && <RowActions name={item.name} chain compact onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />}
    </div>
  </Card>
}

/**
 * An event on View all: art 20, the name (Label 12) over “Event” (grey) and its Forecast tag (“Forecast: Bearish”, the
 * trend arrow), 6 apart; option chain + ScalpPro (24 × 24) on the right. Under a hairline the bulb note (“Last time,
 * Crude oil has moved ▼ 4.5%”). Tags wrap on a narrow phone rather than running under the buttons.
 */
function EventCard({ item, onOptionChain, onScalper }: Actions & { item: AllEventsItem }) {
  return <Card padding="none" className={styles.card}>
    <div className={styles.body} data-note={Boolean(item.note) || undefined}>
      <div className={styles.head}>
        <img src={item.image} alt="" className={styles.art} />
        <div className={styles.text} data-event>
          <p className={styles.name}>{item.name}</p>
          <div className={styles.tags}>
            <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" className={styles.greyTag}>{t('eventsToday.event')}</Tag>
            {item.tag && (() => {
              const icon = <Icon icon={item.tag.arrow === 'up' ? msTrendingUp : msTrendingDown} />
              return <Tag variant="tertiary" size="sm" color={item.tag.tone}
                iconLeft={item.tag.side === 'left' ? icon : undefined} iconRight={item.tag.side === 'right' ? icon : undefined}>
                {t(`allEvents.${item.tag.kind}`, { trend: t(`allEvents.trend.${item.tag.trend}`) })}
              </Tag>
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>
        {item.actions && <RowActions name={item.name} chain compact onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />}
      </div>
      {item.note && <div className={styles.footer}>
        <span className={styles.rule} />
        <div className={styles.note}>
          <Icon icon={msWbIncandescentFill} size={16} className={styles.bulb} />
          <span className={styles.noteLine}>
            <span>{t(`allEvents.note.${item.note.kind}`, { name: item.note.name })}</span>
            <span className={styles.move} data-up={item.note.change >= 0}>
              <Icon icon={item.note.change >= 0 ? msArrowDropUp : msArrowDropDown} size={12} />
              {Math.abs(item.note.change).toFixed(1)}%
            </span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>}
    </div>
  </Card>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/commodities/components/CalendarDay.tsx`

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Grid } from '@l3/components/Grid'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { MaskIcon } from '@l3/components/MaskIcon'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msArrowDownward, msArrowUpward, msEvent, msLink, msTrendingDown, msTrendingUp } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../../shared/prototype'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import type { ExpiryDay, ExpiryEntry } from '../data'
import scalper from '../../assets/scalppro.svg'
import styles from './Commodities.module.css'

/** The day `inDays` from today. */
export function dayFrom(inDays: number) {
  const date = new Date()
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + inDays)
  return date
}

/**
 * One day of the Commodity calendar: on the left the grey date block (weekday over the date, today ringed), on the
 * right one card with that day's entries split by hairlines (home v2), or one card per entry, 8 apart (`separate`, the calendar page). Used by the calendar page (fno-38) and the home's
 * Expiring This Week, version 2.
 * - A contract row: art, name (and its kind when `showKind`), option chain (options only) and ScalpPro icon buttons;
 *   the row opens the asset page.
 * - An event row: event icon, name (two lines), time; no buttons. Under it one tag per commodity it moves
 *   (an L3 Tag with an up / down arrow and the commodity; tap → asset page); with `eventDetails` also previous / forecast / actual above
 *   (the calendar page — the home keeps events to one line). No country, impact tag or why line. Not tappable.
 * `sticky` keeps the date block under the calendar page's month header while the day is in view.
 */
export function CalendarDay({ day, showKind, eventDetails = true, sticky = true, separate = false, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: {
  day: ExpiryDay
  /** One card per contract or event (8 apart) instead of one card for the day — the calendar page. */
  separate?: boolean
  showKind: boolean
  eventDetails?: boolean
  sticky?: boolean
  onAsset: () => void
  onOptionChain: () => void
  onScalper: () => void
}) {
  return <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="12" align="start">
    <CalendarDate inDays={day.inDays} className={styles.calendarDate} sticky={sticky} />
    {separate
      ? <Stack gap="08" className={styles.calendarCards}>
        {day.entries.map((c) => <Card key={c.id} padding="none" className={styles.calendarCard}>
          <CalendarEntry entry={c} showKind={showKind} eventDetails={eventDetails} onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
        </Card>)}
      </Stack>
      : <Card padding="none" className={styles.calendarCard}>
        {day.entries.map((c) => <CalendarEntry key={c.id} entry={c} showKind={showKind} eventDetails={eventDetails} onAsset={onAsset} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />)}
      </Card>}
  </Stack>
}

/** The date block: weekday over the date (today inverted on the calendar page — dark fill, light text — not marked on the home). The page / v2 draw it as a grey block; v3 as the card's left column. */
export function CalendarDate({ inDays, className, sticky = false }: { inDays: number; className: string; sticky?: boolean }) {
  const date = dayFrom(inDays)
  return <Stack gap="00" align="center" className={className} data-static={!sticky || undefined} data-today={inDays === 0 || undefined}>
    <span className={styles.calendarWeekday}>{date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'short' })}</span>
    <span className={styles.calendarDay}>{date.getDate()}</span>
  </Stack>
}

/** One calendar row — a contract (art, name, kind, option chain + ScalpPro, tap → asset page) or an event (see CalendarDay). */
export function CalendarEntry({ entry: c, showKind, eventDetails = true, showTime = true, onAsset, onOptionChain, onScalper }: {
  entry: ExpiryEntry
  showKind: boolean
  /** An event's time after its kind — off where a time column already says it (Expiring This Week v5, Day). */
  showTime?: boolean
  eventDetails?: boolean
  onAsset: () => void
  onOptionChain: () => void
  onScalper: () => void
}) {
    // Prototype setting “Event card”: Version 2 adds the event's trend (Bullish / Bearish tag on the right of its name)
    // and, at the card's foot, a gradient strip with how a commodity moved after the last release.
    const eventV2 = useFlowOption('fno', 'eventCard', 'v1') === 'v2'
    if (c.event) {
      // An event: everything upfront — there's no event page, so the row isn't tappable and has no buttons; each asset it moves is.
      const e = c.event
      const outlookUp = e.outlook === 'bullish'
      const stats = ([['previous', e.previous], ['forecast', e.forecast], ['actual', e.actual]] as const)
      return <Stack gap="08" className={styles.calendarRow}>
        <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="12" align="center">
          <Avatar icon={<Icon icon={msEvent} size={14} />} size={24} className={styles.calendarAvatar} />
          <Stack gap="00" className={styles.calendarText}>
            <p className={styles.calendarName} data-wrap>{c.name}</p>
            <span className={styles.calendarExchange}>
              {[showKind ? t('expiryAll.kind.event') : null, showTime ? e.time : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
            </span>
          </Stack>
          {eventV2 && e.outlook && <Tag variant="secondary" size="sm" color={outlookUp ? 'profit' : 'loss'} className={styles.calendarOutlook}
            iconLeft={<Icon icon={outlookUp ? msTrendingUp : msTrendingDown} />}>{t(`expiryAll.outlook.${e.outlook}`)}</Tag>}
        </Stack>
        <Stack gap="08" className={styles.calendarEventBody}>
          {eventDetails && e.previous && <Grid columns={3} gap="08">
            {stats.map(([key, value]) => <Stack key={key} gap="00">
              <span className={styles.calendarExchange}>{t(`expiryAll.${key}`)}</span>
              <span className={styles.calendarStat}>{value ?? t('expiryAll.due')}</span>
            </Stack>)}
          </Grid>}
          {/* What it moves, one tag per commodity (arrow = bullish / bearish); tap → its asset page.
              One row that scrolls sideways when they don't fit. */}
          <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" className={styles.calendarMoves}>
            {e.moves.map((m) => {
              const label = t(m.trend === 'up' ? 'expiryAll.bullishFor' : 'expiryAll.bearishFor', { name: m.name })
              // A small L3 Tag: up / down arrow (profit / loss colour) and the commodity; tappable.
              return <Tag key={m.name} variant="tertiary" size="sm" color={m.trend === 'up' ? 'profit' : 'loss'}
                iconLeft={<Icon icon={m.trend === 'up' ? msArrowUpward : msArrowDownward} />}
                role="button" tabIndex={0} aria-label={label} className={styles.calendarMoveTag}
                onClick={onAsset} onKeyDown={(ev) => { if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') { ev.preventDefault(); onAsset() } }}>{m.name}</Tag>
            })}
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
        {/* Version 2: the last release's move, in a strip across the card's foot (up / down tint fading to the right). */}
        {eventV2 && e.lastTime && <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="04" align="center" className={styles.calendarLastTime} data-trend={e.lastTime.change >= 0 ? 'up' : 'down'}>
          <span className={styles.calendarExchange}>{t('expiryAll.lastTime', { name: e.lastTime.name })}</span>
          <PriceChange value={e.lastTime.change} unit="percent" size="sm" />
        </Stack>}
      </Stack>
    }
    return <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="12" align="center" className={styles.calendarRow}
      data-tappable onClick={onAsset}>
      <Avatar src={c.image} initials={c.initials} size={24} className={styles.calendarAvatar} />
      <Stack gap="00" className={styles.calendarText}>
        <p className={styles.calendarName}>{c.name}</p>
        {/* When kinds are mixed, say which each row is. */}
        {showKind && <span className={styles.calendarExchange}>{t(`expiryAll.kind.${c.kind}`)}</span>}
      </Stack>
      {/* Option chain: options only — futures have no chain. */}
      <RowActions name={c.name} chain={c.kind === 'option'} onOptionChain={onOptionChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
    </Stack>
}

/** The row's two icon buttons: option chain (when `chain`) and ScalpPro. They stop the tap so the row doesn't open too. */
/** `compact`: 24 × 24 buttons (16 icon, 4 in), as the V5 timeline's Figma (7076:26456) draws them — L3's smallest is 32. */
export function RowActions({ name, chain, compact, onOptionChain, onScalper }: { name: string; chain: boolean; compact?: boolean; onOptionChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void }) {
  return <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" align="center" className={compact ? styles.compactActions : undefined}>
    {chain && <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" raised="none" aria-label={t('expiryAll.chain', { name })} iconLeft={<Icon icon={msLink} size={16} />} onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); onOptionChain() }} />}
    <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" raised="none" aria-label={t('expiryAll.scalper', { name })} iconLeft={<span className={styles.calendarIcon}><MaskIcon src={scalper} /></span>} onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); onScalper() }} />
  </Stack>
}
```
