### `src/flows/fno/order-pad/screens/TpslSheet.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react'
import { BottomSheetHeader } from '@l3/components/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Checkbox } from '@l3/components/Checkbox'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Select } from '@l3/components/Select'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tooltip } from '@l3/components/Tooltip'
import { msAdd, msDelete, msInfo } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { formatInr } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { Keyboard, KeypadSlide, typeKey } from '../../../../shared/ui/Keyboard'
import { Sheet } from '../../../../shared/ui/Sheet'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { PriceField, PriceFieldBox } from '../components/PriceField'
import type { TpslLeg, TpslOrder, TpslPosition } from '../data'
import styles from './TpslSheet.module.css'

type Leg = 'tp' | 'sl'
const LEGS: Leg[] = ['tp', 'sl']
const TICK = 0.05
/** Option prices move in ₹0.05 ticks. */
const toTick = (n: number) => Math.max(TICK, Math.round(n / TICK) * TICK)
/** Where a leg starts when it's turned on: TP 5% above the LTP, SL 5% below. */
const startPrice = (leg: Leg, ltp: number) => toTick(ltp * (leg === 'tp' ? 1.05 : 0.95))

type Typing = { orderId: number; leg: Leg; text: string | null; fresh: boolean }

/**
 * TPSL sheet over the F&O order pad, for an open (bought) position. Built like the stocks TP/SL sheet (us-stocks
 * TpslSheetB, 27 Nov, the user's call: "part of the same ecosystem"): the same header (title, Qty as the description,
 * the contract + LTP at the right), each leg one price card (name · Market ⇄ Limit · Switch, then "Trigger at" with the
 * typed ₹ price and a % Stepper), Est. profit / loss and Clear under it, and Apply in the dock.
 * F&O TP/SL is set per quantity, in whole lots: the position can be split into several orders ("Order 2" …), each with
 * its own lots, take profit and stop loss. Together they can't cover more than is held. TP must be above the LTP and SL
 * below it. Apply needs a valid quantity and a TP or SL on every order. Prices are typed from the app keypad.
 */
export function TpslSheet({ position: p, onApply, onClose }: { position: TpslPosition; onApply: () => void; onClose: () => void }) {
  const id = useId()
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<TpslOrder[]>([{
    id: 1, qty: p.qty,
    tp: { at: 'mkt', on: true, price: p.tp ?? startPrice('tp', p.ltp) },
    sl: { at: 'mkt', on: p.sl !== undefined, price: p.sl ?? null },
  }])
  const [lots, setLots] = useState(false)
  const [trailing, setTrailing] = useState(p.trailing ?? false)
  const [typing, setTyping] = useState<Typing | null>(null)

  const update = (orderId: number, change: Partial<TpslOrder>) => setOrders((all) => all.map((o) => (o.id === orderId ? { ...o, ...change } : o)))
  // A leg is set when it has a price; empty = not applied.
  const setLeg = (o: TpslOrder, leg: Leg, change: Partial<TpslLeg>) => {
    const next = { ...o[leg], ...change }
    update(o.id, { [leg]: { ...next, on: next.price !== null } })
  }
  const add = () => setOrders([...orders, { id: Math.max(...orders.map((o) => o.id)) + 1, qty: p.lotSize, tp: { at: 'mkt', on: true, price: startPrice('tp', p.ltp) }, sl: { at: 'mkt', on: false, price: null } }])

  const total = orders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.qty, 0)
  const over = total > p.qty
  const legError = (leg: Leg, l: TpslLeg) =>
    l.price === null ? undefined
      : leg === 'tp' ? (l.price <= p.ltp ? t('tpsl.tpLow', { price: formatInr(p.ltp) }) : undefined)
        : l.price >= p.ltp ? t('tpsl.slHigh', { price: formatInr(p.ltp) }) : undefined
  const valid = !over && orders.every((o) => LEGS.some((leg) => o[leg].price !== null) && LEGS.every((leg) => !legError(leg, o[leg])))

  // A tap in the sheet outside a price and the keypad closes the keypad (as on the stocks sheet).
  const typingOn = typing !== null
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!typingOn) return
    const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement
      const sheet = document.getElementById(id)?.closest('[role="dialog"]')
      if (!sheet?.contains(target) || target.closest('[data-price-field], [aria-label="Number keypad"]')) return
      setTyping(null)
      ;(document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.blur()
    }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onDown)
  }, [typingOn, id])

  // One key into the typed price: up to 2 decimals.
  const onKey = (key: string) => {
    if (!typing) return
    const o = orders.find((x) => x.id === typing.orderId)
    if (!o) return
    const base = typing.fresh ? '' : (typing.text ?? '')
    let text: string | undefined
    if (key === '.') text = base.includes('.') ? undefined : (base || '0') + '.'
    else if (/^\d$/.test(key) && base.includes('.') && (base.split('.')[1]?.length ?? 0) >= 2) text = undefined
    else text = typeKey(base, key, 8).replace(/^0+(?=\d)/, '')
    if (text === undefined) return
    setTyping({ ...typing, text, fresh: false })
    const price = Number(text) || 0
    setLeg(o, typing.leg, { price: price > 0 ? price : null })
  }

  /** One leg: one compact price card (name · Market ⇄ Limit, the typed price, a % Stepper), then Est. / the error and
   *  Clear under it. No on/off Switch (27 Nov, the user's call): a leg left empty ("--") isn't applied. */
  const legCard = (o: TpslOrder, leg: Leg) => {
    const l = o[leg]
    const name = t(`tpsl.${leg}`)
    const error = legError(leg, l)
    const est = l.price === null ? undefined : (l.price - p.avg) * o.qty
    // TP counts up from the average price, SL down from it.
    const pct = l.price === null ? null : Math.round(((leg === 'tp' ? l.price - p.avg : p.avg - l.price) / p.avg) * 1000) / 10
    const active = typing?.orderId === o.id && typing.leg === leg ? typing : null
    return (
      <Stack key={leg}>
        <PriceFieldBox error={Boolean(error)} surface="primary" className={styles.card}>
          <PriceField
            label={name}
            unit={{ label: t(`tpsl.at.${l.at}`), onSwitch: () => setLeg(o, leg, { at: l.at === 'mkt' ? 'lmt' : 'mkt' }), 'aria-label': t('tpsl.atSwitch', { leg: name }) }}
            price={{
              text: active && active.text !== null ? active.text : l.price === null ? '' : l.price.toFixed(2),
              placeholder: t('tpsl.none'),
              typing: active !== null,
              'aria-label': t('tpsl.priceLabel', { leg: name }),
              onPick: () => { if (!active) setTyping({ orderId: o.id, leg, text: null, fresh: true }) },
            }}
            stepper={{
              label: t('tpsl.pct', { leg: name }),
              value: pct ?? 0,
              min: 0, max: leg === 'sl' ? 99.5 : 500, step: 0.5,
              format: (n) => (pct === null ? t('tpsl.none') : `${n.toFixed(1)}%`),
              onChange: (n) => {
                setLeg(o, leg, { price: toTick(p.avg * (leg === 'tp' ? 1 + n / 100 : 1 - n / 100)) })
                if (active) setTyping({ ...active, text: null, fresh: true })
              },
            }}
          />
        </PriceFieldBox>
        {(l.price !== null || error) && (
          <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="between" align="center" gap="08" className={styles.estRow}>
            {error ? (
              <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{error}</p>
            ) : (
              <p className={styles.est}>
                {t(leg === 'tp' ? 'tpsl.estProfit' : 'tpsl.estLoss')}{' '}
                <span className={leg === 'tp' ? styles.up : styles.down}>{est === undefined ? t('tpsl.none') : formatInr(est, { sign: true })}</span>
              </p>
            )}
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className={styles.link} onClick={() => { setLeg(o, leg, { price: null }); if (active) setTyping(null) }}>{t('tpsl.clear')}</Button>
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Stack>
    )
  }

  // The stocks sheet's header: the qty as the description, the contract + LTP + change at the right.
  const header = (
    <BottomSheetHeader heading={t('tpsl.title')} headingId={id} description={t('tpsl.qtyHeld', { qty: p.qty })} trailing={
      <Stack gap="04" align="end">
        <span className={styles.contract}>{p.fullName}</span>
        <span className={styles.inline}>
          <span className={styles.contract}>{formatInr(p.ltp)}</span>
          <PriceChange value={p.change} unit="percent" size="sm" />
        </span>
      </Stack>
    } />
  )

  const footer = (
    <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('tpsl.title')}>
      <Button size="lg" fullWidth disabled={!valid} onClick={onApply}>{t('tpsl.apply')}</Button>
    </ButtonGroup>
  )

  return (
    <Sheet labelledBy={id} onClose={onClose} header={header} footer={footer}
      utility={<KeypadSlide open={typing !== null}><Keyboard decimal onKey={onKey} /></KeypadSlide>}>
      <Stack gap="16">
        {orders.map((o, i) => {
          const body = (
          <Stack gap="16">
            {(
              <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="08">
                <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
                  <span className={styles.orderTitle}>{t('tpsl.orderN', { n: i + 1 })}</span>
                  <span className={styles.muted}>{t('tpsl.avg', { price: formatInr(p.avg) })}</span>
                </Stack>
                {i > 0 && <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label={t('tpsl.removeLabel', { n: i + 1 })} iconLeft={<Icon icon={msDelete} size={16} />} onClick={() => setOrders(orders.filter((x) => x.id !== o.id))}>{t('tpsl.remove')}</Button>}
              </Stack>
            )}
            {/* Quantity: a stepper-only row, Quantity ⇄ Lots with the lot hint after it on one line. */}
            <Stack>
              <PriceFieldBox error={over && i === orders.length - 1} surface="primary" className={styles.card}>
                <PriceField
                  label={t(lots ? 'order.lots' : 'order.quantity')}
                  unitNote={t('order.lotHint', { lot: p.lotSize })}
                  unit={{ label: t(lots ? 'order.lots' : 'order.quantity'), onSwitch: () => setLots(!lots), 'aria-label': t('order.unitSwitch') }}
                  stepper={{
                    label: t(lots ? 'order.lots' : 'order.quantity'),
                    value: lots ? o.qty / p.lotSize : o.qty,
                    min: lots ? 1 : p.lotSize, step: lots ? 1 : p.lotSize,
                    onChange: (n) => update(o.id, { qty: lots ? n * p.lotSize : n }),
                  }}
                />
              </PriceFieldBox>
              {over && i === orders.length - 1 && <p className={`${styles.error} ${styles.estRow}`} role="alert">{t('tpsl.over', { total, qty: p.qty })}</p>}
            </Stack>
            {LEGS.map((leg) => legCard(o, leg))}
          </Stack>
          )
          // Several orders: each is one grey panel (L3 Card filled) holding its white cards, so an order reads as one
          // group (27 Nov, the user's call) — from the first order on, so adding a second doesn't change the look.
          return <Card key={o.id} variant="filled">{body}</Card>
        })}
        <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" fullWidth iconLeft={<Icon icon={msAdd} />} onClick={add}>{t('tpsl.add')}</Button>
        {/* Small, as in the live app: checkbox · label · ⓘ (the hint is in the tooltip). */}
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="04">
          <label className={styles.trailing}>
            <Checkbox checked={trailing} onChange={(e) => setTrailing(e.target.checked)} />
            {t('tpsl.trailing')}
          </label>
          <Tooltip content={t('tpsl.trailingHint')} placement="top">
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label={t('tpsl.trailingInfo')} iconLeft={<Icon icon={msInfo} size={16} />} />
          </Tooltip>
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    </Sheet>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/positions/Positions.module.css`

```css
/* F&O → Positions (fno-48 … 51). Layout is L3 Stack / Section / Inset; this file holds surfaces, type and the spans inside
   clickable cards (a clickable L3 Card is a <button>: block layout elements aren't allowed in it). */

/* ---- Total Returns (the grey top) ---- */

.top {
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

/* The white body under the grey top: rounded top corners, so the grey shows round them (live app). */
.body {
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24) var(--l3-radius-24) 0 0;
}

/* The card is information, not a button: separated by its surface only — no border, no shadow (ui-craft 0009). */
.totalCard.totalCard {
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.amount {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-24);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.amount[data-tone='up'],
.value[data-tone='up'] {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
}

.amount[data-tone='down'],
.value[data-tone='down'] {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
}

.label {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.value {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* The card's footer row, under a hairline. */
.footer {
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
}

/* This week's days: a 20 circle per day, tinted by that day's P&L (no trade: grey). */
.days {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.day {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-spacing-20);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-20);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-10);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

.day[data-tone='up'] {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-light);
}

.day[data-tone='down'] {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-down-light);
}

/* D · W · M · Y: square pills (1:1, as tall as the sm pill), not L3's 48 minimum. */
.periods.periods > [role='tab'][data-appearance][data-size] {
  min-width: 0;
  width: var(--l3-spacing-24);
  padding-inline: 0;
}

/* ---- Collapsed Total Returns (in the Actionbar's bottom slot once the card has scrolled away) ---- */

.collapsed {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-10) var(--l3-spacing-16);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-down-light), var(--l3-surface-default));
  animation: collapsedIn var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.collapsed[data-tone='up'] {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-light), var(--l3-surface-default));
}

.collapsed .amount {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-16);
}

@keyframes collapsedIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08))); }
}

/* ---- Lists ---- */

.title {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-16);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.list {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.grow {
  flex: 1;
}

/* At the top of the page the top bar has no bottom hairline; it appears once the page scrolls. L3 gap: Actionbar always
   draws it (no "line on scroll" option). */
.barAtTop.barAtTop {
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* ---- Orders header (in the Actionbar's bottom slot), as the stocks Portfolio → Orders header ---- */

.pillRow {
  padding-block: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

/* Open · History share the row equally (L3 width="fill" stretches the row but only a pill group's pills are equal). */
.equalPills.equalPills > [role='tab'][data-appearance] {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
}

.ordersHeading {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* Round filter button, as on Market. L3 gap: L3 Button has no round shape, so its radius variable is set to full. */
.roundButton.roundButton {
  --btn-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
}

/* ---- Position card ---- */

.cardTitle {
  overflow: hidden;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.sub {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.productName {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* The logo in a hairline ring, as the live app's card. */
.logoRing {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light);
}

/* Avg. price | LTP | Returns between two dashed hairlines (the live app's card). L3 gap: no dashed divider. */
.figuresRow {
  padding-block: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-block: 1px dashed var(--l3-border-light);
}

.figuresRow:last-child {
  padding-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom: 0;
}

/* Set or Manage TPSL · Exit Now: 8 at the sides instead of Medium's 10, so the label fits half a 360 card. */
.cardButton.cardButton[data-size] {
  --btn-padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

/* TP / TSL set: a green strip along the card's bottom (the live app's card). */
.tpslStrip {
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-success-light);
}

.tpslCheck {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

.tpslText {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---- Order card ---- */

.orderCard {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.orderRow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.orderName {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  min-width: 0;
}

.tags {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.figure {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---- Day groups (Orders): as stocks Portfolio → Orders (us-stocks orders/OrderCard.module.css) ---- */

.dayGroups {
  padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

.dayList {
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) 0 var(--l3-spacing-16);
  list-style: none;
}

/* An open day is a plain row in the page margin (no inset of its own), so the date lines up with the cards; a closed
   day is an L3 card cell (its own border and padding). */
.dayRow.dayRow[data-variant='plain'][data-size] {
  padding-inline: 0;
  padding-block: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px transparent; /* the card's 1px edge, clear, so it fades out rather than snaps */
}

.dayRow.dayRow {
  transition:
    padding var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard),
    box-shadow var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard),
    border-radius var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.dayChevron {
  transition: rotate var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.dayGroup[data-open] .dayChevron {
  rotate: 180deg;
}

.dayBody {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    grid-template-rows var(--l3-motion-duration-long) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard),
    opacity var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.dayBody[data-open] {
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  opacity: 1;
}

.dayBodyInner {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Order cards as the stocks ones: flat, a hairline edge instead of the raised shadow. */
.flatCard[data-interactive][data-variant] {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .collapsed { animation: none; }
  .dayRow.dayRow,
  .dayChevron,
  .dayBody { transition: none; }
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/positions/components/Cards.tsx`

```tsx
// F&O → Positions: one position card (static, with its Set / Manage TPSL and Exit Now buttons) and one order card (a clickable
// L3 Card that opens details, so its rows are spans in Positions.module.css — a clickable Card renders a <button>).
// Adapted from the stocks Portfolio cards (us-stocks orders/PositionCard + InOrderCard); a flow can't import another's.
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Grid } from '@l3/components/Grid'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tag, type TagColor } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msCheckCircleFill, msChevronRight, msEdit } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { getCompany } from '../../../../shared/data/companies'
import { formatInr } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { isExited, positionReturns, type FnoOrder, type FnoPosition, type OrderStatus } from '../data'
import styles from '../Positions.module.css'

const tone = (n: number) => (n > 0 ? 'up' : n < 0 ? 'down' : undefined)
/** ₹ with a sign on gains: +₹26.50 · -₹0.80. */
export const signedInr = (n: number) => formatInr(n, { sign: true })

/** A stock's logo, a commodity's picture, or the name's first letter (index options). */
function Logo({ name, symbol, image, size }: { name: string; symbol?: string; image?: string; size: 24 | 40 }) {
  const company = symbol ? getCompany(symbol) : undefined
  return <Avatar src={company?.logoUrl ?? image} initials={company?.initials ?? name.slice(0, 1)} size={size} />
}

/** A position: logo · name over "Call | 23 Dec 26 | Qty.75" · exchange over product; Avg. price | LTP | Returns between
 * dashed lines; an open one ends with Set TPSL (none set) or Manage TPSL (set) and Exit Now, and with TP / TSL set a
 * green strip along the bottom: "✓ TP (₹138.50) • TSL (₹124.00)" and "Qty 75/75 ›" (the live app's card, 27 Nov).
 * Static: it holds buttons. Medium buttons, not Large: two Large ones cut the label off in half a card (also the live
 * app's smaller size). */
export function PositionCard({ position, onTpsl, onExit }: { position: FnoPosition; onTpsl: () => void; onExit: () => void }) {
  const exited = isExited(position)
  const returns = positionReturns(position)
  const hasTpsl = !exited && position.tp !== undefined && position.tsl !== undefined
  const sub = [position.contract, t('positions.qty', { qty: position.qty })].filter(Boolean).join(' | ')
  return (
    <Card padding="none" aria-label={t('positions.card', { name: position.name, state: t(exited ? 'positions.state.exited' : 'positions.state.open'), returns: signedInr(returns) })}>
      <Inset paddingInline="12" paddingBlock="12">
        <Stack gap="12">
          <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="12">
            <span className={styles.logoRing}><Logo name={position.name} symbol={position.symbol} image={position.image} size={40} /></span>
            <Stack gap="04" className={styles.grow}>
              <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
                <span className={styles.cardTitle}>{position.name}</span>
                {exited && <Tag variant="secondary" size="sm" color="neutral">{t('positions.exited')}</Tag>}
              </Stack>
              <span className={styles.sub}>{sub}</span>
            </Stack>
            <Stack gap="04" align="end">
              <span className={styles.sub}>{position.exchange}</span>
              <span className={styles.productName}>{position.product}</span>
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
          <Grid columns={3} gap="08" className={styles.figuresRow}>
            <Stack gap="04">
              <span className={styles.label}>{t(exited ? 'positions.buyPrice' : 'positions.avgPrice')}</span>
              <span className={styles.value}>{formatInr(position.buyPrice)}</span>
            </Stack>
            <Stack gap="04" align="center">
              <span className={styles.label}>{t(exited ? 'positions.sellPrice' : 'positions.ltp')}</span>
              <span className={styles.value}>{formatInr(position.sellPrice ?? position.ltp ?? 0)}</span>
            </Stack>
            <Stack gap="04" align="end">
              <span className={styles.label}>{t('positions.returns')}</span>
              <span className={styles.value} data-tone={tone(returns)}>{signedInr(returns)}</span>
            </Stack>
          </Grid>
          {!exited && (
            <Grid columns={2} gap="08">
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" className={styles.cardButton} iconRight={<Icon icon={msEdit} size={16} />} onClick={onTpsl}>{t(hasTpsl ? 'positions.manage' : 'positions.setTpsl')}</Button>
              <Button variant="primary" size="md" className={styles.cardButton} onClick={onExit}>{t('positions.exit')}</Button>
            </Grid>
          )}
        </Stack>
      </Inset>
      {hasTpsl && (
        <Inset paddingInline="12" paddingBlock="08" className={styles.tpslStrip}>
          <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="08">
            <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
              <Icon icon={msCheckCircleFill} size={20} className={styles.tpslCheck} aria-label={t('positions.tpslOn')} />
              <span className={styles.tpslText}>{t('positions.tpsl', { tp: formatInr(position.tp!), tsl: formatInr(position.tsl!) })}</span>
            </Stack>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" iconRight={<Icon icon={msChevronRight} />} onClick={onTpsl}>{t('positions.tpslQty', { qty: position.qty })}</Button>
          </Stack>
        </Inset>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}

const STATUS_COLOR: Record<OrderStatus, TagColor> = { open: 'warning', executed: 'discover', cancelled: 'error', rejected: 'error' }

/** The order's own price: its average once filled, its limit while open, else at market. */
function orderPrice(o: FnoOrder) {
  if (o.price === undefined) return t('orders.market')
  return t(o.status === 'executed' ? 'orders.avg' : 'orders.limit', { price: formatInr(o.price) })
}

export function OrderCard({ order, onOpen }: { order: FnoOrder; onOpen: () => void }) {
  const status = t(`orders.status.${order.status}`)
  const side = t(`orders.side.${order.side}`)
  return (
    <Card className={styles.flatCard} onClick={onOpen} aria-label={t('orders.card', { side, name: order.name, status })}>
      <span className={styles.orderCard}>
        <span className={styles.orderRow}>
          <span className={styles.sub}>{`${order.product} • ${order.time}`}</span>
          <span className={styles.tags}>
            <Tag variant="secondary" size="sm" color={STATUS_COLOR[order.status]}>{status}</Tag>
            <Tag variant="secondary" size="sm" color={order.side === 'buy' ? 'profit' : 'loss'}>{side}</Tag>
          </span>
        </span>
        <span className={styles.orderRow}>
          <span className={styles.orderName}>
            <Logo name={order.name} symbol={order.symbol} image={order.image} size={24} />
            <span className={styles.cardTitle}>{order.name}</span>
          </span>
          <span className={styles.figure}>{`${order.filled}/${order.qty}`}</span>
        </span>
        <span className={styles.orderRow}>
          <span className={styles.figure}>{orderPrice(order)}</span>
          {order.tp !== undefined && order.tsl !== undefined && (
            <span className={styles.sub}>{t('orders.tpsl', { tp: formatInr(order.tp, { decimals: 1 }), tsl: formatInr(order.tsl, { decimals: 1 }) })}</span>
          )}
        </span>
      </span>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/positions/components/TotalReturns.tsx`

```tsx
// F&O → Positions: the Total Returns card on the grey top, and its collapsed one-line form that stays under the tabs once
// the card has scrolled away (live app screenshot 2). "Total Returns ⇕" switches the amounts between ₹ and % of what
// was bought; D · W · M · Y picks the period. Under a hairline: this week's days, hide amounts, P&L Analysis.
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Select } from '@l3/components/Select'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msChevronRight, msVisibility, msVisibilityOff } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { periodTotals, positions, weekDays, type Period } from '../data'
import { signedInr } from './Cards'
import styles from '../Positions.module.css'

export type Unit = 'inr' | 'percent'
const PERIODS: Period[] = ['D', 'W', 'M', 'Y']
/** What today's positions were bought for: the base for returns in %. */
const invested = positions.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.buyPrice * p.qty, 0)
const tone = (n: number) => (n > 0 ? 'up' : n < 0 ? 'down' : undefined)

export function formatReturns(n: number, unit: Unit) {
  if (unit === 'inr') return signedInr(n)
  const pct = (n / invested) * 100
  return `${pct > 0 ? '+' : pct < 0 ? '-' : ''}${Math.abs(pct).toFixed(2)}%`
}

type Props = {
  period: Period
  onPeriod: (period: Period) => void
  unit: Unit
  onUnit: () => void
  /** The week's days greyed out (their P&L colours hidden); the amounts always show. */
  daysHidden: boolean
  onDaysHidden: () => void
  onAnalysis: () => void
}

export function TotalReturnsCard({ period, onPeriod, unit, onUnit, daysHidden, onDaysHidden, onAnalysis }: Props) {
  const { unrealised, realised } = periodTotals[period]
  const total = unrealised + realised
  return (
    <Card surface="primary" className={styles.totalCard}>
      <Stack gap="16">
        {/* The label and the amount are one block; the period switch sits beside it, at its top (live app). */}
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="start" justify="between" gap="08">
          <Stack gap="08">
            <Select size="sm" subtle icon="swap" aria-label={t('positions.unit')} onClick={onUnit}>{t('positions.total')}</Select>
            <p className={styles.amount} data-tone={tone(total)}>{formatReturns(total, unit)}</p>
          </Stack>
          <Tabs appearance="pill-group" size="sm" className={styles.periods} aria-label={t('positions.period')} value={period} onChange={(v) => onPeriod(v as Period)}
            items={PERIODS.map((p) => ({ value: p, label: t(`positions.period.${p}`) }))} />
        </Stack>
        <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="between" gap="16">
          <Stack gap="04">
            <span className={styles.label}>{t('positions.unrealised')}</span>
            <span className={styles.value} data-tone={tone(unrealised)}>{formatReturns(unrealised, unit)}</span>
          </Stack>
          <Stack gap="04" align="end">
            <span className={styles.label}>{t('positions.realised')}</span>
            <span className={styles.value} data-tone={tone(realised)}>{formatReturns(realised, unit)}</span>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="08" className={styles.footer}>
          <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
            <Stack as="ul" direction="horizontal" gap="04" className={styles.days} aria-label={t('positions.week')}>
              {weekDays.map((d) => {
                const key = daysHidden || d.pnl === undefined ? 'positions.week.none' : d.pnl < 0 ? 'positions.week.loss' : 'positions.week.profit'
                return <li key={d.label} className={styles.day} data-tone={daysHidden || d.pnl === undefined ? undefined : tone(d.pnl)} aria-label={t(key, { day: d.label })}>{d.day}</li>
              })}
            </Stack>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label={t(daysHidden ? 'positions.show' : 'positions.hide')} aria-pressed={daysHidden} iconLeft={<Icon icon={daysHidden ? msVisibilityOff : msVisibility} size={20} />} onClick={onDaysHidden} />
          </Stack>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" iconRight={<Icon icon={msChevronRight} />} onClick={onAnalysis}>{t('positions.analysis')}</Button>
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  )
}

/** One line under the tabs: "Total Returns  -₹3,559.71" on a wash of the result's colour. */
export function CollapsedTotal({ period, unit }: { period: Period; unit: Unit }) {
  const { unrealised, realised } = periodTotals[period]
  const total = unrealised + realised
  return (
    <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="08" className={styles.collapsed} data-tone={tone(total)}>
      <span className={styles.label}>{t('positions.total')}</span>
      <span className={styles.amount} data-tone={tone(total)}>{formatReturns(total, unit)}</span>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

```ts
// F&O → Positions sample data (= the API contract): today's positions and orders, as in the live app's Positions tab
// (screenshots, 27 Nov 2026). Totals and pill counts are worked out from these lists, never typed in.
import crudeOil from '../commodities/assets/crude-oil.png'
import naturalGas from '../commodities/assets/natural-gas.png'
import goldMini from '../commodities/assets/gold-mini.png'
import silver from '../commodities/assets/silver.png'

export type Segment = 'equity' | 'commodity'
export type Exchange = 'NSE' | 'BSE' | 'MCX'
export type Product = 'Intraday' | 'Delivery'

export type FnoPosition = {
  id: string
  /** "RELIANCE", "NIFTY 25600", "CRUDEOILM 7700". */
  name: string
  /** Options and futures: "Put | 16 Dec 26"; a stock has none. */
  contract?: string
  /** A listed company's NSE symbol (its logo comes from shared/data/companies), or a commodity picture. */
  symbol?: string
  image?: string
  segment: Segment
  exchange: Exchange
  product: Product
  qty: number
  buyPrice: number
  /** Exited positions only. */
  sellPrice?: number
  /** Open positions only: the last traded price. */
  ltp?: number
  /** Take profit and trailing stop loss, when set on an open position (the card's green strip). */
  tp?: number
  tsl?: number
}

export const isExited = (p: FnoPosition) => p.sellPrice !== undefined
/** ₹ returns: (sell or LTP − buy) × qty. */
export const positionReturns = (p: FnoPosition) => ((p.sellPrice ?? p.ltp ?? p.buyPrice) - p.buyPrice) * p.qty

export const positions: FnoPosition[] = [
  { id: 'p1', name: 'NIFTY 25600', contract: 'Put | 02 Dec 26', segment: 'equity', exchange: 'NSE', product: 'Intraday', qty: 150, buyPrice: 127.2, ltp: 131.85, tp: 138.5, tsl: 124 },
  { id: 'p2', name: 'RELIANCE', symbol: 'RELIANCE', segment: 'equity', exchange: 'NSE', product: 'Intraday', qty: 1, buyPrice: 1393.8, sellPrice: 1393.0 },
  { id: 'p3', name: 'CRUDEOILM 7700', contract: 'Put | 16 Dec 26', image: crudeOil, segment: 'commodity', exchange: 'MCX', product: 'Delivery', qty: 10, buyPrice: 312.4, sellPrice: 338.9 },
  { id: 'p4', name: 'NIFTY 25700', contract: 'Call | 02 Dec 26', segment: 'equity', exchange: 'NSE', product: 'Intraday', qty: 150, buyPrice: 96.45, sellPrice: 82.1 },
  { id: 'p5', name: 'GOLDM FEB FUT', contract: 'Fut | 05 Feb 27', image: goldMini, segment: 'commodity', exchange: 'MCX', product: 'Delivery', qty: 1, buyPrice: 1_28_540, ltp: 1_28_912 },
  { id: 'p6', name: 'HDFCBANK', symbol: 'HDFCBANK', segment: 'equity', exchange: 'NSE', product: 'Intraday', qty: 12, buyPrice: 1004.65, sellPrice: 998.3 },
  { id: 'p7', name: 'CRUDEOILM 7600', contract: 'Call | 16 Dec 26', image: crudeOil, segment: 'commodity', exchange: 'MCX', product: 'Delivery', qty: 10, buyPrice: 244.6, sellPrice: 198.75 },
  { id: 'p8', name: 'SENSEX 84500', contract: 'Put | 04 Dec 26', segment: 'equity', exchange: 'BSE', product: 'Intraday', qty: 40, buyPrice: 212.3, sellPrice: 178.65 },
  { id: 'p9', name: 'NATGASMINI 340', contract: 'Call | 23 Dec 26', image: naturalGas, segment: 'commodity', exchange: 'MCX', product: 'Delivery', qty: 250, buyPrice: 14.2, sellPrice: 12.85 },
  { id: 'p10', name: 'SILVERM 92000', contract: 'Call | 26 Feb 27', image: silver, segment: 'commodity', exchange: 'MCX', product: 'Delivery', qty: 5, buyPrice: 1_812.5, sellPrice: 1_770 },
]

export const unrealisedReturns = positions.filter((p) => !isExited(p)).reduce((sum, p) => sum + positionReturns(p), 0)
export const realisedReturns = positions.filter(isExited).reduce((sum, p) => sum + positionReturns(p), 0)
export const totalReturns = unrealisedReturns + realisedReturns
/** The period the Total Returns card shows: Day · Week · Month · Year. */
export type Period = 'D' | 'W' | 'M' | 'Y'
/** Other periods' totals (sample): the week, month and year include today's. */
export const periodTotals: Record<Period, { unrealised: number; realised: number }> = {
  D: { unrealised: unrealisedReturns, realised: realisedReturns },
  W: { unrealised: unrealisedReturns, realised: realisedReturns + 6_412.35 },
  M: { unrealised: unrealisedReturns, realised: realisedReturns + 18_904.6 },
  Y: { unrealised: unrealisedReturns, realised: realisedReturns - 42_186.75 },
}
/** This week, Monday to Friday: each traded day's P&L sign (no trade yet = undefined). */
export const weekDays: { day: string; label: string; pnl?: number }[] = [
  { day: 'M', label: 'Monday', pnl: 2_840.5 },
  { day: 'T', label: 'Tuesday', pnl: -1_205.25 },
  { day: 'W', label: 'Wednesday', pnl: 4_777.1 },
  { day: 'T', label: 'Thursday', pnl: totalReturns },
  { day: 'F', label: 'Friday' },
]

// ---- Orders ----

export type OrderStatus = 'open' | 'executed' | 'cancelled' | 'rejected'
export type FnoOrder = {
  id: string
  /** The day group it sits in ("Today", "Yesterday", "24 Nov"). */
  day: string
  time: string
  product: Product
  side: 'buy' | 'sell'
  status: OrderStatus
  /** "NIFTY 02 Dec 26 - 25600 Put". */
  name: string
  symbol?: string
  image?: string
  filled: number
  qty: number
  /** Executed: the average fill price; open: its limit price; neither = at market. */
  price?: number
  /** Take profit and trailing stop loss set with the order. */
  tp?: number
  tsl?: number
}

export const orders: FnoOrder[] = [

  { id: 'o8', day: '24 Nov', time: '02:47 PM', product: 'Delivery', side: 'buy', status: 'cancelled', name: 'SILVERM 26 Feb 27 - 92000 Call', image: silver, filled: 0, qty: 5, price: 1_790 },
```

### `src/flows/fno/positions/screens/Positions.tsx`

```tsx
// F&O → Positions (fno-48 … 51): the F&O navbar's Positions tab, rebuilt from the live app (screenshots, 27 Nov 2026) on
// the stocks Portfolio → Positions page's patterns (us-stocks PortfolioScreen: Actionbar with underline tabs, grey top,
// position cards, Orders grouped by day). Positions and Orders are one page: switching only changes the content.
// - Positions: the Total Returns card and Market Indices (Zing + index cards, shared with F&O home) on the grey top;
//   Your Positions with Refresh and settings, segment pills with counts, a card per position. Once the card has
//   scrolled under the top bar, its one-line form stays in the Actionbar's bottom slot.
// - Orders: Open · History pills and All Orders · Filter (sticky, in the Actionbar's bottom slot), orders by day.
// Destinations not built yet (P&L Analysis, settings, Filter, a position's or order's details) open the explanatory sheet.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Aerobar } from '@l3/components/Aerobar'
import { Badge } from '@l3/components/Badge'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { EmptyState } from '@l3/components/EmptyState'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { Section } from '@l3/components/Section'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msAccountBalanceWallet, msFilterAlt, msBookmark, msKeyboardArrowDown, msRefresh, msSearch, msSettings } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { Screen } from '../../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { TopBarAction } from '../../../../shared/ui/TopBarAction'
import { FnoNav } from '../../components/FnoNav'
import { MarketIndices } from '../../components/Overview'
import { DetailSheet } from '../../sheets/HomeSheets'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import { isOpenOrder, orders, positions, type FnoOrder, type FnoPosition, type Period, type Segment } from '../data'
import { OrderCard, PositionCard } from '../components/Cards'
import { CollapsedTotal, TotalReturnsCard, type Unit } from '../components/TotalReturns'
import styles from '../Positions.module.css'

export type PositionsTab = 'positions' | 'orders'
export type OrdersView = 'open' | 'history'
type SegmentFilter = 'all' | Segment

type Props = {
  tab?: PositionsTab
  ordersView?: OrdersView
  /** Open scrolled down, the Total Returns card collapsed under the tabs (fno-49). */
  scrolled?: boolean
  onHome: () => void
  onFno: () => void
  onChain: () => void
  onScalper: () => void
  onSearch: () => void
  onWallet: () => void
  /** The top bar's watchlist button → the Watchlist page (market-11). */
  onWatchlist: () => void
  /** Set / Manage TPSL on an open position: the F&O order pad with the TPSL sheet open. */
  onTpsl: (position: FnoPosition) => void
}

export function Positions({ tab: initialTab = 'positions', ordersView: initialView = 'history', scrolled, onHome, onFno, onChain, onScalper, onSearch, onWallet, onWatchlist, onTpsl }: Props) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const card = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<PositionsTab>(initialTab)
  const [view, setView] = useState<OrdersView>(initialView)
  const [segment, setSegment] = useState<SegmentFilter>('all')
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>('D')
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState<Unit>('inr')
  const [daysHidden, setDaysHidden] = useState(false)
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false)
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [refreshed, setRefreshed] = useState(false)
  const [atTop, setAtTop] = useState(true)
  // The four screens are one page (group 'positions'): picking another in the preview keeps this page and moves its tab.
  useEffect(() => { setTab(initialTab) }, [initialTab])
  useEffect(() => { setView(initialView) }, [initialView])

  // The card collapses into the bar once its bottom has gone under the top bar.
  useEffect(() => {
    const body = root.current?.parentElement
    if (!body || tab !== 'positions') { setCollapsed(false); return }
    if (scrolled && card.current) body.scrollTop = card.current.offsetTop + card.current.offsetHeight
    const onScroll = () => {
      const bottom = card.current?.getBoundingClientRect().bottom ?? 0
      setCollapsed(bottom <= body.getBoundingClientRect().top)
    }
    onScroll()
    body.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => body.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [tab, scrolled])

  // The top bar's bottom hairline shows only once the page has scrolled (at the top it would sit on an empty edge).
  useEffect(() => {
    const body = root.current?.parentElement
    if (!body) return
    const onScroll = () => setAtTop(body.scrollTop <= 0)
    onScroll()
    body.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => body.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [tab])

  const pickTab = (next: PositionsTab) => {
    setTab(next)
    root.current?.parentElement?.scrollTo({ top: 0 })
  }
  const count = (s: SegmentFilter) => positions.filter((p) => s === 'all' || p.segment === s).length
  const shown = positions.filter((p) => segment === 'all' || p.segment === segment)
  const shownOrders = orders.filter((o) => (view === 'open' ? isOpenOrder(o) : !isOpenOrder(o)))

  // Laid out as the stocks Portfolio → Orders header: the pills 12 above and 8 below, then the list's name with the round
  // filter button (12 above and below), 16 at the sides.
  const ordersControls = (
    <Stack gap="00">
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00" className={styles.pillRow}>
        <Tabs appearance="pill" width="fill" className={styles.equalPills} aria-label={t('orders.views')} value={view} onChange={(v) => setView(v as OrdersView)}
          items={(['open', 'history'] as const).map((v) => ({ value: v, label: t(`orders.${v}`) }))} />
      </Inset>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="12">
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="08">
          <h2 className={styles.ordersHeading}>{t('orders.all')}</h2>
          <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" className={styles.roundButton} iconLeft={<Icon icon={msFilterAlt} />} aria-label={t('orders.filter')} onClick={() => setDetail(t('orders.filter'))} />
        </Stack>
      </Inset>
    </Stack>
  )

  return (
    <Screen
      top={
        <Actionbar
          className={atTop ? styles.barAtTop : undefined}
          title={t('positions.title')}
          actions={
            <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
              <TopBarAction icon={msSearch} label={t('positions.search')} onClick={onSearch} />
              <TopBarAction icon={msBookmark} label={t('positions.watchlist')} onClick={onWatchlist} />
              <TopBarAction icon={msAccountBalanceWallet} label={t('positions.wallet')} onClick={onWallet} />
            </Stack>
          }
          bottom={
            <Stack gap="00">
              <Tabs appearance="underline" aria-label={t('positions.sections')} value={tab} onChange={(v) => pickTab(v as PositionsTab)}
                items={(['positions', 'orders'] as const).map((v) => ({ value: v, label: t(`positions.tab.${v}`) }))} />
              {tab === 'positions' && collapsed && <CollapsedTotal period={period} unit={unit} />}
              {tab === 'orders' && ordersControls}
            </Stack>
          }
        />
      }
      bottom={<FnoNav value="positions" onHome={onHome} onFno={onFno} onPositions={() => pickTab('positions')} onChain={onChain} onScalper={onScalper} />}
      toast={refreshed ? <Aerobar floating type="success" heading={t('positions.refreshed')} onDismiss={() => setRefreshed(false)} /> : undefined}
      sheet={detail ? <DetailSheet title={detail} onClose={() => setDetail(null)} /> : undefined}
    >
      <div ref={root}>
        {tab === 'positions' ? (
          <Stack gap="00" className={styles.top}>
            <Section paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="16">
              <div ref={card}>
                <TotalReturnsCard period={period} onPeriod={setPeriod} unit={unit} onUnit={() => setUnit(unit === 'inr' ? 'percent' : 'inr')} daysHidden={daysHidden} onDaysHidden={() => setDaysHidden(!daysHidden)} onAnalysis={() => setDetail(t('positions.analysis'))} />
              </div>
            </Section>
            {/* The white body rises over the grey top with rounded corners (live app): Market Indices, then Your Positions. */}
            <Section paddingBlock="24" gap="24" className={styles.body}>
              <Stack gap="12">
                <Section paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00"><h2 className={styles.title}>{t('positions.indices')}</h2></Section>
                <MarketIndices onDestination={setDetail} />
              </Stack>
              <Section paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00" gap="16">
                <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="08">
                  <h2 className={styles.title}>{t('positions.yours')}</h2>
                  <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" iconRight={<Icon icon={msRefresh} />} onClick={() => setRefreshed(true)}>{t('positions.refresh')}</Button>
                    <Badge dot color="error" label={t('positions.settings')}>
                      <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msSettings} />} aria-label={t('positions.settings')} onClick={() => setDetail(t('positions.settings'))} />
                    </Badge>
                  </Stack>
                </Stack>
                <Tabs appearance="pill" size="sm" aria-label={t('positions.segments')} value={segment} onChange={(v) => setSegment(v as SegmentFilter)}
                  items={(['all', 'equity', 'commodity'] as const).map((s) => ({ value: s, label: t(`positions.segment.${s}`, { count: count(s) }) }))} />
                {shown.length ? (
                  <Stack as="ul" gap="12" className={styles.list}>
                    {shown.map((p) => <li key={p.id}><PositionCard position={p} onTpsl={() => onTpsl(p)} onExit={() => setDetail(t('positions.exit'))} /></li>)}
                  </Stack>
                ) : (
                  <EmptyState title={t('positions.empty.title')} description={t('positions.empty.text')} action={<Button variant="primary" size="sm" onClick={onFno}>{t('positions.empty.button')}</Button>} />
                )}
              </Section>
            </Section>
          </Stack>
        ) : (
          <Section paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00">
            {shownOrders.length ? (
              <OrderGroups key={view} orders={shownOrders} onOpen={(o) => setDetail(o.name)} />
            ) : (
              <EmptyState title={t('orders.empty.title')} description={t('orders.empty.text')} />
            )}
          </Section>
        )}
      </div>
    </Screen>
  )
}

/** Orders by day ("Today", "Yesterday", "24 Nov"), each opening and closing; the first starts open. Copied from the stocks
 * Portfolio → Orders day groups (us-stocks orders/OrderDateGroups — a flow can't import another's). */
function OrderGroups({ orders: list, onOpen }: { orders: FnoOrder[]; onOpen: (order: FnoOrder) => void }) {
  const days = [...new Set(list.map((o) => o.day))]
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(() => new Set(days.slice(0, 1)))
  const toggle = (day: string) => {
    const next = new Set(open)
    if (next.has(day)) next.delete(day)
    else next.add(day)
    setOpen(next)
  }
  return (
    <Stack gap="08" className={styles.dayGroups} aria-label={t('orders.list')}>
      {days.map((day) => {
        const isOpen = open.has(day)
        return (
          <section key={day} aria-label={day} className={styles.dayGroup} data-open={isOpen || undefined}>
            {/* As stocks Portfolio → Orders: closed, an L3 card cell (its own tile); open, a plain row with its cards under it. */}
            <ListCell {...(isOpen ? {} : { variant: 'card' as const, raised: false })} size="sm" className={styles.dayRow} label={day} iconRight={<Icon icon={msKeyboardArrowDown} className={styles.dayChevron} />} onClick={() => toggle(day)} />
            <div className={styles.dayBody} data-open={isOpen || undefined} inert={!isOpen}>
              <div className={styles.dayBodyInner}>
                <Stack as="ul" gap="16" className={styles.dayList}>
                  {list.filter((o) => o.day === day).map((o) => <li key={o.id}><OrderCard order={o} onOpen={() => onOpen(o)} /></li>)}
                </Stack>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        )
      })}
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Aerobar } from '@l3/components/Aerobar'
import { MaskIcon } from '@l3/components/MaskIcon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Screen } from '../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { user } from '../../../shared/data/user'
import { ContractSection, type Choose } from '../components/ContractSection'
import { Shortcuts, Watchlists } from '../components/Discovery'
import { FnoNav } from '../components/FnoNav'
import { Header } from '../components/Header'
import { Heatmap } from '../components/Heatmap'
import { UsBanner } from '../components/UsBanner'
import { Overview } from '../components/Overview'
import { TradingChart } from '../components/TradingChart'
import { ChoiceSheet, CreateWatchlistSheet, DetailSheet } from '../sheets/HomeSheets'
import { CommoditiesFeed } from '../commodities/components/CommoditiesFeed'
import { ContractPickerSheet } from '../commodities/sheets/ContractPickerSheet'
import type { Commodity, ExpiringContract } from '../commodities/data'
import { TrendInfoSheet } from '../commodities/sheets/TrendInfoSheet'
import { StrategiesFeed } from '../strategies/components/StrategiesFeed'
import type { Segment } from '../strategies/data'
import { watchlists, type Contract } from '../data'
import { t } from '../copy'
import equity from '../assets/equity.svg'
import commodities from '../assets/commodities.svg'
import strategies from '../assets/strategies.svg'
import styles from '../components/HomeParts.module.css'
import flat from '../flatCards.module.css'

export type HomePart = 'top' | 'watchlists' | 'options' | 'heatmap' | 'futures'
/** The product tab: Equity (fno-01…04), Commodities (fno-08…11), Strategies (fno-15, 16). */
export type Product = 'equity' | 'commodities' | 'strategies'
type Props = {
  product?: Product
  /** Strategies tab: Equity or Commodities strategies. */
  segment?: Segment
  /** Commodities tab: open with the contract picker up, on this tab of it. */
  picker?: 'equity' | 'commodities'
  onProduct: (product: Product, segment?: Segment) => void
  onCommodity: (commodity: Commodity) => void
  /** A contract card (Expiring This Week) → that contract's asset page. */
  onAsset: () => void
  /** Expiring This Week's View all → the Upcoming expiries timeline (fno-38). */
  onExpiries: () => void
  scrollTo?: HomePart; onHome: () => void; onSearch: () => void; onProfile: () => void; onWallet: () => void; onDash: () => void; onUsStocks?: () => void; onOptions: () => void; onFutures: () => void; onChain: () => void; onScalper: () => void; onPositions: () => void }
type Modal = { kind: 'detail'; title: string; contract?: Contract } | { kind: 'create' } | { kind: 'choice'; title: string; values: string[]; value: string; onPick: (v: string) => void } | { kind: 'picker'; segment: 'equity' | 'commodities' } | { kind: 'trend'; contract: ExpiringContract }

/** fno-01 … 04 · one scrollable Equity home, with board frames for the lower sections. */
export function Home({ product = 'equity', segment = 'equity', picker, onProduct, onCommodity, onAsset, onExpiries, scrollTo = 'top', onHome, onSearch, onProfile, onWallet, onDash, onUsStocks, onOptions, onFutures, onChain, onScalper, onPositions }: Props) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<Modal | null>(picker ? { kind: 'picker', segment: picker } : null)
  const [instrument, setInstrument] = useState('Gold')
  const [lists, setLists] = useState(watchlists)
  const [created, setCreated] = useState(false)
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
  // The product tabs are stuck under the top bar: their row takes the scrolled top bar's colour.
  const [tabsStuck, setTabsStuck] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const body = root.current?.parentElement
    if (!body) return
    const tabs = root.current?.querySelector('[data-fno="tabs"]')
    const onScroll = () => {
      setScrolled(body.scrollTop > 0)
      setTabsStuck(!!tabs && body.scrollTop > 0 && tabs.getBoundingClientRect().top <= body.getBoundingClientRect().top + 1)
    }
    onScroll()
    body.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => body.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [])
  const close = () => setModal(null)
  const open = (title: string) => setModal({ kind: 'detail', title })
  const choose: Choose = (title, values, value, onPick) => setModal({ kind: 'choice', title, values, value, onPick })
  const scroll = (part: HomePart) => {
    const body = root.current?.parentElement
    const target = root.current?.querySelector(`[data-fno="${part}"]`)
    if (body && target) body.scrollTo({ top: body.scrollTop + target.getBoundingClientRect().top - body.getBoundingClientRect().top, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }
  // A product tab switch slides only the content under the tabs, toward the chosen tab's side. If the page was
  // scrolled past the tabs (they stick under the top bar), it stops with the new content's start right under them.
  const order: Product[] = ['equity', 'commodities', 'strategies']
  const shownProduct = useRef(product)
  const [slide, setSlide] = useState<'from-end' | 'from-start' | null>(null)
  if (shownProduct.current !== product) {
    setSlide(order.indexOf(product) > order.indexOf(shownProduct.current) ? 'from-end' : 'from-start')
    shownProduct.current = product
  }
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const body = root.current?.parentElement
    const tabs = root.current?.querySelector('[data-fno="tabs"]')
    const content = root.current?.querySelector('[data-fno="content"]')
    if (!slide || !body || !tabs || !content) return
    // The tabs stick under the top bar, so measure the new content against their bottom edge.
    const offset = content.getBoundingClientRect().top - tabs.getBoundingClientRect().bottom
    if (offset < 0) body.scrollTop += offset
  }, [product])
  useEffect(() => { if (picker) setModal({ kind: 'picker', segment: picker }) }, [picker])
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const body = root.current?.parentElement
    const target = root.current?.querySelector(`[data-fno="${scrollTo}"]`)
    if (body && target && scrollTo !== 'top') body.scrollTop += target.getBoundingClientRect().top - body.getBoundingClientRect().top
  }, [scrollTo])
  const sheet = modal?.kind === 'detail' ? <DetailSheet title={modal.title} contract={modal.contract} onClose={close} /> : modal?.kind === 'choice' ? <ChoiceSheet {...modal} onClose={close} /> : modal?.kind === 'picker' ? <ContractPickerSheet segment={modal.segment} value={instrument} onPick={setInstrument} onClose={close} /> : modal?.kind === 'trend' ? <TrendInfoSheet contract={modal.contract} onClose={close} /> : modal?.kind === 'create' ? <CreateWatchlistSheet onClose={close} onCreate={(name) => { setLists((ls) => [...ls, { id: `custom-${ls.length}`, name, count: 0 }]); close(); setCreated(true) }} /> : undefined
  return <Screen className={flat.flatCards} top={<Header scrolled={scrolled} initials={user.name.split(' ').map((name) => name[0]).join('')} onSearch={onSearch} onProfile={onProfile} onWallet={onWallet} onDash={onDash} />} bottom={<FnoNav onHome={onHome} onPositions={onPositions} onChain={onChain} onScalper={onScalper} />} sheet={sheet} toast={created ? <Aerobar floating type="success" heading={t('watchlists.created')} onDismiss={() => setCreated(false)} /> : undefined}>
    <Stack ref={root}>
      <div data-fno="top"><Overview onDestination={open} onPositions={onPositions} /></div>
      <div data-fno="tabs" className={styles.stickyTabs} data-stuck={tabsStuck || undefined}><Tabs aria-label="F&O products" appearance="ribbon" size="md" width="fill" className={styles.productTabs} value={product} onChange={(v) => onProduct(v)} items={[{ value: 'equity', label: t('equity'), iconLeft: <span className={styles.ribbonIcon}><MaskIcon src={equity} /></span> }, { value: 'commodities', label: t('commodities'), iconLeft: <span className={styles.ribbonIcon}><MaskIcon src={commodities} /></span> }, { value: 'strategies', label: t('strategies'), iconLeft: <span className={styles.ribbonIcon}><MaskIcon src={strategies} /></span> }]} /></div>
      <div key={product} data-fno="content" className={styles.productContent} data-slide={slide ?? undefined}>
      {product === 'equity' && <Stack gap="32" className={styles.feed}>
        <Shortcuts onWatchlist={() => scroll('watchlists')} onDestination={open} />
        {onUsStocks && <UsBanner onOpen={onUsStocks} />}
        <TradingChart onChoose={choose} onDestination={open} onChain={onChain} onScalper={onScalper} />
        <div className={styles.divider} />
        <div data-fno="watchlists"><Watchlists lists={lists} onAdd={() => setModal({ kind: 'create' })} onOpen={open} /></div>
        <div data-fno="options"><ContractSection kind="options" onChoose={choose} onContract={(contract) => setModal({ kind: 'detail', title: contract.name, contract })} onViewAll={onOptions} /></div>
        <div data-fno="heatmap"><Heatmap onOpen={open} onViewAll={() => open(t('heatmap.title'))} /></div>
        <div data-fno="futures"><ContractSection kind="futures" onChoose={choose} onContract={(contract) => setModal({ kind: 'detail', title: contract.name, contract })} onViewAll={onFutures} /></div>
      </Stack>}
      {product === 'commodities' && <CommoditiesFeed instrument={instrument} lists={lists} onCommodity={onCommodity} onAsset={onAsset} onPicker={() => setModal({ kind: 'picker', segment: 'commodities' })} onChoose={choose} onContract={(contract) => setModal({ kind: 'detail', title: contract.name, contract })} onDestination={open} onAddWatchlist={() => setModal({ kind: 'create' })} onChain={onChain} onScalper={onScalper} onExpiries={onExpiries} onTrendInfo={(contract) => setModal({ kind: 'trend', contract })} />}
      {product === 'strategies' && <StrategiesFeed segment={segment} onSegment={(next) => onProduct('strategies', next)} onChoose={choose} onDestination={open} onWatchlist={() => open(t('shortcut.watchlist'))} />}
      </div>
    </Stack>
  </Screen>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/screens/Scalper.module.css`

```css
/*
 * Scalper — measured on the live app's screenshot (392 wide, dark). Every colour is an L3 token: the page is
 * surface/default, the panels surface/primary; Active and its count use the Zing accent, the chart-type button the
 * US-stock blue (the live app's blue tint), Buy the brand lime.
 */

/* Chrome around the charts (header band, the band between the charts, the order dock): surface/secondary in light (the
   live app's grey separators), surface/default (black) in dark. */
.screen {
  --scalper-chrome: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

:global(html[data-mode='light']) .screen {
  --scalper-chrome: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

/* ---- Top: header (back · strategy tabs · add) and the tool row ---- */
.top {
  flex: none;
  background: var(--scalper-chrome);
}

.header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  height: var(--l3-size-48);
  padding-left: var(--l3-spacing-06);
}

.back.back {
  align-self: center;
  margin-top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

/* L3 ribbon tabs: the selected tab takes the tool row's surface and a light edge, so it runs into the row below. */
.strategies.strategies {
  flex: none;
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16) var(--l3-spacing-20);
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.strategies.strategies [role='tab'][aria-selected='true'] { /* beats L3's ribbon selector (0,3,0) */
  --tab-surface: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  --tab-border: var(--tab-surface); /* no outline (designer's call, 2026-11-03): sides and flares in the fill colour */
}

.addStrategies {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  align-self: center;
  margin-top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.addRing {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-24);
  height: var(--l3-size-24);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-zing-light);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-accent-zing-default); /* 1px: Figma stroke weight has no variable */
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* Tool row: 36 tall on surface/primary, a dashed line under it; scrolls sideways (Active runs off the edge). */
.tools {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: var(--l3-spacing-36);
  padding-left: var(--l3-spacing-20);
  overflow-x: auto;
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--l3-border-intense);
}

.tool.tool {
  flex: none;
  --btn-content: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}

.divider {
  flex: none;
  width: 1px;
  height: var(--l3-size-20);
  margin-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  background: var(--l3-border-light);
}

/* Active strategies: Zing tint, rounded on the left, running off the right edge; the count sits on the icon. */
.active {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  height: var(--l3-size-32);
  margin-left: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-24) 0 var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-accent-zing-light);
  border-right: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08) 0 0 var(--l3-radius-08);
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-zing-light);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-zing-default);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.activeIcon {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}

.count {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
  right: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-width: var(--l3-size-16);
  height: var(--l3-size-16);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-zing-default);
  color: var(--l3-static-black);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-10);
}

/* ---- Chart panels ---- */
.panel {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
}

.panelHead {
  display: flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-16) var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.instrument {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}

.nameRow,
.priceRow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  height: var(--l3-size-20);
}

.picker {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.name {
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  text-underline-offset: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.segment {
  margin-left: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}

.link.link {
  --btn-content: var(--l3-content-primary);
  margin-left: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.price {
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}

.up {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}


/* The pane's tools button: 32 (L3 Small) on surface/secondary. */

.paneButton.paneButton {
  --btn-surface: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  --btn-content: var(--l3-content-primary);
  --btn-border: var(--l3-border-intense);
  margin-top: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

/* The chart fills the panel; "N ▾" (indicators on it) sits at its top-left, the reset button at its bottom centre. */
.chart {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
}

.indicatorCount.indicatorCount {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  left: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  --btn-content: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}

.refresh.refresh {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--l3-spacing-40);
  left: 50%;
  --btn-content: var(--l3-content-accent-discover-default);
  --btn-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

/* Between the panes: a 16 band on the page colour with a drag handle. */
.split {
  display: grid;
  flex: none;
  place-items: center;
  height: var(--l3-size-16);
  background: var(--scalper-chrome);
}

.handle {
  width: var(--l3-size-40);
  height: var(--l3-size-04);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  cursor: row-resize;
}

/* ---- Order dock ---- */
.dock {
  display: flex;
  flex: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-08);
  background: var(--scalper-chrome);
}

.orderType.orderType {
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-intense); /* 1px: Figma stroke weight has no variable */
}

.order {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  width: 100%;
}

.side,
.qty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.buy.buy,
.sell.sell {
  --btn-radius: var(--l3-radius-16);
}

.req {
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

.funds {
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-10);
}

/* The chart-tools sheet brings its own layout: no content padding (L3 2.4: that includes its 16 top and 24 bottom
   spaces) — edge to edge. No top hairline either (L3 draws one above every sheet; over the dimmed screen it read as a
   stray line) — the sheet keeps its shadow. */
/* Raised so it beats L3's no-dock rule (.surface[data-placement] > .content:last-child adds 24 + the safe area). */
.sheet.sheet.sheet [data-sheet-content]:last-child,
.sheet [data-sheet-content] {
  padding: 0;
}

.sheet.sheet.sheet {
  box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-high);
}

/* An open position (fno-35): the option pane takes 3 parts of the height to the spot pane's 2, so the TP, entry and
   SL pills clear each other (Figma C). */
.panel[data-tall] {
  flex: 1.5;
}
```
