### `src/flows/fno/sheets/SignalStrip.module.css`

```css
/*
 * The nudge strip over a commodity signal's card (SignalStrip.tsx), after Figma 6946:42446 ("Commodities nudge") and its
 * improved gradient 6947:45037 (24 Nov), file 9r61YQp7QQZAQovDyz8hLF: a 28 strip behind the card's top edge, warm in its
 * top-left corner (halfway zing light → honey 200) fading to zing light 64 across; a 1 gold ring round strip and card
 * (zing light at the top → honey 300 at the bottom); the gold bars (18) on a soft white glow 16 in, a Heading/10 +
 * Label/10 line in honey 800. Rotating facts only since 24 Nov (the other versions' styles: archive/zing-nudge-strip-versions/).
 */

/* The strip's colours. */
.nudge {
  --strip-from: var(--l3-surface-accent-zing-light);
  --strip-to: var(--l3-border-accent-zing-light);
  --strip-ink: var(--app-strip-gold-ink);
  /* The ring (outline stroke): L3 extra/gold/50 at the top → extra/gold/300 at the bottom (user, 24 Nov; the tokens
     follow the theme — dark: honey 900 → honey 600). */
  --strip-ring-top: var(--l3-extra-gold-50);
  --strip-ring: var(--l3-extra-gold-300);
  position: relative;
  /* The ring: Figma's 1 stroke round strip and card. It sits just outside the card (padding 1, margin −1), so the card
     keeps its exact size and place — only the strip grows in above it. */
  padding: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  border-radius: calc(var(--l3-radius-12) + 1px);
}
/* The ring (and what shows behind the card's corners): extra gold 50 → extra gold 300, top to bottom. */
.ring {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--strip-ring-top), var(--strip-ring));
}

/* Entry, once the sheet is up (its own slide takes ~400): the strip slides out from behind the card (its row grows
   0 → 28), one card after another; then its line rises in. */
.nudge { --strip-start: calc(var(--l3-motion-duration-long) + var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) + var(--strip-order, 0) * var(--l3-motion-duration-medium)); }
/*
 * The strip runs on 12 under the card (as Figma's 48 strip under the card from 28), so the card's rounded top corners
 * sit on the strip's colour — no notch where they curve away. It takes 27 of the layout (28 from the ring's outer edge).
 */
.reveal {
  position: relative;
  height: calc(var(--l3-size-28) - 1px + var(--l3-radius-12));
  margin-bottom: calc(-1 * var(--l3-radius-12));
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: calc(var(--l3-radius-12) - 1px) calc(var(--l3-radius-12) - 1px) 0 0;
  animation: strip-reveal var(--l3-motion-duration-long) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
  animation-delay: var(--strip-start);
}
@keyframes strip-reveal { from { height: var(--l3-radius-12); } }
/* The ring fades in as the strip comes out. */
.ring { animation: strip-ring var(--l3-motion-duration-long) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both; animation-delay: var(--strip-start); }
@keyframes strip-ring { from { opacity: 0; } }

.strip {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-radius-12) var(--l3-spacing-16); /* the line stays centred in the 27 seen */
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: inherit;
  /* Figma 6947:45038 "top strip": warm in the top-left corner (halfway between the two honeys), fading to zing light
     64 across (its gradient runs down-right at ~138°). */
  background: linear-gradient(138deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--strip-from), var(--strip-to)) 0, var(--strip-from) var(--l3-size-64));
  color: var(--strip-ink);
}
.strip > * {
  animation: strip-rise var(--l3-motion-duration-long) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--strip-start) + var(--l3-motion-duration-medium));
}
@keyframes strip-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--l3-spacing-06)); } }

/* The picture on a soft white glow under it (Figma Ellipse 6835: 29 × 8, white 50%). */
.glow {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  width: var(--l3-icon-size-18);
  height: var(--l3-icon-size-18);
}
.glow[data-glow='true']::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-02));
  width: var(--app-strip-glow-width);
  height: var(--l3-size-08);
  translate: -50% 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--app-strip-glow);
  filter: blur(var(--l3-spacing-02));
}
.picture { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
.fire { position: relative; color: var(--l3-content-accent-orange-default); }
/* The move line: a trend arrow (up or down) in the strip's text colour (honey 800 on gold). */
.trend { position: relative; color: var(--strip-ink); }

.text {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-10);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.text b { font-weight: var(--l3-text-heading-10-weight); }

/* One line at a time, the next rising from below (its picture too). */
.rotorPic { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 100%; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; animation: strip-rise var(--l3-motion-duration-long) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both; }
.rotorLine { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; animation: strip-rise var(--l3-motion-duration-long) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both; }
.move { color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default); }
.move[data-up='true'] { color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default); }

/* The card sits on the strip's lower part, as in Figma (it covers the gradient's last 21). */
.nudge > :last-child { position: relative; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal, .ring, .strip > *, .rotorLine, .rotorPic { animation: none; }
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/sheets/SignalStrip.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { msLocalFireDepartmentFill, msTrendingDown, msTrendingUp } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import type { ZingSignal } from '../data'
import goldBars from '../assets/signals/gold-bars.png'
import styles from './SignalStrip.module.css'

/**
 * The nudge strip over a commodity signal's card — Rotating facts (Figma 6946:42446 / 6947:45037, 24 Nov): the commodity
 * cards didn't stand out enough among index and stock signals, so a strip peeks out from behind the card's top edge with
 * a reason to look. It slides out from behind the card when the sheet opens; its line (and its picture) turns over
 * every 5 s:
 * 1. the gold bars (other commodities: their logo) · "**2.1K+ people** have traded on gold today"
 * 2. the flame · "**Trending on MCX** · 2.1K+ traded today"
 * 3. a trend arrow (up / down, in the strip's text colour) · "Gold is **+1.2%** today" (the move green / red)
 * 4. the gold bars · "MCX is open till 11:30 PM"
 * The only version since 24 Nov (the Commodity nudge strip setting and Gold glow, Colour per commodity and Dark ticker
 * are archived in archive/zing-nudge-strip-versions/).
 */
export function SignalStrip({ signal, show = true, logo, order, children }: { signal: ZingSignal; show?: boolean; logo: string; order: number; children: ReactNode }) {
  const nudge = signal.nudge
  const commodity = signal.commodity
  // `show`: only the first commodity card in the list gets the strip (SignalsSheet).
  if (!show || !nudge || !commodity) return <>{children}</>

  // The gold bars sit on Figma's soft white glow; logos and icons don't.
  const bars = commodity === 'gold'
  const picture = <img src={bars ? goldBars : logo} alt="" className={styles.picture} />
  const flame = <Icon icon={msLocalFireDepartmentFill} size={16} className={styles.fire} />
  const up = !nudge.move.startsWith('−')
  const trendIcon = <Icon icon={up ? msTrendingUp : msTrendingDown} size={16} className={styles.trend} />

  return (
    <div className={styles.nudge} style={{ '--strip-order': order } as CSSProperties}>
      <span className={styles.ring} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className={styles.reveal}>
        <div className={styles.strip}>
          <Rotating items={[
            { picture, glow: bars, line: <><b>{t('signals.strip.people', { count: nudge.traders })}</b> {t('signals.strip.traded', { name: t(`signals.strip.name.${commodity}`) })}</> },
            { picture: flame, line: <><b>{t('signals.strip.trending')}</b> · {t('signals.strip.tradedShort', { count: nudge.traders })}</> },
            { picture: trendIcon, line: <>{t('signals.strip.moveIs', { name: t(`signals.strip.title.${commodity}`) })} <b className={styles.move} data-up={up}>{nudge.move}</b> {t('signals.strip.today')}</> },
            { picture, glow: bars, line: <>{t('signals.strip.open')}</> },
          ]} />
        </div>
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

/** How long each line stays before the next rolls up. */
const ROTATE_MS = 5000

/**
 * One line at a time (with its picture), the next rolling up from below every 5 s. The picture's box stays put (only
 * what's inside it changes), so the new picture comes in with its line — not after the strip's entry delay.
 */
function Rotating({ items }: { items: { picture: ReactNode; glow?: boolean; line: ReactNode }[] }) {
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setIndex((i) => (i + 1) % items.length), ROTATE_MS)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [items.length])
  const item = items[index]
  return <>
    <span className={styles.glow} data-glow={Boolean(item.glow)} aria-hidden="true">
      <span key={index} className={styles.rotorPic}>{item.picture}</span>
    </span>
    <p className={styles.text} aria-live="polite">
      <span key={index} className={styles.rotorLine}>{item.line}</span>
    </p>
  </>
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/sheets/SignalsSheet.module.css`

```css
/*
 * Zing signals sheet (SignalsSheet.tsx) and its filter sheet, after Figma 6900:23853 ("Enrich signal filter",
 * file 9r61YQp7QQZAQovDyz8hLF) in L3 tokens.
 */

/* One height however many signals there are: 75% of the phone screen (user, 20 Nov; the screen is a size container —
   Screen.module.css); the list scrolls inside it. */
.sheet.sheet { height: 75cqh; }

/* The chip row in the sheet header's place: the filter button | the chips (they scroll sideways), a line under it. */
.chipBar {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) 0 var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-16);
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px: Figma stroke weight has no variable */
}
.chipBar > :last-child { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.chips { padding-right: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
/* Chips not picked: Label/12 in text secondary (user, 20 Nov). */
.chips [role='tab'][aria-selected='false'] { --tab-content: var(--l3-content-secondary); }
.chipLogo { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); object-fit: cover; }
/* The filter button: a round bordered pill like the chips (Figma: 32, border-intense, elevation low). */
.filterButton.filterButton { flex: none; --btn-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); }
/* View: Figma's fixed 60 wide. */
.view.view { min-width: calc(var(--l3-size-56) + var(--l3-size-04)); }
.divider {
  flex: none;
  width: 1px; /* hairline */
  height: var(--l3-size-20);
  background: var(--l3-border-light);
}
/* The flame on Win rate ≥ 50% (Figma: orange). */
.fire { color: var(--l3-content-accent-orange-default); }
.chipsWrap { min-width: 0; }
/*
 * The saved-filter tip points at Your filter: its anchor sits over the first chip (16 + the 32 filter button + 12 + the
 * 1 line + 12 in; the chip's own width), so the arrow lands under it as in Figma (6900:31347).
 */
.tip.tip {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  left: calc(var(--l3-spacing-16) + var(--l3-size-32) + var(--l3-spacing-24) + 1px); /* 1px: the divider hairline */
  pointer-events: none;
}
.tipTarget { display: block; width: calc(var(--l3-size-128) - var(--l3-size-16)); height: var(--l3-size-32); }
/* Figma's tip: discover blue, white Label/12 on one line, 8 / 12 · 8 inside, 4 to the ✕, radius 8, a soft shadow.
   L3's tooltip is the dark inverted bubble with Description/12 (L3 gap: no discover tone). */
.tip.tip [role='tooltip'] {
  --tt-surface: var(--l3-surface-accent-discover-default);
  pointer-events: auto;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  max-width: none;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-12);
  color: var(--l3-static-white);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-medium);
}
.tip.tip [role='tooltip'] > span:first-child { padding: 0; }
.chipClose { display: inline-flex; width: var(--l3-size-16); height: var(--l3-size-16); cursor: pointer; }

.body { display: block; }

.heading {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}
.totalLabel, .pnlLabel { color: var(--l3-content-primary); }
.pnlLabel { color: var(--l3-content-secondary); }

/* A signal card: a smooth drop shadow under its edge (user, 20 Nov) — L3 elevation low (close) + soft (wide). */
.signalCard.signalCard { box-shadow: var(--card-border), var(--l3-shadow-elevation-low), var(--l3-shadow-elevation-soft); }
/* A signal card. */
.who { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.name {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary); /* the strategy name in text primary (user, 20 Nov) */
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Grey tags (market, win rate) read in text secondary (user, 20 Nov; L3's neutral tag is text primary). */
.greyTag.greyTag { --tag-content: var(--l3-content-secondary); }
.up { font-weight: var(--l3-text-heading-10-weight); color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default); }
/* The trade, under a line: Buy Call 23950 • RR 1.4 • EMA 9 > EMA 21, spread across the card. */
.trade {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px: Figma stroke weight has no variable */
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.muted { color: var(--l3-content-tertiary); }
.dot {
  flex: none;
  width: var(--l3-size-04);
  height: var(--l3-size-04);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-border-intense);
}

/* ---- Filter: the chart tools sheet's layout (ChartToolsSheet.module.css .body / .nav / .panel / .header) ---- */
/* The sheet brings its own layout: no content padding (as the Scalper's chart tools sheet). */
.toolsSheet.toolsSheet.toolsSheet [data-sheet-content] { padding: 0; }
.toolsSheet.toolsSheet.toolsSheet { box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-high); }
/* The count in a side tab's corner: white on the discover blue in both modes (the tools sheet sets it for Zing yellow). */
.nav.nav.nav[data-flag-tone] { --side-nav-flag-content: var(--l3-static-white); }
/*
 * The filter is the Scalper's Settings sheet (chart tools → Settings) in look: the same side nav, white panel, title row
 * and rows (ChartToolsSheet.module.css). It stays shorter than Settings' 576: the list area is 412 (Indices' six rows
 * fit: title row 64 + 16 + 6 × 48 + 5 × 8), the picks' 44 strip under it when there are picks, then the dock.
 */
.filterGrid.filterGrid { height: calc(var(--l3-size-128) * 3 + var(--l3-size-28)); }

/* The Zing mark (Figma's own glyph), drawn in the tile's text colour like the Material icons beside it. */
.zingMark { display: block; width: var(--l3-icon-size-24); height: var(--l3-icon-size-24); } /* as the side nav's icons */
/* "Clear All" in Figma's discover blue (a text action). */
.clear.clear { --btn-content: var(--l3-content-accent-discover-default); color: var(--l3-content-accent-discover-default); }

/* The picks (Figma "applied", 44): 12 above the chips, 16 at the sides, one row that scrolls sideways. */
.pills {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  height: calc(var(--l3-size-32) + var(--l3-spacing-12));
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-16) 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
}
/* A pick is Figma's unselected pill: surface-primary, border-light, 8 inside, 4 to the ✕, Label/12 in secondary. */
.pill.pill {
  flex: none;
  --btn-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  --btn-surface: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  --btn-border: var(--l3-border-light);
  --btn-content: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  --btn-gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}
/* The ✕ (Figma "cross"): filled, in primary. */
.pillX { color: var(--l3-content-primary); }
/* A long strategy name is cut at 140 (Figma dev note "Max width: 140px"). */
.pillLabel {
  display: block;
  max-width: calc(var(--l3-size-128) + var(--l3-size-12));
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---- Commodity signals ---- */
/* Logos in tags: the tag's 12 icon slot (L3 Tag sm). */
.tagLogo { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); object-fit: cover; }
```

### `src/flows/fno/sheets/SignalsSheet.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Badge } from '@l3/components/Badge'
import { BottomSheetHeader } from '@l3/components/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Checkbox, Radio } from '@l3/components/Checkbox'
import { EmptyState } from '@l3/components/EmptyState'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { MaskIcon } from '@l3/components/MaskIcon'
import { SideNav } from '@l3/components/SideNav'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { Tooltip } from '@l3/components/Tooltip'
import { msCancelFill, msFilterAltFill, msFormatListBulleted, msLocalFireDepartmentFill, msSpeed, msSwapVert } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { Sheet } from '../../../shared/ui/Sheet'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { filterCount, matchesFilter, noSignalFilter, signalMarkets, signalsTotalPnl, zingSignals, type SignalAvatar, type SignalCommodity, type SignalFilter, type SignalMarket, type ZingSignal } from '../data'
import goldLogo from '../commodities/assets/gold.png'
import silverLogo from '../commodities/assets/silver.png'
import crudeLogo from '../commodities/assets/crude-oil.png'
import gasLogo from '../commodities/assets/natural-gas.png'
import neeraj from '../assets/signals/neeraj.png'
import lemon from '../assets/signals/lemon.png'
import booming from '../assets/signals/booming.png'
import zingMark from '../assets/signals/zing-mark.svg'
import { SignalStrip } from './SignalStrip'
import styles from './SignalsSheet.module.css'
import tools from './ChartToolsSheet.module.css'

/** The quick chips under the sheet's top edge. `yours` appears once a filter has been applied (and saved). */
export type SignalsChip = 'yours' | 'all' | 'win50' | 'win25' | 'commodity' | 'nifty' | 'sensex' | 'banknifty' | 'stocks' | SignalCommodity
/** The filter sheet's groups (its side nav). */
export type FilterSection = 'indices' | 'winRate' | 'direction' | 'strategies'

/** Where the sheet starts — the prototype's screens open it in each Figma state. */
export type SignalsSheetState = {
  chip?: SignalsChip
  /** The saved filter ("Your filter"), if one has been applied. */
  saved?: SignalFilter | null
  /** The filter, open on this group. */
  filter?: FilterSection | null
  /** The filter sheet's choices so far (before Apply). Default: the saved filter. */
  draft?: SignalFilter
  /** "Filter applied & saved for quick access", under Your filter (shows once, right after Apply). */
  savedTip?: boolean
  /** The plain "All Signals" look: a heading over every signal (Figma's last frame). */
  plain?: boolean
}

const avatars: Record<SignalAvatar, string> = { neeraj, lemon, booming }
/** The commodity logos the Commodities home uses (commodities/assets). */
const commodityLogos: Record<SignalCommodity, string> = { gold: goldLogo, silver: silverLogo, crude: crudeLogo, gas: gasLogo }

/**
 * How a commodity signal stands out from index and stock signals (24 Nov, the user's call — the earlier versions are
 * gone, and so are the segment tabs): the sheet starts with the filter button | the chips (All Signals · Win rate ≥ 50% ·
 * Nifty · Sensex · F&O Stocks · Commodities), a line under them; commodity cards have an amber tag with the
 * commodity's logo and name, and the nudge strip over them (Rotating facts, SignalStrip.tsx).
 */
const marketLabel = (market: SignalMarket) => t(`signals.market.${market}`)
const quick: Record<Exclude<SignalsChip, 'yours'>, (s: ZingSignal) => boolean> = {
  all: () => true,
  win50: (s) => (s.winRate ?? 0) >= 50,
  win25: (s) => (s.winRate ?? 0) >= 25,
  commodity: (s) => s.market === 'commodity',
  nifty: (s) => s.market === 'nifty',
  sensex: (s) => s.market === 'sensex',
  banknifty: (s) => s.market === 'banknifty',
  stocks: (s) => s.market === 'stocks',
  gold: (s) => s.commodity === 'gold',
  silver: (s) => s.commodity === 'silver',
  crude: (s) => s.commodity === 'crude',
  gas: (s) => s.commodity === 'gas',
}

/**
 * Zing signals (Scalper → the Active chip, top right): today's live signals from Zing strategies, across F&O — index
 * options (Nifty, Sensex, Bank Nifty), F&O stocks and commodities.
 * - The top row: the filter button, Your filter (once one is saved, ✕ removes it), All Signals, Win rate ≥ 50%, then
 *   Commodity · Nifty · Sensex. Each chip shows how many signals it holds.
 * - Active signals (n) with today's Total P&L, then one card per signal: strategy, its market and win rate (or P&L),
 *   View; under a line the trade: Buy Call 23950 · RR · the rule that fired.
 * - The filter button turns the sheet into the filter, laid out like the chart tools sheet (Indices · Win rate · Call/Put ·
 *   Strategies). Apply saves the choices as Your filter and selects it; Cancel drops them.
 */
export function SignalsSheet({ initial = {}, onClose }: { initial?: SignalsSheetState; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<SignalFilter | null>(initial.saved ?? null)
  const [chip, setChip] = useState<SignalsChip>(initial.chip ?? (initial.saved ? 'yours' : 'all'))
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterSection | null>(initial.filter ?? null)
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<SignalFilter>(initial.draft ?? initial.saved ?? noSignalFilter)
  const [savedTip, setSavedTip] = useState(Boolean(initial.savedTip))

  const openFilter = () => {
    setDraft(saved ?? noSignalFilter)
    setSavedTip(false)
    setFilter('indices')
  }
  const apply = () => {
    const keep = filterCount(draft) ? draft : null
    setSaved(keep)
    setChip(keep ? 'yours' : 'all')
    setSavedTip(Boolean(keep))
    setFilter(null)
  }
  const removeSaved = () => {
    setSaved(null)
    setChip('all')
    setSavedTip(false)
  }

  /** The tab's press layer covers its icons, so a tap on Your filter's ✕ is caught here by where it lands. */
  const closeTap = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const close = e.currentTarget.querySelector('[data-chip-close]')?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!close || e.clientX < close.left - 4 || e.clientX > close.right + 4 || e.clientY < close.top - 4 || e.clientY > close.bottom + 4) return
    e.stopPropagation()
    e.preventDefault()
    removeSaved()
  }
  const inChip = (c: SignalsChip) => zingSignals.filter((s) => (c === 'yours' ? saved !== null && matchesFilter(s, saved) : quick[c](s)))
  const shown = inChip(chip)
  const count = (c: SignalsChip) => inChip(c).length

  // The quick chips after All Signals.
  const quickChips: Exclude<SignalsChip, 'yours' | 'all'>[] = ['win50', 'nifty', 'sensex', 'stocks', 'commodity']
  const chipItem = (c: Exclude<SignalsChip, 'yours' | 'all'>): { value: SignalsChip; label: string; iconLeft?: ReactNode } => {
    if (c === 'win50' || c === 'win25') return { value: c, label: t(`signals.${c}`, { count: count(c) }), iconLeft: <Icon icon={msLocalFireDepartmentFill} className={styles.fire} /> }
    if (c === 'gold' || c === 'silver' || c === 'crude' || c === 'gas') return { value: c, label: t(`signals.commodity.${c}`), iconLeft: <img src={commodityLogos[c]} alt="" className={styles.chipLogo} /> }
    if (c === 'commodity') return { value: c, label: t('signals.segment.commodity') }
    if (c === 'stocks') return { value: c, label: t('signals.market.stocks') }
    return { value: c, label: t(`signals.${c}`) }
  }
  const chips: { value: SignalsChip; label: string; iconLeft?: ReactNode; iconRight?: ReactNode }[] = [
    ...(saved
      ? [{
          value: 'yours' as const,
          label: t('signals.yours', { count: count('yours') }),
          // ✕ on the chip takes the saved filter off (a tap on the rest of the chip selects it): see closeTap.
          iconRight: <span data-chip-close="" className={styles.chipClose}><Icon icon={msCancelFill} size={16} /></span>,
        }]
      : []),
    { value: 'all', label: t('signals.all', { count: count('all') }) },
    ...quickChips.map((c) => chipItem(c)),
  ]

  const chipBar = (
    <div className={styles.chipBar}>
      <Badge dot={Boolean(saved)} color="error" label={t('signals.filterOn')}>
        <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msFilterAltFill} />} aria-label={t('signals.filter')} onClick={openFilter} className={styles.filterButton} />
      </Badge>
      <span className={styles.divider} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div onClickCapture={closeTap} className={styles.chipsWrap}>
        <Tabs aria-label={t('signals.chips')} appearance="pill" size="md" value={chip} onChange={setChip} items={chips} className={styles.chips} />
      </div>
      {/* "Filter applied & saved for quick access", pointing at Your filter (the first chip), once after Apply. */}
      <Tooltip open={savedTip} content={t('signals.savedTip')} placement="bottom" onClose={() => setSavedTip(false)} className={styles.tip}>
        <span className={styles.tipTarget} />
      </Tooltip>
    </div>
  )
  const totalTag = (
    <Tag size="md" variant="tertiary" color="profit">
      <span className={styles.totalLabel}>{t('signals.totalPnl')}</span> {t('signals.plus', { amount: formatInr(signalsTotalPnl, 0) })}
    </Tag>
  )
  const activeTitle = t('signals.active', { count: shown.length })
  // The plain "All Signals" look (Figma's last frame): a heading over every signal.
  const plain = Boolean(initial.plain) && !saved
  const header = plain ? (
    <BottomSheetHeader heading={t('signals.allTitle')} />
  ) : (
    // No tabs: the sheet starts with the filter button | the chips, a line under them.
    chipBar
  )

  // The filter takes the sheet over in place, laid out like the chart tools sheet (side nav + panel, Cancel / Apply in
  // the sheet's dock); Cancel, or a scrim tap, brings the signals back.
  if (filter) {
    return (
      <Sheet label={t('signals.filterTitle')} onClose={() => setFilter(null)} className={styles.toolsSheet} footer={<FilterDock onCancel={() => setFilter(null)} onApply={apply} />}>
        <FilterPanel section={filter} onSection={setFilter} draft={draft} onDraft={setDraft} />
      </Sheet>
    )
  }

  return (
    <Sheet label={t('signals.title')} onClose={onClose} header={header} className={styles.sheet}>
      <div className={styles.body}>
        {plain ? (
          <Stack gap="16">{zingSignals.map((s) => <SignalCard key={s.id} signal={s} order={stripOrder(zingSignals, s)} strip={stripOn(zingSignals, s)} />)}</Stack>
        ) : (
          <Stack gap="16">
            <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="12">
              <h2 className={styles.heading}>{activeTitle}</h2>
              {totalTag}
            </Stack>
            {shown.length ? (
              <Stack gap="16">{shown.map((s) => <SignalCard key={s.id} signal={s} order={stripOrder(shown, s)} strip={stripOn(shown, s)} />)}</Stack>
            ) : (
              <EmptyState title={t('signals.none')} description={t('signals.noneHint')} />
            )}
          </Stack>
        )}
      </div>
    </Sheet>
  )
}

/** The card's market tag: grey for an index or stock (NIFTY); for a commodity, an amber tag with its logo and name. */
function MarketTags({ signal }: { signal: ZingSignal }) {
  const commodity = signal.commodity
  if (!commodity) return <Tag size="sm" variant="tertiary" color="neutral" className={styles.greyTag}>{signal.underlying}</Tag>
  return <Tag size="sm" variant="tertiary" color="warning" iconLeft={<img src={commodityLogos[commodity]} alt="" className={styles.tagLogo} />}>{t(`signals.commodity.${commodity}`)}</Tag>
}

/** One signal: who sent it, where and how good it is, View; the trade under a line. */
function SignalCard({ signal, order = 0, strip = true }: { signal: ZingSignal; order?: number; strip?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <SignalStrip signal={signal} show={strip} logo={signal.commodity ? commodityLogos[signal.commodity] : ''} order={order}>
    <Card className={styles.signalCard}>
      <Stack gap="12">
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="12">
          <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="12" className={styles.who}>
            <Avatar src={avatars[signal.avatar]} size={32} />
            <Stack gap="04" className={styles.who}>
              <p className={styles.name}>{signal.strategy}</p>
              <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" align="center">
                {signal.winRate !== undefined ? (
                  <>
                    <MarketTags signal={signal} />
                    <Tag size="sm" variant="tertiary" color="neutral" className={styles.greyTag}>{t('signals.winRate')} <b className={styles.up}>{t('signals.percent', { value: signal.winRate })}</b></Tag>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <Tag size="sm" variant="tertiary" color="profit"><span className={styles.pnlLabel}>{t('signals.pnl')}</span> {t('signals.plus', { amount: formatInr(signal.pnl ?? 0, 2) })}</Tag>
                )}
              </Stack>
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
          <Button size="sm" aria-label={t('signals.viewLabel', { name: signal.strategy })} className={styles.view}>{t('signals.view')}</Button>
        </Stack>
        <div className={styles.trade}>
          <span><span className={styles.muted}>{signal.side}</span> {signal.contract}</span>
          <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span><span className={styles.muted}>{t('signals.rr')}</span> {signal.rr}</span>
          <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>{signal.ruleMuted ? <><span className={styles.muted}>{signal.rule[0]}</span> {signal.rule[1]}</> : `${signal.rule[0]} ${signal.rule[1]}`}</span>
        </div>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
    </SignalStrip>
  )
}

/** Where a card's strip comes in the stagger: the strips slide out one after another, top down. */
const stripOrder = (list: ZingSignal[], signal: ZingSignal) => list.filter((s) => s.nudge).indexOf(signal)

/**
 * The nudge strip goes on the first commodity card in the list only (24 Nov, user) — just to show that commodity signals
 * are there; the other commodity cards are plain. (A strip on every commodity card is archived in
 * archive/zing-nudge-strip-versions/.)
 */
const stripOn = (list: ZingSignal[], signal: ZingSignal) => stripOrder(list, signal) === 0

type FilterProps = { draft: SignalFilter; onDraft: (draft: SignalFilter) => void }

/** The picks in a draft, each with how to take it off (the chips over the dock). */
function picks({ draft, onDraft }: FilterProps) {
  return [
    ...draft.markets.map((m) => ({ key: m, label: t(`signals.pill.${m}`), remove: () => onDraft({ ...draft, markets: draft.markets.filter((v) => v !== m) }) })),
    ...(draft.winRate !== 'all' ? [{ key: 'win', label: t(`signals.win.${draft.winRate}`), remove: () => onDraft({ ...draft, winRate: 'all' as const }) }] : []),
    ...(draft.direction !== 'all' ? [{ key: 'dir', label: t(`signals.dir.${draft.direction}`), remove: () => onDraft({ ...draft, direction: 'all' as const }) }] : []),
    ...draft.strategies.map((id) => ({ key: id, label: zingSignals.find((s) => s.id === id)?.strategy ?? id, remove: () => onDraft({ ...draft, strategies: draft.strategies.filter((v) => v !== id) }) })),
  ]
}

/** The filter's dock: Cancel · Apply (primary), as Figma's Buttons dock. */
function FilterDock({ onCancel, onApply }: { onCancel: () => void; onApply: () => void }) {
  return (
    <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('signals.filterTitle')} direction="horizontal">
      <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel}>{t('signals.cancel')}</Button>
      <Button onClick={onApply}>{t('signals.apply')}</Button>
    </ButtonGroup>
  )
}

/**
 * The filter, in the Scalper's Settings sheet look (ChartToolsSheet.module.css: the 96 side nav, the white panel with its
 * sticky Heading/16 title row over a hairline, 48 card rows 8 apart, the chosen radio row in the discover tint): Indices · Win rate · Call/Put · Strategies on the
 * left (a group that narrows the list shows how many it picked), the group's choices on the right, Clear All in the
 * title row empties the group. The picks sit under it as chips (✕ takes one off), in Figma's 44 strip.
 */
function FilterPanel({ section, onSection, draft, onDraft }: FilterProps & { section: FilterSection; onSection: (section: FilterSection) => void }) {
  const picked: Record<FilterSection, number> = {
    indices: draft.markets.length,
    winRate: draft.winRate === 'all' ? 0 : 1,
    direction: draft.direction === 'all' ? 0 : 1,
    strategies: draft.strategies.length,
  }
  const flag = (s: FilterSection) => (picked[s] ? String(picked[s]) : undefined)
  const clear = () => onDraft({
    ...draft,
    ...(section === 'indices' && { markets: [] }),
    ...(section === 'winRate' && { winRate: 'all' as const }),
    ...(section === 'direction' && { direction: 'all' as const }),
    ...(section === 'strategies' && { strategies: [] }),
  })
  const toggle = <T extends string>(list: T[], value: T) => (list.includes(value) ? list.filter((v) => v !== value) : [...list, value])

  const title = t(`signals.section.${section}`)
  const pills = picks({ draft, onDraft })
  const check = (label: string, checked: boolean, onChange: () => void, iconLeft?: ReactNode) => (
    <ListCell key={label} variant="card" size="sm" as="label" label={label} iconLeft={iconLeft} trailing={<Checkbox checked={checked} onChange={onChange} aria-label={label} />} className={tools.row} />
  )
  const radio = (name: string, label: string, checked: boolean, onChange: () => void) => (
    <ListCell key={label} variant="card" size="sm" as="label" selected={checked} label={label} trailing={<Radio name={name} checked={checked} onChange={onChange} aria-label={label} />} className={tools.row} />
  )

  return (
    // Settings' look; the list area is 412, the picks' strip goes under it.
    <>
    <div className={`${tools.body} ${styles.filterGrid}`}>
      <SideNav<FilterSection>
        selectedTone="discover"
        aria-label={t('signals.filterTitle')}
        aria-controls="signals-filter-panel"
        value={section}
        onChange={onSection}
        className={`${tools.nav} ${styles.nav}`}
        items={[
          { value: 'indices', label: t('signals.section.indices'), icon: <Icon icon={msFormatListBulleted} />, flag: flag('indices') },
          { value: 'winRate', label: t('signals.section.winRate'), icon: <Icon icon={msSpeed} />, flag: flag('winRate') },
          { value: 'direction', label: t('signals.section.direction'), icon: <Icon icon={msSwapVert} />, flag: flag('direction') },
          { value: 'strategies', label: t('signals.section.strategies'), icon: <span className={styles.zingMark}><MaskIcon src={zingMark} /></span>, flag: flag('strategies') },
        ]}
      />
      <section id="signals-filter-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-label={title} className={tools.panel}>
        <div className={tools.header}>
          <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="12" className={tools.titleRow}>
            <h2 className={tools.title}>{title}</h2>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={clear} className={styles.clear}>{t('signals.clearAll')}</Button>
          </Stack>
        </div>
        <Stack gap="08">
          {section === 'indices' && [
            check(t('signals.allIndices'), draft.markets.length === 0, () => onDraft({ ...draft, markets: [] })),
            ...signalMarkets.map((m) => check(marketLabel(m), draft.markets.includes(m), () => onDraft({ ...draft, markets: toggle(draft.markets, m) }))),
          ]}
          {section === 'winRate' && (['all', '50', '30'] as const).map((v) => radio('signals-win', t(`signals.win.${v}`), draft.winRate === v, () => onDraft({ ...draft, winRate: v })))}
          {section === 'direction' && (['all', 'call', 'put'] as const).map((v) => radio('signals-dir', t(`signals.dir.${v}`), draft.direction === v, () => onDraft({ ...draft, direction: v })))}
          {section === 'strategies' && zingSignals.map((s) => check(s.strategy, draft.strategies.includes(s.id), () => onDraft({ ...draft, strategies: toggle(draft.strategies, s.id) }), <Avatar src={avatars[s.avatar]} size={24} />))}
        </Stack>
      </section>
    </div>
    {pills.length > 0 && (
      <div className={styles.pills} aria-label={t('signals.picked')}>
        {pills.map((p) => (
          <Button key={p.key} variant="secondary" size="sm" iconRight={<Icon icon={msCancelFill} className={styles.pillX} />} aria-label={t('signals.remove', { label: p.label })} onClick={p.remove} className={styles.pill}>
            <span className={styles.pillLabel}>{p.label}</span>
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>
    )}
    </>
  )
}

/** ₹ in Indian grouping: 13367 → ₹13,367; 367.3 → ₹367.30. */
function formatInr(value: number, digits: number) {
  return `₹${value.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits })}`
}
```

### `src/flows/fno/strategies/components/Strategies.module.css`

```css
/* Strategies tab — flow-only pieces on L3 tokens. */
.section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--l3-spacing-16); }
.pillDivider { flex: none; align-self: stretch; width: 1px; background: var(--l3-border-light); }
.caption { font: var(--l3-text-label-10); color: var(--l3-content-tertiary); white-space: nowrap; }
.statLabel { font: var(--l3-text-label-12); color: var(--l3-content-tertiary); white-space: nowrap; }
.statValue { font: var(--l3-text-heading-12); white-space: nowrap; }
.title16 { font: var(--l3-text-heading-16); white-space: nowrap; }
.fill { width: 100%; }
.ellipsis { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.muted { color: var(--l3-content-tertiary); }
.strike { font: var(--l3-text-label-10); color: var(--l3-content-tertiary); }
.apply { flex: none; min-width: var(--l3-size-80); }
.invest { flex: none; }
.play { display: inline-flex; color: var(--l3-content-accent-error-default); }
.fire { display: inline-flex; color: var(--l3-content-accent-warning-default); }

/* Last week: one 16 circle per weekday, tinted by result. */
.day { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: var(--l3-size-16); height: var(--l3-size-16); border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full); font: var(--l3-text-heading-10); }
.win { background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-light); color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default); }
.loss { background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-down-light); color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default); }
.none { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); color: var(--l3-content-disabled); }

/* Payoff sketch: loss area left of the breakeven, profit area right of it. */
.payoff { flex: none; width: var(--l3-size-40); height: var(--l3-size-28); }
.lossArea { fill: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-down-light); }
.profitArea { fill: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-light); }
.lossLine, .profitLine { fill: none; stroke-width: 1.5; }
.lossLine { stroke: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default); }
.profitLine { stroke: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default); }

/* Quick Trade: outlined up / down buttons (L3 has filled Buy / Sell only — see L3 gaps). */
.upButton.upButton[data-variant] { --btn-content: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default); --btn-border: var(--l3-border-accent-indicator-up-default); }
.downButton.downButton[data-variant] { --btn-content: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default); --btn-border: var(--l3-border-accent-indicator-down-default); }
```

## Source — shared app parts it uses

### `src/shared/copy.ts`

```ts
/**
 * UI copy. Every user-facing string of a flow lives in ONE file, `src/flows/<flow-id>/copy.json` — flat keys
 * ("empty.title") → the text. Screens read it through the flow's `t`:
 *
 *   t('empty.title')                       → "No search results found"
 *   t('group.results', { list, count })    → "Stocks (8)"   ({name} placeholders are filled in)
 *
 * Sample data (stock names, prices, watchlists) stays in the flow's data.ts — copy.json is only the words the app
 * itself says: titles, labels, buttons, empty states, accessible names. Porting a flow: this file is the string
 * table (Flutter ARB / iOS Localizable.strings).
 */
export type CopyVars = Record<string, string | number>

export function makeCopy<Copy extends Record<string, string>>(flow: string, copy: Copy) {
  return function t(key: keyof Copy & string, vars?: CopyVars): string {
    const template = copy[key] ?? key
    return vars ? template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, name: string) => (name in vars ? String(vars[name]) : m)) : template
  }
}
```

### `src/shared/data/companies.ts`

```ts
// The company catalogue — every Indian listed stock the prototype shows, with what a card, a list row or the stock
// (asset) page needs: identity, logo, profile and a real market snapshot.
//
// - Logos come from the design system (@l3/assets/company-logos).
// - Profiles (founded, headquarters, website, one line about the business) are written here — public facts.
// - Market data (price, day / 52-week range, volume, 3 months of daily closes, sector, industry) comes from
//   market-snapshot.json, refreshed from Yahoo Finance by `npm run market:snapshot` (see scripts/market-snapshot.mjs).
//   Near-live, not live: the bundled copy is used at first, then the app re-reads ./market-snapshot.json (published
//   next to the page; refreshed every 15 minutes in market hours by the site's GitHub Action) on load and every
//   5 minutes. `companies` / `getCompany()` then return the newer numbers; call `useMarketSnapshot()` in a screen
//   that shows prices so it re-renders when they change.
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
import { companyLogo } from '@l3/assets/company-logos'
import bundled from './market-snapshot.json'

export type Exchange = 'NSE' | 'BSE'

export type CompanyProfile = {
  /** NSE trading symbol — the key everywhere (RELIANCE). */
  symbol: string
  /** How the app writes it (Reliance Industries). */
  name: string
  /** Two letters for the Avatar when there's no logo. */
  initials: string
  exchanges: Exchange[]
  founded: number
  headquarters: string
  website: string
  /** One sentence on the business. */
  about: string
}

export type DailyClose = { date: string; close: number }

export type MarketData = {
  /** Last traded price, ₹. */
  price: number
  prevClose: number
  /** Day change, ₹ and %. */
  change: number
  changePct: number
  dayHigh: number
  dayLow: number
  high52: number
  low52: number
  volume: number | null
  sector: string | null
  industry: string | null
  /** Daily closes, oldest first (about 3 months) — for sparklines and the stock page chart. */
  closes: DailyClose[]
}

export type Company = CompanyProfile & {
  /** Logo image URL from the design system, or undefined (show `initials`). */
  logoUrl?: string
  /** The snapshot's market data, or undefined if the symbol wasn't fetched. */
  market?: MarketData
}

const both: Exchange[] = ['NSE', 'BSE']
const company = (symbol: string, name: string, initials: string, founded: number, headquarters: string, website: string, about: string): CompanyProfile => ({
  symbol, name, initials: initials.slice(0, 1), exchanges: both, founded, headquarters, website, about,
})

export type CompanySymbol = keyof typeof profiles

type Snapshot = { source: string; fetchedAt: string; quotes: Record<string, Partial<MarketData> & { closes?: DailyClose[] }> }

/** When the market data shown now was fetched (ISO date-time) and from where. Updated in place by the runtime refresh. */
export const marketSnapshot = { fetchedAt: bundled.fetchedAt, source: bundled.source }

function toCompany(p: CompanyProfile, snapshot: Snapshot, fallback?: MarketData): Company {
  const q = snapshot.quotes[p.symbol]
  return { ...p, logoUrl: companyLogo(p.symbol), market: q?.price != null ? (q as MarketData) : fallback }
}

/** Every company with logo and market data, by NSE symbol. */
export const companies = Object.fromEntries(Object.values(profiles).map((p) => [p.symbol, toCompany(p, bundled as Snapshot)])) as Record<CompanySymbol, Company>

// ── Runtime refresh ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

function apply(snapshot: Snapshot) {
  if (!(snapshot.fetchedAt > marketSnapshot.fetchedAt)) return // ISO strings sort by time; never go back to older data
  // A symbol the published file doesn't have yet (added to the catalogue after the site's copy) keeps the numbers we have.
  for (const p of Object.values(profiles)) companies[p.symbol as CompanySymbol] = toCompany(p, snapshot, companies[p.symbol as CompanySymbol]?.market)
  Object.assign(marketSnapshot, { fetchedAt: snapshot.fetchedAt, source: snapshot.source })
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

/** Re-read the published snapshot (same origin — no API call). Fails quietly: the numbers we have stay. */
export async function refreshMarket() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('market-snapshot.json', { cache: 'no-cache' })
    if (res.ok) apply(await res.json())
  } catch { /* offline, or the file isn't there — keep what we have */ }
}

const REFRESH_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  refreshMarket()
  setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refreshMarket() }, REFRESH_MS)
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refreshMarket() })
}

function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener)
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener) }
}

/** Re-renders the calling component when fresher market data arrives; returns its `fetchedAt`. */
export function useMarketSnapshot(): string {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => marketSnapshot.fetchedAt)
}

/** One company by NSE symbol (undefined if it isn't in the catalogue). */
export function getCompany(symbol: string): Company | undefined {
  return (companies as Record<string, Company | undefined>)[symbol]
}

/** All companies, sorted by today's change — for "top gainers / losers" style lists. */
export function companiesByChange(direction: 'gainers' | 'losers'): Company[] {
  const list = Object.values(companies).filter((c) => c.market)
  return list.sort((a, b) => (direction === 'gainers' ? b.market!.changePct - a.market!.changePct : a.market!.changePct - b.market!.changePct))
}
```

### `src/shared/data/format.ts`

```ts
/** ₹ with Indian grouping: inr(123456.5) → "₹1,23,456.50"; inr(1000, 0) → "₹1,000". */
export const inr = (n: number, decimals = 2) =>
  '₹' + n.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals })

/** $ with US grouping: usd(1234.5) → "$1,234.50"; usd(1000, 0) → "$1,000". */
export const usd = (n: number, decimals = 2) =>
  '$' + n.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals })

/** "9876543210" → "98765 43210" (how Indian mobile numbers are read out). */
export const phone = (digits: string) => (digits.length > 5 ? `${digits.slice(0, 5)} ${digits.slice(5)}` : digits)

/** Keep the last `visible` characters: mask('ABCPM1234K', 1, 5) → "ABCPM****K". */
export const mask = (s: string, keepStart: number, keepEnd: number) =>
  s.slice(0, keepStart) + '•'.repeat(Math.max(0, s.length - keepStart - keepEnd)) + s.slice(s.length - keepEnd)
```

### `src/shared/data/live.ts`

```ts
// Live-looking prices for the prototype. Every price on screen moves a little around its real value (the market
// snapshots: market-snapshot.json for Indian stocks, us-market-snapshot.json for US), ticking every 2 s.
// FLAG: simulated movement — there is no free live feed a browser page can call (Yahoo sends no CORS header; Finnhub
// and the like need a key). The level is real (the snapshot); only the wiggle around it is made up. Each symbol moves
// on its own smooth path (a few slow sine waves), never more than ±0.6 % from the snapshot, the same on every device.
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

const TICK_MS = 2000

let tick = 0
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

function subscribe(onChange: () => void) {
  listeners.add(onChange)
  if (!timer) {
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'hidden') return
      tick += 1
      listeners.forEach((l) => l())
    }, TICK_MS)
  }
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(onChange)
    if (!listeners.size && timer) {
      clearInterval(timer)
      timer = undefined
    }
  }
}

/** Re-render every ticking price now (fresher snapshot data arrived), one tick early. */
export function nudgeLive() {
  tick += 1
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

/** The live clock: a number that goes up by one every 2 s while anything on screen listens. */
export function useLiveTick(): number {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => tick, () => 0)
}

/** A stable number in [0, 1) for a symbol (its path's phase and speed). */
function hash(key: string, salt: number) {
  let n = 2166136261 ^ salt
  for (const c of key) n = Math.imul(n ^ c.charCodeAt(0), 16777619)
  return ((n >>> 0) % 10000) / 10000
}

/** How far a symbol has moved from its snapshot price at a tick: a fraction, within ±0.006. */
export function liveDrift(key: string, at: number): number {
  const a = hash(key, 1), b = hash(key, 2), c = hash(key, 3)
  return 0.0035 * Math.sin(at * (0.21 + a * 0.2) + a * 6.28) + 0.0018 * Math.sin(at * (0.73 + b * 0.4) + b * 6.28) + 0.0007 * Math.sin(at * (1.9 + c) + c * 6.28)
}

export type LiveQuote = {
  price: number
  /** Day change, % (against yesterday's close, so it moves with the price). */
  changePct: number
  /** Day change in the price's currency. */
  change: number
  /** Which way the last tick went: for a brief up / down flash. */
  moved: 'up' | 'down' | 'none'
}

/** A price and its day change % as they are at a tick (yesterday's close is worked back from the snapshot's %). */
export function liveQuote(key: string, price: number, changePct: number, at: number): LiveQuote {
  const prevClose = price / (1 + changePct / 100)
  const now = price * (1 + liveDrift(key, at))
  const before = price * (1 + liveDrift(key, at - 1))
  const round = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100
  const p = round(now)
  return {
    price: p,
    change: round(p - prevClose),
    changePct: round(((p - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100),
    moved: at === 0 || round(before) === p ? 'none' : p > round(before) ? 'up' : 'down',
  }
}

/** A price that ticks: `useLiveQuote('NVDA', 204.64, -4.22)`. */
export function useLiveQuote(key: string, price: number, changePct: number): LiveQuote {
  return liveQuote(key, price, changePct, useLiveTick())
}
```

### `src/shared/data/usStocks.ts`

```ts
// US stocks — data more than one flow uses (the US Stocks flow, the Stocks home's US tab, the Market tab's US list).
// Prices are real: us-market-snapshot.json, from Yahoo Finance by `npm run us:snapshot` (scripts/us-market-snapshot.mjs),
// overrides the catalogue's numbers below and adds every other stock / ETF the app shows. `live.ts` makes them tick.
// Near-live, not live: the bundled copy is used at first, then the app re-reads ./us-market-snapshot.json (published by
// the build, refreshed every 15 minutes in US market hours by the site repo's Action, scripts/site-workflow-us.yml) on
// load and every 5 minutes, and updates the numbers below in place.
// Logos are in src/shared/assets/us-logos: full-colour SVGs (scripts/us-logos.mjs), PNGs for the few without one (L3 has company logos for Indian stocks only).
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
import bundled from './us-market-snapshot.json'
import { nudgeLive } from './live'

export type UsStock = {
  sym: string
  name: string
  price: number
  /** Day change, %. */
  change: number
  exchange: string
  /** Logo path (asset()) — overrides the catalogue logo. */
  logo?: string
  /** Logo plate colour behind a transparent logo. */
  plate?: string
}

export const catalogue: Record<string, Omit<UsStock, 'sym'>> = {
  NVDA: { name: 'NVIDIA Corp', price: 188.42, change: 1.24, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  AAPL: { name: 'Apple Inc', price: 262.82, change: 0.89, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  MSFT: { name: 'Microsoft Corp', price: 523.61, change: -0.42, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  GOOGL: { name: 'Alphabet Inc', price: 251.46, change: 0.92, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  GOOG: { name: 'Alphabet Inc', price: 252.03, change: 0.9, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  TSLA: { name: 'Tesla Inc', price: 433.72, change: 2.15, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  AMZN: { name: 'Amazon.com Inc', price: 224.21, change: -0.37, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  META: { name: 'Meta Platforms', price: 734, change: 0.64, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  NFLX: { name: 'Netflix Inc', price: 1187, change: -1.12, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  NKE: { name: 'Nike Inc', price: 64.3, change: 0.48, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  MCD: { name: 'McDonald’s Corp', price: 301.55, change: -0.21, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  KO: { name: 'Coca-Cola Co', price: 69.42, change: 0.18, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  SBUX: { name: 'Starbucks Corp', price: 84.1, change: -0.66, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  V: { name: 'Visa Inc', price: 344.7, change: 0.37, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  UBER: { name: 'Uber Technologies', price: 96.2, change: 1.05, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  AMD: { name: 'Advanced Micro Devices', price: 214.9, change: 3.12, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  AVGO: { name: 'Broadcom Inc', price: 342.37, change: 2.87, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  MU: { name: 'Micron Technology', price: 192.4, change: 1.4, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  LULU: { name: 'Lululemon Athletica', price: 168.3, change: -1.6, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  JPM: { name: 'JPMorgan Chase', price: 296.2, change: 0.31, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  // Mid and small caps — so the Market tab's cap filters have stocks in every tier.
  LYFT: { name: 'Lyft Inc', price: 22.4, change: 1.8, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  ETSY: { name: 'Etsy Inc', price: 61.2, change: -0.9, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  SONO: { name: 'Sonos Inc', price: 14.1, change: -1.3, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
}

type SnapshotQuote = { name: string | null; exchange: string | null; price: number; changePct: number; open?: number | null; prevClose: number; dayHigh: number | null; dayLow: number | null; high52: number | null; low52: number | null; volume: number | null; closes: number[] }
type IndexQuote = { price: number; changePct: number }
type Snapshot = { source: string; fetchedAt: string; quotes: Record<string, SnapshotQuote>; indices: Record<string, IndexQuote>; fx?: { usdInr?: { price: number } } }

// The numbers in use now — the bundled snapshot's, replaced in place when a fresher one is read (see the runtime refresh).
const quotes: Record<string, SnapshotQuote> = { ...(bundled.quotes as unknown as Record<string, SnapshotQuote>) }
const indices: Record<string, IndexQuote> = { ...(bundled.indices as Record<string, IndexQuote>) }
const current = { fetchedAt: bundled.fetchedAt, source: bundled.source, usdInr: (bundled as unknown as Snapshot).fx?.usdInr?.price }

/** "Apple Inc." → "Apple Inc", "Airbnb, Inc." → "Airbnb Inc": the snapshot's legal names, as the app writes them. */
const tidyName = (name: string) => name.replace(/,? (Inc|Corp|Corporation|Co|Ltd|Plc|N\.V|S\.A)\.?$/i, (m) => ' ' + m.replace(/[,.]/g, '').trim()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()

// The snapshot's real price, day change and exchange for every symbol in it; the catalogue's own names stay.
function applyQuotes() {
  for (const [sym, q] of Object.entries(quotes)) {
    if (q.price == null) continue
    const known = catalogue[sym]
    catalogue[sym] = { name: known?.name ?? tidyName(q.name ?? sym), price: q.price, change: q.changePct, exchange: q.exchange ?? known?.exchange ?? 'NASDAQ' }
  }
}
applyQuotes()

/** When the US prices were taken (ISO time). */
export const usSnapshotAt = (): string => current.fetchedAt

/** The snapshot's full quote of a symbol (day range, 52-week range, volume, a month of closes), if it has one. */
export const usQuote = (symbol: string): SnapshotQuote | undefined => quotes[symbol]

/** Today's value of a US index (`sp-500`, `nasdaq`, `dow-jones`) from the snapshot. */
export const usIndexQuote = (id: string): IndexQuote | undefined => indices[id]

/** ₹ per $ in the snapshot (USDINR=X), or undefined if it has none. */
export const usdInrSnapshot = (): number | undefined => current.usdInr

// ── Runtime refresh ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

function apply(next: Snapshot) {
  if (!(next.fetchedAt > current.fetchedAt)) return // ISO strings sort by time; never go back to older data
  // A symbol the published file doesn't have yet (added to the app after the site's copy) keeps the numbers we have.
  Object.assign(quotes, next.quotes)
  Object.assign(indices, next.indices)
  Object.assign(current, { fetchedAt: next.fetchedAt, source: next.source, usdInr: next.fx?.usdInr?.price ?? current.usdInr })
  applyQuotes()
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
  nudgeLive() // every ticking price re-renders now, not at the next tick
}

/** Re-read the published US snapshot (same origin — no API call). Fails quietly: the numbers we have stay. */
export async function refreshUsMarket() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('us-market-snapshot.json', { cache: 'no-cache' })
    if (res.ok) apply(await res.json())
  } catch { /* offline, or the file isn't there — keep what we have */ }
}

const REFRESH_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  refreshUsMarket()
  setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refreshUsMarket() }, REFRESH_MS)
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refreshUsMarket() })
}

function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener)
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener) }
}

/** Re-renders the calling component when fresher US data arrives; returns its `fetchedAt`. */
export function useUsMarketSnapshot(): string {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => current.fetchedAt)
}

// A full-colour SVG (the mark on its brand colour, edge to edge — scripts/us-logos.mjs) wins over the older PNG (a mark on
// transparent, which shows on the L3 Avatar's grey); the PNG stays for the few symbols that have no SVG.
const logoFiles = import.meta.glob('../assets/us-logos/*.{png,svg}', { eager: true, query: '?url', import: 'default' }) as Record<string, string>
const symbolOf = (path: string) => path.slice(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1, path.lastIndexOf('.'))
const logoBySymbol = new Map(
  Object.entries(logoFiles)
    .sort(([a], [b]) => Number(a.endsWith('.svg')) - Number(b.endsWith('.svg')))
    .map(([path, url]) => [symbolOf(path), url]),
)

/** Symbols that have a logo file in src/shared/assets/us-logos. */
export const usLogoSymbols: string[] = [...logoBySymbol.keys()].sort()

/** The logo of a US company (SVG or PNG URL), or undefined (show initials). */
export const usLogo = (symbol: string): string | undefined => logoBySymbol.get(symbol)

// Logos from financialmodelingprep.com (2 Nov, ETF holdings) are transparent marks drawn for a white page: they sit on
// a static white plate so dark marks (Intuitive Surgical, Rocket Lab, Sony) show in dark mode too; the white marks
// (Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Samsung) sit on black.
const PLATED_WHITE = new Set('ABB ADI AMAT ASML ASTS BABA BIDU COP GE GRMN HXSCL ISRG KLAC LRCX MRVL MUFG NVO NXPI PDD RKLB RTX SAP SONY TM TSM TXN'.split(' '))
const PLATED_BLACK = new Set(['LMT', 'NOC', 'SSNLF'])
/** The plate a US logo needs inside an Avatar ('white' / 'black'), or undefined when the file brings its own. */
export const usLogoPlate = (symbol: string): 'white' | 'black' | undefined =>
  PLATED_BLACK.has(symbol) ? 'black' : PLATED_WHITE.has(symbol) ? 'white' : undefined

// The stock being looked at: a list (Market tab, Search …) sets it, the stock page reads it.
let viewed: string | undefined

/** Remember which US stock the stock page should open. */
export const viewUsStock = (symbol: string) => { viewed = symbol }

/** The symbol set by the last `viewUsStock`, or undefined if none yet. */
export const viewedUsStock = () => viewed
```

```ts
// Market status — app-level prototype settings ("Market" in the User status panel), 27 Nov, user: "give this thing in the
// prototype setting, what the status of the market is, before market, after market, because this is just a prototype".
// Nothing here follows the clock: whoever tests picks the state and every screen that depends on it follows — the order
// pads' notes, the order result (placed now vs. queued for the open), the US Markets banner on the F&O home.
// In a real app these come from the exchange calendar and the time of day.
import type { FlowOption } from '../flows/types'
import { useFlowOption } from './prototype'
import { USER_STATUS } from './userStatus'

/** NSE / BSE (Indian stocks). Pre-open: 9:00–9:15 AM, orders go into the opening auction. */
export type NseMarket = 'open' | 'preOpen' | 'closed' | 'holiday'
/** The US market (US Stocks), and the US Markets banner. Coming soon: US Stocks isn't launched yet (banner only). */
export type UsMarket = 'live' | 'closed' | 'holiday' | 'soon'

/** Where the setting floats beside the phone: the F&O home (banner), the stock pages and the order pads. */
const MARKET_SCREENS = ['fno-01', 'fno-02', 'fno-03', 'fno-04', 'us-stocks-13', 'us-stocks-33', 'us-stocks-34', 'us-stocks-37', 'us-stocks-38', 'us-stocks-40', 'us-stocks-41', 'us-stocks-47', 'us-stocks-106', 'us-stocks-107']

export const marketStatusOptions: FlowOption[] = [
  {
    id: 'nseMarket',
    group: 'Market',
    label: 'Indian market (NSE)',
    values: [
      { value: 'open', label: 'Open' },
      { value: 'preOpen', label: 'Pre-open' },
      { value: 'closed', label: 'Closed (after market)' },
      { value: 'holiday', label: 'Holiday' },
    ],
    default: 'open',
    floatOn: MARKET_SCREENS,
  },
  {
    id: 'usMarket',
    group: 'Market',
    label: 'US market',
    values: [
      { value: 'live', label: 'Live' },
      { value: 'closed', label: 'Closed' },
      { value: 'holiday', label: 'Holiday' },
      { value: 'soon', label: 'Coming soon' },
    ],
    default: 'live',
    floatOn: MARKET_SCREENS,
  },
]

const option = (id: string) => marketStatusOptions.find((o) => o.id === id)!
const useMarket = (id: string) => useFlowOption(USER_STATUS, id, option(id).default)

export const useNseMarket = () => useMarket('nseMarket') as NseMarket
export const useUsMarket = () => useMarket('usMarket') as UsMarket
```

### `src/shared/money.tsx`

```tsx
// US Stocks money — every value inside US Stocks is in US dollars (the news, prices and filings users read are in $),
// with its rupee equivalent at the live USD → INR rate available everywhere. How the ₹ shows is a prototype setting
// ("₹ equivalent" in the User status panel), so the same screens try each idea:
//   off    — $ only (the default; the stock and ETF pages still show ≈ ₹ under the price)
//   below  — $ with a small "≈ ₹1,23,456" line under it — only in the order pad since 3 Nov (`layout="stack"`)
//   switch — a $ / ₹ switch (<CurrencySwitch />); picking ₹ turns every US value into rupees, across every screen
// Screens never format a US amount themselves: <Usd value={188.42} /> (or useUsd() where only a string fits).
// The rate is real: USDINR=X in us-market-snapshot.json (`npm run us:snapshot`), ticking around it like the prices
// (live.ts). FLAG: it's a snapshot + simulated movement, not a live FX feed — the real app reads its partner's rate.
import { useSyncExternalStore, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import type { FlowOption } from '../flows/types'
import { usdInrSnapshot } from './data/usStocks'
import { liveDrift, useLiveTick } from './data/live'
import styles from './money.module.css'

// ── The rate ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** ₹ per $ in the snapshot (the fallback is the 2 Nov 2026 close, should the snapshot lose it). Re-read with the prices. */
const usdInrNow = (): number => usdInrSnapshot() ?? 94.87

/** The USD → INR rate right now: the snapshot's, moving a little every 2 s like a live quote. */
export function useUsdInrRate(): number {
  const at = useLiveTick()
  return Math.round(usdInrNow() * (1 + liveDrift('USDINR', at) / 4) * 100) / 100
}

// ── Formatting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type MoneyFormat = {
  /** Digits after the point (default 2). */
  decimals?: number
  /** '+' on positive values (gains and changes). Negative values always get '-'. */
  sign?: boolean
  /** Short big numbers: $4.59T / $812.40B / $12.3M, and ₹4.35 L Cr / ₹12.40 Cr / ₹3.20 L. */
  compact?: boolean
}

const fixed = (n: number, locale: string, decimals: number) =>
  n.toLocaleString(locale, { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals })
const signOf = (n: number, sign?: boolean) => (n < 0 ? '-' : sign && n > 0 ? '+' : '')

/** $1,234.50 · +$12.30 · $4.59T */
export function formatUsd(n: number, { decimals = 2, sign, compact }: MoneyFormat = {}): string {
  const a = Math.abs(n)
  if (compact) {
    const unit = a >= 1e12 ? ['T', 1e12] : a >= 1e9 ? ['B', 1e9] : a >= 1e6 ? ['M', 1e6] : undefined
    if (unit) return `${signOf(n, sign)}$${fixed(a / (unit[1] as number), 'en-US', 2)}${unit[0]}`
  }
  return `${signOf(n, sign)}$${fixed(a, 'en-US', decimals)}`
}

/** ₹1,23,456.78 · +₹1,064 · ₹4.35 L Cr (Indian grouping and units) */
export function formatInr(n: number, { decimals = 2, sign, compact }: MoneyFormat = {}): string {
  const a = Math.abs(n)
  if (compact) {
    const unit = a >= 1e12 ? [' L Cr', 1e12] : a >= 1e7 ? [' Cr', 1e7] : a >= 1e5 ? [' L', 1e5] : undefined
    if (unit) return `${signOf(n, sign)}₹${fixed(a / (unit[1] as number), 'en-IN', 2)}${unit[0]}`
  }
  return `${signOf(n, sign)}₹${fixed(a, 'en-IN', decimals)}`
}

/**
 * A $ amount written as text → the number and how it was written, so sample strings can go through <Usd text="…" />:
 * '$188.42' → 188.42 · '+$12.30' → 12.3 · '-$5' → -5 · '$4.59T' → 4.59e12. Not a $ amount → undefined.
 */
export function parseUsd(text: string): { value: number; format: MoneyFormat } | undefined {
  const m = /^\s*([+-−])?\s*\$\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*([KMBT])?\s*$/.exec(text)
  if (!m) return undefined
  const digits = m[2].replace(/,/g, '')
  const scale = { K: 1e3, M: 1e6, B: 1e9, T: 1e12 }[m[3] as 'K' | 'M' | 'B' | 'T'] ?? 1
  const value = Number(digits) * scale * (m[1] === '-' || m[1] === '−' ? -1 : 1)
  return { value, format: { decimals: digits.split('.')[1]?.length ?? 0, sign: m[1] === '+', compact: scale >= 1e6 } }
}

// ── The setting and the switch ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type InrDisplay = 'off' | 'below' | 'switch'
export type UsCurrency = 'usd' | 'inr'

/** The app-level setting (shown in the User status panel, beside the phone on the US screens that show most money). */
export const moneyOptions: FlowOption[] = [
  {
    id: 'inrDisplay',
    group: 'US Stocks money',
    label: '₹ equivalent',
    values: [{ value: 'off', label: '$ only' }, { value: 'below', label: '₹ below' }, { value: 'switch', label: '$ / ₹ switch' }],
    // $ only by default (3 Nov): the ₹ shows when picked here. The stock and ETF pages are the exception — their price
    // always has its ≈ ₹ under it.
    default: 'off',
    // Not in the floating card beside the phone any more (18 Nov, the user's call): still in the settings list.
  },
]

// Archived 18 Nov (the user's call): the "₹ equivalent" setting is no longer offered — US money shows in $ only. The
// ₹ below / $ ⇄ ₹ switch code stays; set INR_DISPLAY to 'below' or 'switch' to see it (stock and ETF pages keep their ≈ ₹).
const INR_DISPLAY = moneyOptions[0].default as InrDisplay
const useInrDisplay = () => INR_DISPLAY

// The currency picked on the switch: one for the whole app, remembered on this device (like a real app's preference).
const CURRENCY_KEY = 'us-currency'
let currency: UsCurrency = (() => {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(CURRENCY_KEY) === 'inr' ? 'inr' : 'usd'
  } catch {
    return 'usd'
  }
})()
const currencyListeners = new Set<() => void>()
const subscribeCurrency = (l: () => void) => (currencyListeners.add(l), () => void currencyListeners.delete(l))

export function setUsCurrency(next: UsCurrency) {
  currency = next
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(CURRENCY_KEY, next)
  } catch {
    /* private window: just this session */
  }
  currencyListeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

export type MoneyDisplay = {
  /** How the ₹ shows (the setting). */
  inr: InrDisplay
  /** The currency values are in right now: ₹ only when the switch is on and set to ₹. */
  currency: UsCurrency
  /** ₹ per $ right now. */
  rate: number
}

export function useMoneyDisplay(): MoneyDisplay {
  const inr = useInrDisplay()
  const picked = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeCurrency, () => currency, () => 'usd' as UsCurrency)
  return { inr, currency: inr === 'switch' ? picked : 'usd', rate: useUsdInrRate() }
}

/**
 * A US amount as text, in the currency showing: `const usd = useUsd(); usd(188.42)` → "$188.42" (or "₹17,875.40" with
 * the switch on ₹). For places that only take a string (a button label, a sentence, a chart axis). No "≈ ₹" line.
 */
export function useUsd() {
  const { currency, rate } = useMoneyDisplay()
  return (usd: number, format: MoneyFormat = {}) =>
    currency === 'inr' ? formatInr(usd * rate, { ...format, decimals: format.compact ? 2 : format.decimals ?? 2 }) : formatUsd(usd, format)
}

/** The rupee line on its own ("≈ ₹17,875"), only with the "₹ below" setting. For a ₹ line that sits apart from its $. */
export function useInrEquivalent() {
  const { inr, rate } = useMoneyDisplay()
  return (usd: number, format: MoneyFormat = {}) => (inr === 'below' ? `≈ ${formatInr(usd * rate, { decimals: 0, ...format })}` : undefined)
}

// ── Components ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type UsdProps = MoneyFormat & {
  /** The amount in $ … */
  value?: number
  /** … or a $ amount written as text ('$188.42', '+$12.30', '$4.59T'); anything else shows as it is. */
  text?: string
  /**
   * `inline` (default): no ₹ line — the switch still turns it into ₹. `stack`: the ≈ ₹ line goes under the value, with
   * the "₹ below" setting. Since 3 Nov only the order pad asks for it (its Fee breakdown); listing cards, pages and
   * sheets show $ only.
   */
  layout?: 'stack' | 'inline'
  /** Text-align of the stack (a right-aligned column → 'end'). */
  align?: 'start' | 'end' | 'center'
  className?: string
}

/**
 * A US amount. Shows $ (or ₹ with the switch on ₹) in the parent's own type style, and with "₹ below" a small
 * secondary "≈ ₹…" line under it. `<Usd value={1234.5} />` · `<Usd text="+$12.30" />` · `<Usd value={4.59e12} compact />`
 */
export function Usd({ value, text, layout = 'inline', align = 'start', className, ...format }: UsdProps) {
  const usd = useUsd()
  const below = useInrEquivalent()
  const parsed = value === undefined && text !== undefined ? parseUsd(text) : undefined
  if (value === undefined && !parsed) return <span className={className}>{text}</span>
  const amount = value ?? parsed!.value
  const f: MoneyFormat = parsed ? { ...parsed.format, ...format } : format
  const main = usd(amount, f)
  const line = layout === 'stack' ? below(amount, { sign: f.sign, compact: f.compact }) : undefined
  if (!line) return <span className={className}>{main}</span>
  return (
    <span className={[styles.stack, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} data-align={align}>
      <span>{main}</span>
      <span className={styles.inr}>{line}</span>
    </span>
  )
}

/** Just the "≈ ₹…" line, for a layout that puts it apart from the $ (under a big balance, say). Nothing unless "₹ below". */
export function InrEquivalent({ usd, className, ...format }: MoneyFormat & { usd: number; className?: string }): ReactNode {
  const line = useInrEquivalent()(usd, format)
  return line ? <span className={[styles.inr, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}>{line}</span> : null
}

/**
 * The $ / ₹ switch (L3 pill group, small). Shows only with the "$ / ₹ switch" setting; the pick applies to every US
 * value in the app. Put it where the money is: the wallet's balance, the portfolio's value, a stock page's price.
 */
export function CurrencySwitch({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const { inr, currency } = useMoneyDisplay()
  if (inr !== 'switch') return null
  return (
    <Tabs
      className={className}
      appearance="pill-group"
      size="sm"
      aria-label="Show values in"
      items={[{ value: 'usd', label: '$ USD' }, { value: 'inr', label: '₹ INR' }]}
      value={currency}
      onChange={(v) => setUsCurrency(v as UsCurrency)}
    />
  )
}
```
